module Gopurs.CallExprs
  ( application
  , uncurriedApplication
  , effectApplication
  ) where

import Prelude
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Foldable (foldMap)
import Data.Map as Map
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..), fromMaybe)
import Data.Newtype (unwrap)
import Data.String as String
import Data.String.Pattern (Pattern(..), Replacement(..))
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..))
import Gopurs.ArrayProducerFold as ArrayProducerFold
import Gopurs.ArrayIntrinsics as ArrayIntrinsics
import Gopurs.ArrayConcat as ArrayConcat
import Gopurs.ArrayIntrinsics.Callback as Callback
import Gopurs.ArrayTraverse as ArrayTraverse
import Gopurs.ArrayIndexedFold as ArrayIndexedFold
import Gopurs.ArrayEquality as ArrayEquality
import Gopurs.ScalarArrayFold as ScalarArrayFold
import Gopurs.ArrayRangeFold as ArrayRangeFold
import Gopurs.CodePointFold as CodePointFold
import Gopurs.ArraySort as ArraySort
import Gopurs.ObjectTraverse as ObjectTraverse
import Gopurs.TailRecEffect as TailRecEffect
import Gopurs.PrivateSTRegions as PrivateSTRegions
import Gopurs.CallAnalysis (CallTarget, collectGoSpine, getGoSpineArgs, curriedTarget, qualifiedTarget)
import Gopurs.CallArguments (Arguments, applyBoxed)
import Gopurs.CallArguments as CallArguments
import Gopurs.CodegenState (FunctionInfo)
import Gopurs.ExprAnalysis (getExprType, unwrapTcoExpr)
import Gopurs.ExprContext (ExprContext, ExprResult, LoopTarget, TranslateExpr, StmtTree(..), childContext)
import Gopurs.GoAst (rawGo, GoExpr(..), GoType(..), goTypeToStr, sanitizeName)
import Gopurs.GoConversions (boxGoExpr, coerceGoExpr)
import Gopurs.GoFunctions (hasNativeRecordArgument, nativeCallbackCall)
import Gopurs.GoTypes (exprTypeToGoType)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco (TcoExpr)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (ExprType(..), Ident(..), Qualified(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.FreeVars (localId)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendSyntax(..))

application :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> ExprResult
application translate context nextId expression =
  let
    Tuple fn spine = collectGoSpine expression
    args = getGoSpineArgs spine
  in
    -- Curried calls give a tail jump priority over intrinsic recognition.
    case tailTarget context fn of
      Just target -> tailCall translate context nextId expression args target
      Nothing -> case ObjectTraverse.emit translate context nextId (qualifiedTarget fn) args of
        Just result -> result
        Nothing -> case TailRecEffect.emit translate context nextId fn args of
          Just result -> result
          Nothing -> case PrivateSTRegions.emit translate context nextId fn args of
            Just result -> result
            Nothing -> regularApplication fn args
  where
  regularApplication fn args = case producerFold fn args of
    Just result -> result
    Nothing -> sortedApplication fn args

  producerFold fn args = if not (ArrayProducerFold.onlyCurried expression) then Nothing else case args of
    [ producer ] | getExprType producer == Array Int -> do
      info <- directFunction context (curriedTarget context.bound fn) 1
      descriptor <- info.arrayFold
      ArrayProducerFold.emit translate context nextId descriptor producer
    _ -> Nothing

  sortedApplication fn args = case ArraySort.emit translate context nextId fn args of
    Just result -> result
    Nothing -> scalarApplication fn args

  scalarApplication fn args = case scalarFold translate context nextId fn args of
    Just result -> result
    Nothing -> arrayApplication fn args

  arrayApplication fn args = case ArrayEquality.emit translate context nextId fn args of
    Just result -> result
    Nothing -> case ArrayTraverse.emit translate context nextId fn args of
        Just result -> result
        Nothing ->
          let target = curriedTarget context.bound fn
          in case ArrayIntrinsics.recognize ArrayIntrinsics.Curried context.modNameStr target (Array.length args) of
            Just intrinsic ->
              ArrayIntrinsics.emitCurried translate context nextId fn args intrinsic
            Nothing -> case directFunction context target (Array.length args) of
              Just info ->
                let translated = directArguments translate context nextId info.fArgs args
                in nativeCall context (GoRef info.reference) info.fArgs info.fRet info.arity translated
              Nothing -> curriedCall translate context nextId fn args

scalarFold :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> Array TcoExpr -> Maybe ExprResult
scalarFold translate context nextId fn args = case CodePointFold.emit translate context nextId fn args of
  Just fused -> Just fused
  Nothing -> case ArrayRangeFold.emit translate context nextId fn args of
    Just fused -> Just fused
    Nothing -> case ScalarArrayFold.emit translate context nextId fn args of
      Just folded -> Just folded
      Nothing -> ArrayIndexedFold.emit translate context nextId fn args

-- Only a published native predicate slot enables lambda lowering here. Other
-- calls retain their current translation. Capture every argument in source
-- order before entering the worker, including boxed callback factories.
directArguments :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> Array GoType -> Array TcoExpr -> Arguments
directArguments translate context@{ codegenStateRef, modNameStr } nextId expected args =
  let predicateType = TypeFunc [ TypeInt64 ] TypeBool
  in if Array.elem predicateType expected then
    CallArguments.capture { prefix: "nativePredicate_arg_", markUsed: false }
      (\index argumentId arg ->
        let
          native = if Array.index expected index == Just predicateType && getExprType arg == Func [ Int ] Boolean then
            Callback.nativeLambda translate context argumentId 1 arg
            else Nothing
          result = case native of
            Just callback@{ expr: GoFuncLit params statements returned resultType } ->
              callback
                { expr = GoFuncLit params statements (coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr returned resultType TypeBool) TypeBool
                , exprType = predicateType }
            _ -> translate (childContext context Nothing) argumentId arg
        in if Array.index expected index == Just predicateType then
          result { expr = coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr result.expr result.exprType predicateType, exprType = predicateType }
          else result)
      nextId args
    -- A unary native consumer has no later argument evaluation across which
    -- array materialization could move. In particular concat's empty-side
    -- alias must not be copied early relative to another argument factory.
    else if expected == [ TypeNativeArray TypeInt64 ] && Array.length args == 1 then CallArguments.capture { prefix: "nativeArray_arg_", markUsed: false }
      (\index argumentId arg ->
        let native = if Array.index expected index == Just (TypeNativeArray TypeInt64) then
              ArrayConcat.nativeArgument translate context argumentId arg
              else Nothing
        in case native of
          Just result -> result
          Nothing -> translate ((childContext context Nothing)
            { mbExpectedGoType = Just (TypeNativeArray TypeInt64) }) argumentId arg)
      nextId args
    else CallArguments.translate translate context Nothing { stmts: StmtEmpty, nextId } args

-- A direct worker must be saturated; partial calls retain the boxed path.
directFunction :: ExprContext -> Maybe CallTarget -> Int -> Maybe FunctionInfo
directFunction { metadata, modNameStr, moduleFunctions } target count = do
  { mbMod, name } <- target
  let isLocal = map (String.replaceAll (Pattern ".") (Replacement "_") <<< unwrap) mbMod == Just modNameStr || mbMod == Nothing
  info <- if isLocal then Map.lookup name moduleFunctions
    else do
      mn <- mbMod
      Map.lookup (unwrap mn <> "." <> name) metadata.globalFunctions
  if count >= info.arity && info.arity >= 1 then Just info else Nothing

curriedCall :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> Array TcoExpr -> ExprResult
curriedCall translate context@{ codegenStateRef, metadata, modNameStr } nextId fn args =
  let
    resFn = translate (childContext context Nothing) nextId fn
    argumentTypes = map (exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr <<< getExprType) args
  in
    case resFn.exprType of
      TypeFunc fArgs fRet | Array.length args >= Array.length fArgs ->
        let translated = CallArguments.translate translate context Nothing { stmts: resFn.stmts, nextId: resFn.nextId } args
        in nativeCall context resFn.expr fArgs fRet (Array.length fArgs) translated
      _ | Array.length args <= 5 && hasNativeRecordArgument argumentTypes ->
        recordCallbackCall translate context resFn args
      _ ->
        let
          translated = CallArguments.translate translate context (Just Any) { stmts: resFn.stmts, nextId: resFn.nextId } args
          boxedArgs = CallArguments.boxRemaining context 0 translated
          expr = applyBoxed (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resFn.expr resFn.exprType) boxedArgs
        in
          { stmts: translated.stmts, expr, exprType: TypeValue, nextId: translated.nextId }

recordCallbackCall :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> ExprResult -> Array TcoExpr -> ExprResult
recordCallbackCall translate context@{ codegenStateRef, modNameStr } fn args =
  let
    fnName = "__callback_fn_" <> show fn.nextId
    captured = CallArguments.capture { prefix: "__callback_arg_", markUsed: false }
      (\_ nextId arg ->
        let result = translate (childContext context Nothing) nextId arg
        -- A Go short declaration would default an untyped numeric literal to
        -- int/float64. Preserve its declared native ABI before capturing it.
        in result { expr = case result.exprType of
          TypeInt64 -> GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ result.expr ]
          TypeFloat64 -> GoCall (GoVar "float64") [ result.expr ]
          TypeUint32 -> GoCall (GoVar "uint32") [ result.expr ]
          _ -> result.expr
        })
      (fn.nextId + 1) args
    fnExpr = GoVar fnName
    fallback = applyBoxed fnExpr (CallArguments.boxRemaining context 0 captured)
    expr = if hasNativeRecordArgument captured.exprTypes then
      nativeCallbackCall fnExpr captured.exprTypes captured.exprs fallback
      else fallback
  in
    { stmts: fn.stmts
        <> StmtLeaf (GoAssign fnName (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr fn.expr fn.exprType))
        <> captured.stmts
    , expr
    , exprType: TypeValue
    , nextId: captured.nextId
    }

-- Coerce the native prefix and apply any surplus arguments to its boxed
-- result. Boxing surplus arguments stays before prefix coercion, as before.
nativeCall :: ExprContext -> GoExpr -> Array GoType -> GoType -> Int -> Arguments -> ExprResult
nativeCall context@{ codegenStateRef, modNameStr } fn expected ret arity args =
  let
    remaining = CallArguments.boxRemaining context arity args
    callArgs = CallArguments.coercePrefix context arity expected args
    call = GoCall fn callArgs
    expr = if Array.null remaining then call else applyBoxed (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr call ret) remaining
    exprType = if Array.null remaining then ret else TypeValue
  in
    { stmts: args.stmts, expr, exprType, nextId: args.nextId }

uncurriedApplication :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> TcoExpr -> Array TcoExpr -> ExprResult
uncurriedApplication translate context nextId expression fn args =
  -- Uncurried calls recognize intrinsics before considering a tail jump.
  case ArraySort.emit translate context nextId fn args of
    Just result -> result
    Nothing -> uncurriedScalarApplication translate context nextId expression fn args

uncurriedScalarApplication :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> TcoExpr -> Array TcoExpr -> ExprResult
uncurriedScalarApplication translate context nextId expression fn args =
  case scalarFold translate context nextId fn args of
    Just result -> result
    Nothing -> uncurriedArrayApplication translate context nextId expression fn args

uncurriedArrayApplication :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> TcoExpr -> Array TcoExpr -> ExprResult
uncurriedArrayApplication translate context nextId expression fn args =
  case ArrayEquality.emit translate context nextId fn args of
    Just result -> result
    Nothing -> case ArrayIntrinsics.safeIndex translate context nextId (qualifiedTarget fn) args of
      Just result -> result
      Nothing -> case ArrayIntrinsics.recognize ArrayIntrinsics.Uncurried context.modNameStr (qualifiedTarget fn) (Array.length args) of
        Just intrinsic ->
          ArrayIntrinsics.emitUncurried translate context nextId args intrinsic
        Nothing ->
          let
            Tuple flatFn spine = collectGoSpine expression
            flatArgs = getGoSpineArgs spine
          in
            case tailTarget context flatFn of
              Just target -> tailCall translate context nextId expression flatArgs target
              Nothing -> uncurriedCall translate context 10 nextId fn args

effectApplication :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> Array TcoExpr -> ExprResult
effectApplication translate context = uncurriedCall translate context 5

-- Effect applications and ordinary uncurried applications differ only in
-- the largest runtime wrapper they select. Both box their final result.
uncurriedCall :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> Int -> TcoExpr -> Array TcoExpr -> ExprResult
uncurriedCall translate context@{ codegenStateRef, modNameStr } maxArity nextId fn args =
  let
    resFn = translate (childContext context Nothing) nextId fn
    translated = CallArguments.translate translate context Nothing { stmts: resFn.stmts, nextId: resFn.nextId } args
    len = Array.length args
    goFuncName = if len >= 2 && len <= maxArity then "UncurriedApp" <> show len else "UncurriedApp"
    expr = case resFn.exprType of
      TypeFunc fArgs fRet | Array.length fArgs == len ->
        let callArgs = CallArguments.coercePrefix context len fArgs translated
        in boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr (GoCall resFn.expr callArgs) fRet
      _ ->
        let boxedArgs = CallArguments.boxRemaining context 0 translated
        in GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") goFuncName)
          (Array.cons (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resFn.expr resFn.exprType) boxedArgs)
  in
    { stmts: translated.stmts, expr, exprType: TypeValue, nextId: translated.nextId }

tailTarget :: ExprContext -> TcoExpr -> Maybe LoopTarget
tailTarget { bound, loopCtx, options: { isTail } } fn =
  if isTail then case unwrapTcoExpr fn of
    Local mbIdent lvl ->
      let binding = fromMaybe { name: localId mbIdent lvl, goType: TypeValue } (Map.lookup (localId mbIdent lvl) bound)
      in Array.find (\target -> target.ident == binding.name) loopCtx
    Var (Qualified _ (Ident name)) -> Array.find (\target -> target.ident == sanitizeName name) loopCtx
    _ -> Nothing
  else Nothing

tailCall :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> Array TcoExpr -> LoopTarget -> ExprResult
tailCall translate context@{ metadata, codegenStateRef, modNameStr, mbExpectedExprType } nextId expression args target =
  let
    -- Translate all operands outside tail position before updating the loop
    -- slots. Their references use the current iteration's immutable parameters
    -- (GoFunctions.iterationBindings), not slots changed by earlier assignments.
    translated = CallArguments.translate translate context Nothing { stmts: StmtEmpty, nextId } args
    assigns = Array.mapWithIndex
      (\index param -> GoMutate param (coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr
        (fromMaybe (rawGo "nil") (Array.index translated.exprs index))
        (fromMaybe TypeValue (Array.index translated.exprTypes index))
        (fromMaybe TypeValue (Array.index target.goTypes index))))
      target.loopParams
    expectedGoType = exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr
      (case getExprType expression of
        Any -> fromMaybe Any mbExpectedExprType
        ty -> ty)
  in
    { stmts: translated.stmts <> foldMap StmtLeaf assigns <> StmtLeaf (GoContinue target.ident)
    , expr: rawGo ("func() " <> goTypeToStr expectedGoType <> " { panic(\"unreachable\") }()")
    , exprType: expectedGoType
    , nextId: translated.nextId
    }

module Gopurs.CodeGen
  ( translate
  , translateWithFunctions
  , PreparedModule
  , prepareModule
  , workerInputs
  , workerOwners
  , globalTypeDemands
  , translatePreparedWithFunctions
  ) where

import Prelude
import Gopurs.Cache.LookupTable as LookupTable
import Control.Alternative (guard)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendAccessor(..), BackendOperator(..), BackendOperator1(..), BackendOperator2(..), BackendSyntax(PrimEffect, PrimOp, Branch, Fail, CtorDef, CtorSaturated, Lit, UncurriedAbs, Abs, Update, Accessor, LetRec, Let, EffectDefer, EffectPure, EffectBind, UncurriedEffectAbs, UncurriedEffectApp, UncurriedApp, App, Local, Var, Typed))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax as Syn
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Convert (BackendModule)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Semantics (NeutralExpr(..))
import Data.String as String
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..), fromMaybe)
import Data.Newtype (unwrap)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (Ident(..), Literal(..), Prop(..), Qualified(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn as CoreFn
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..))
import Effect.Unsafe (unsafePerformEffect)
import Effect.Ref (Ref)
import Effect.Ref as Ref
import Data.String.Pattern (Pattern(..), Replacement(..))
import Data.Map as Map
import Data.Set as Set
import Data.Foldable (foldl)
import Gopurs.GoAst (GoExpr(..), GoDecl(..), GoType(..), GoFile, capitalize, sanitizeName)
import Gopurs.GoSymbol (GoReference(..), generated, foreignSymbol)
import Gopurs.Printer (printGoFile)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco (TcoExpr(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.FreeVars (localId)
import Gopurs.ThunkFusion (optimizeThunkProducers)
import Gopurs.FunctionFusion (optimizeFunctionProducers)
import Gopurs.ListFusion as ListFusion
import Gopurs.ListProgressionFold as ListProgressionFold
import Gopurs.ImmediateApplications (optimizeImmediateApplications)
import Gopurs.RegexMatchProjection as RegexMatchProjection
import Gopurs.Ownership as Ownership
import Gopurs.GoTypes (exprTypeToGoType)
import Gopurs.CodegenState (CodegenMetadata, CodegenState, FunctionInfo)
import Gopurs.GoConversions (boxGoExpr, coerceGoExpr, generateReboxFunctions)
import Gopurs.PrimitiveExprs as PrimitiveExprs
import Gopurs.RecordExprs as RecordExprs
import Gopurs.RecordReadGroups as RecordReadGroups
import Gopurs.ClosedIndexedFolds as ClosedIndexedFolds
import Gopurs.CodePointFold as CodePointFold
import Gopurs.AdtExprs as AdtExprs
import Gopurs.ConstructorExprs as ConstructorExprs
import Gopurs.LiteralExprs as LiteralExprs
import Gopurs.ArrayIntrinsics as ArrayIntrinsics
import Gopurs.ClosedDictionaries (cacheClosedDictionaries)
import Gopurs.ClosedScalar as ClosedScalar
import Gopurs.ConstructorFold as ConstructorFold
import Gopurs.BorrowedObjects (borrowReadOnlyObjects)
import Gopurs.RefLoopRegions as RefLoopRegions
import Gopurs.DecoderSchemas (specializeDecoderSchemas)
import Gopurs.CallExprs as CallExprs
import Gopurs.FunctionExprs as FunctionExprs
import Gopurs.BindingExprs as BindingExprs
import Gopurs.ControlExprs as ControlExprs
import Gopurs.EffectExprs as EffectExprs
import Gopurs.FfiBridge.ImmediateEffects as ImmediateEffects
import Gopurs.TypedExprs as TypedExprs
import Gopurs.ModuleBindings as ModuleBindings
import Gopurs.ModuleDeclarations as ModuleDeclarations
import Gopurs.GoImports (collectImports)
import Gopurs.ExprAnalysis (getExprType, isEffectNode)
import Gopurs.ExprContext (ModuleFunctions, StmtTree(..), TranslateExpr, childContext)

translate :: CodegenMetadata -> BackendModule -> String
translate metadata inputMod = (translateWithFunctions metadata inputMod).code

translateWithFunctions :: CodegenMetadata -> BackendModule -> { code :: String, functions :: ModuleFunctions, file :: GoFile }
translateWithFunctions metadata inputMod = translatePreparedWithFunctions metadata (prepareModule metadata inputMod)

type PreparedModule =
  { module :: BackendModule
  , declarations :: Array GoDecl
  , functions :: ModuleFunctions
  , workers :: Map.Map String (Maybe FunctionInfo)
  }

-- These transformations consume source metadata, not imported worker signatures
-- or module-local FFI signatures. Prepare once, before computing the emission
-- key, so references introduced by a transformation belong to its proof too.
prepareModule :: CodegenMetadata -> BackendModule -> PreparedModule
prepareModule metadata inputMod =
  let
    projected = ListFusion.optimize (RegexMatchProjection.optimize metadata (CodePointFold.optimize (ClosedIndexedFolds.optimize inputMod)))
    progressions = ListProgressionFold.prepare projected
    constants = ClosedScalar.optimize (RefLoopRegions.optimize progressions.module)
    constructors = ConstructorFold.optimize constants
    schemas = specializeDecoderSchemas metadata (borrowReadOnlyObjects metadata (cacheClosedDictionaries metadata (optimizeImmediateApplications (optimizeFunctionProducers (optimizeThunkProducers constructors)))))
    owned = Ownership.prepare metadata schemas.module
  in
    { module: owned.module
    , declarations: owned.declarations <> schemas.declarations <> progressions.declarations
    , functions: Map.union owned.functions progressions.functions
    , workers: workerInputs metadata.globalFunctions owned.module
    }

-- Imported ordinary and immediate-effect workers use qualified Var targets;
-- local targets use the module's
-- own signatures. Include every such Var, even if it is not called, and record
-- absences in the exact batch snapshot. TCO preserves these qualifications.
workerInputs :: ModuleFunctions -> BackendModule -> Map.Map String (Maybe FunctionInfo)
workerInputs available = foldWorkerReferences
  (\owner name acc -> foldl
    (\entries ident -> let key = unwrap owner <> "." <> ident in Map.insert key (Map.lookup key available) entries)
    acc [ name, ImmediateEffects.key name ])
  Map.empty

-- The emitter can resolve immutable owner contributions without decoding every
-- earlier module's signatures. Keep the exact qualified-Var inventory shared
-- with workerInputs, including FFI targets and references introduced by passes.
workerOwners :: BackendModule -> Set.Set String
workerOwners = foldWorkerReferences (\owner _ -> Set.insert (unwrap owner)) Set.empty

-- Conservative requests are collected explicitly by the emitter. They do not
-- need to be complete: LookupTable checks coverage on every actual lookup.
globalTypeDemands :: BackendModule -> Set.Set String
globalTypeDemands mod = foldl
  (\acc group -> foldl (\entries (Tuple _ value) -> visit entries value) acc group.bindings)
  (Set.fromFoldable
    [ "Data.Argonaut.Decode.Internal.Record.schemaDecoderABI1"
    , "Data.Argonaut.Decode.Parser.textDecoderABI1"
    , "Data.Argonaut.Decode.Internal.Record.borrowObject"
    , RegexMatchProjection.helperName
    , RegexMatchProjection.adapterName
    ]) mod.bindings
  where
  visit acc (NeutralExpr syntax) = case syntax of
    Var (Qualified (Just owner) (Ident name)) -> Set.insert (unwrap owner <> "." <> name) acc
    _ -> foldl visit acc syntax

foldWorkerReferences :: forall a. (CoreFn.ModuleName -> String -> a -> a) -> a -> BackendModule -> a
foldWorkerReferences insert initial mod = foldl
  (\acc group -> foldl (\entries (Tuple _ value) -> visit entries value) acc group.bindings)
  initial
  mod.bindings
  where
  visit acc (NeutralExpr syntax) = case syntax of
    Var (Qualified (Just owner) (Ident name)) | owner /= mod.name ->
      insert owner name acc
    _ -> foldl visit acc syntax

-- Source metadata must be the same as at preparation. Output supplies the
-- freshly parsed local FFI signatures here. Restrict imported signatures to
-- exactly the snapshot covered by the emission key, including on fresh builds.
translatePreparedWithFunctions :: CodegenMetadata -> PreparedModule -> { code :: String, functions :: ModuleFunctions, file :: GoFile }
translatePreparedWithFunctions sourceMetadata prepared =
  let
    metadata = sourceMetadata { globalFunctions = Map.mapMaybe identity prepared.workers }
    mod = prepared.module
    modNameStrOrig = unwrap mod.name
    modNameStr = String.replaceAll (Pattern ".") (Replacement "_") modNameStrOrig

    codegenStateRef :: Ref CodegenState
    codegenStateRef = unsafePerformEffect $
      Ref.new { declarations: ModuleDeclarations.constructors metadata modNameStr mod, globalId: 0, reboxPairs: Set.empty }

    preparedBindings = ModuleBindings.prepare metadata modNameStr mod
    -- The module's FFI functions are keyed by raw identifier; local functions
    -- take precedence when names collide.
    -- Reserved immediate-effect signatures must never become ordinary local
    -- calls after sanitizing their otherwise impossible PureScript names.
    ffiLocalFunctions = Map.fromFoldable $ Array.mapMaybe
      (\(Tuple (Ident name) _) -> map (Tuple (sanitizeName name)) (Map.lookup name metadata.ffiFunctions))
      (Map.toUnfoldable mod.foreign)
    foldDescriptors = Map.fromFoldable (Array.concatMap (\group -> if group.recursive then [] else
      map (\(Tuple (Ident name) value) -> Tuple (sanitizeName name) (ClosedIndexedFolds.describe value)) group.bindings) mod.bindings)
    describedFunctions = Map.fromFoldable (map (\(Tuple name info) -> Tuple name (info { arrayFold = if info.fArgs == [ TypeNativeArray TypeInt64 ] && info.fRet == TypeInt64 && info.arity == 1 then fromMaybe Nothing (Map.lookup name foldDescriptors) else Nothing })) (Map.toUnfoldable preparedBindings.functions :: Array (Tuple String FunctionInfo)))
    moduleFunctions = Map.union (Map.union prepared.functions describedFunctions) ffiLocalFunctions
    normalFunctions = Map.fromFoldable $ Array.concatMap
      (\group -> Array.mapMaybe
        (\(Tuple (Ident name) _) -> do
          info <- Map.lookup (sanitizeName name) moduleFunctions
          guard (info.arity >= 1 && info.arity <= 10)
          pure (Tuple (unwrap mod.name <> "." <> name) info))
        group.bindings)
      preparedBindings.bindings
    -- Export FFI functions as `<Module>.<ident>` for callers in other modules.
    ffiGlobalFunctions = Map.fromFoldable $ map
      (\(Tuple name info) -> Tuple (unwrap mod.name <> "." <> name) info)
      (Map.toUnfoldable metadata.ffiFunctions :: Array (Tuple String FunctionInfo))

    Tuple allDeclsAst helpers = unsafePerformEffect do
      let
        d = ModuleBindings.declarations translateExpr metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr moduleFunctions preparedBindings.bindings
      h <- Ref.read codegenStateRef
      pure (Tuple d h)

    foreignGetters = map
      (\(Tuple (Ident name) _) -> GoForeignGetter
        { name: generated modNameStr ("Get_" <> modNameStr <> "_" <> sanitizeName name)
        , value: foreignSymbol modNameStr ("_Gopurs_" <> modNameStr <> "_" <> capitalize (sanitizeName name))
        })
      (Map.toUnfoldable mod.foreign)
    declarationGroups = map (map RecordReadGroups.declaration)
      [ allDeclsAst <> prepared.declarations
      , helpers.declarations <> unsafePerformEffect (generateReboxFunctions metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr)
      , foreignGetters
      ]
    goFile = { packageName: "purescript", imports: collectImports declarationGroups, declarationGroups }

  in
    { code: printGoFile goFile
    , functions: Map.union normalFunctions ffiGlobalFunctions
    , file: goFile
    }

translateExpr :: TranslateExpr
translateExpr context@{ metadata, codegenStateRef, modNameStr, bound, options: { inEffectBlock }, mbExpectedExprType } nextId tcoExpr@(TcoExpr _ expr) =
  let
    child = childContext context Nothing
    isEff = isEffectNode tcoExpr
  in
    if isEff && not inEffectBlock then
      EffectExprs.wrap translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr
    else
      case expr of
        Typed type_ a ->
          TypedExprs.annotated translateExpr context nextId type_ a
        Var (Qualified mbMn (Ident i)) ->
          let
            safeName = sanitizeName i
            vType = case mbMn of
              Just mn ->
                let
                  modStr = unwrap mn
                in
                  case LookupTable.lookup (modStr <> "." <> i) metadata.globalTypes of
                    Just ty -> exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr ty
                    Nothing -> TypeValue
              Nothing -> TypeValue
          in
            case mbMn of
              Just mn ->
                let
                  modStr = unwrap mn
                  modPkg = String.replaceAll (Pattern ".") (Replacement "_") modStr
                  rawCall = GoCall (GoRef (SymbolReference (generated modPkg ("Get_" <> modPkg <> "_" <> safeName)))) []
                in
                  { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr rawCall TypeValue vType, exprType: vType, nextId }
              Nothing ->
                let
                  rawCall = GoCall (GoRef (SymbolReference (generated modNameStr ("Get_" <> modNameStr <> "_" <> safeName)))) []
                in
                  { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr rawCall TypeValue vType, exprType: vType, nextId }

        Local mbIdent lvl ->
          let
            v = fromMaybe { name: localId mbIdent lvl, goType: TypeValue } (Map.lookup (localId mbIdent lvl) bound)
          in
            { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: GoVar v.name, exprType: v.goType, nextId }

        Lit value
          | Just result <- PrimitiveExprs.literal value ->
              { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId }

        Lit (LitArray xs) ->
          LiteralExprs.array translateExpr context nextId xs

        Lit (LitRecord props) ->
          LiteralExprs.record translateExpr context nextId (getExprType tcoExpr) props

        expr_
          | ( case expr_ of
                App _ _ -> true
                Syn.TypeApp _ _ -> true
                _ -> false
            ) ->
              CallExprs.application translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr

        Abs args body ->
          FunctionExprs.abstraction translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr args body

        UncurriedApp fn args ->
          CallExprs.uncurriedApplication translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr fn args

        UncurriedAbs args body ->
          FunctionExprs.uncurriedAbstraction translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr args body

        UncurriedEffectApp fn args ->
          CallExprs.effectApplication translateExpr context nextId fn args

        UncurriedEffectAbs args body ->
          FunctionExprs.effectAbstraction translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr args body

        EffectBind mbIdent lvl binding body ->
          EffectExprs.bindEffect translateExpr context nextId mbIdent lvl binding body

        EffectPure binding ->
          EffectExprs.pureValue translateExpr context nextId binding

        EffectDefer binding ->
          EffectExprs.defer translateExpr context nextId binding

        Let mbIdent lvl binding body ->
          BindingExprs.nonRecursive translateExpr context nextId mbIdent lvl binding body

        LetRec lvl bindings body ->
          BindingExprs.recursive translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr lvl bindings body

        Accessor obj accessor ->
          let
            resObj = translateExpr child nextId obj
          in
            case accessor of
              GetProp prop ->
                let
                  result = RecordExprs.getProp metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr prop { expr: resObj.expr, exprType: resObj.exprType }
                in
                  { stmts: resObj.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: resObj.nextId }
              GetIndex idx -> { stmts: resObj.stmts, expr: GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "ArrayAccess") [ (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resObj.expr resObj.exprType), GoInt idx ], exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resObj.nextId }
              GetCtorField (Qualified mbMod _) _ _ (Ident ctorName) _ idx ->
                let
                  result = AdtExprs.getField metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr
                    { moduleName: mbMod, ctorName, index: idx }
                    { expr: resObj.expr, exprType: resObj.exprType, sourceType: getExprType obj }
                in
                  { stmts: resObj.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: resObj.nextId }

        Update obj props ->
          let
            resObj = translateExpr child nextId obj
            accProps = foldl
              ( \acc (Prop key val) ->
                  let
                    resVal = translateExpr child acc.nextId val
                  in
                    { stmts: acc.stmts <> resVal.stmts, exprs: Array.snoc acc.exprs { key, expr: resVal.expr, goType: resVal.exprType }, exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resVal.nextId }
              )
              { stmts: StmtEmpty, exprs: [], exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resObj.nextId }
              props
            resultType = map (exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr) mbExpectedExprType
            result = RecordExprs.update codegenStateRef modNameStr resultType { expr: resObj.expr, exprType: resObj.exprType } accProps.exprs
          in
            { stmts: resObj.stmts <> accProps.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: accProps.nextId }

        CtorDef _ _ (Ident name) fields ->
          ConstructorExprs.definition context nextId tcoExpr name fields

        CtorSaturated (Qualified mbMod _) _ _ (Ident name) props ->
          ConstructorExprs.saturated translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr mbMod name props

        Fail msg ->
          ControlExprs.failure context nextId tcoExpr msg

        Branch branches def ->
          ControlExprs.branch translateExpr context nextId branches def

        PrimOp (Op1 op1 e)
          | Just emit <- PrimitiveExprs.unary codegenStateRef modNameStr op1 ->
              let
                resE = translateExpr child nextId e
                result = emit { expr: resE.expr, exprType: resE.exprType }
              in
                { stmts: resE.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: resE.nextId }

        PrimOp (Op1 (OpIsTag (Qualified mbMod (Ident tag))) e) ->
          let
            -- A pointer ADT's tag is independent of its type arguments. Keep
            -- the operand's representation: coercing a boxed List here would
            -- copy its entire tail merely to distinguish Nil from Cons.
            translateOperand expected operand@(TcoExpr _ syntax) =
              case syntax of
                Typed type_ inner
                  | TypeStructPointer _ <- exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr type_ ->
                      translateOperand (Just type_) inner
                _ ->
                  translateExpr (child { mbExpectedExprType = expected }) nextId operand
            resE = translateOperand Nothing e
          in
            AdtExprs.isTag metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr mbMod tag resE

        PrimOp (Op1 OpArrayLength e) ->
          let
            resE = translateExpr child nextId e
          in
            case resE.exprType of
              TypeNativeArray _ -> { stmts: resE.stmts, expr: GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Int") [ GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoCall (GoVar "len") [ resE.expr ] ] ], exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resE.nextId }
              _ -> { stmts: resE.stmts, expr: GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Int") [ GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "ArrayLength") [ boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resE.expr resE.exprType ] ] ], exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resE.nextId }

        PrimOp (Op2 OpBooleanAnd e1 e2) ->
          ControlExprs.booleanAnd translateExpr context nextId e1 e2

        PrimOp (Op2 OpBooleanOr e1 e2) ->
          ControlExprs.booleanOr translateExpr context nextId e1 e2

        PrimOp (Op2 OpArrayIndex e1 e2) ->
          ArrayIntrinsics.unsafeIndex translateExpr context nextId e1 e2

        PrimOp (Op2 op2 e1 e2)
          | Just result <- PrimitiveExprs.stringLengthComparison translateExpr context nextId op2 e1 e2 ->
              result

        PrimOp (Op2 op2 e1 e2)
          | Just result <- PrimitiveExprs.boundedIntProduct translateExpr context nextId op2 e1 e2 ->
              result
          | Just result <- PrimitiveExprs.guardedIntProduct translateExpr context nextId op2 e1 e2 ->
              result
          | Just result <- PrimitiveExprs.powerOfTwoModulo translateExpr context nextId op2 e1 e2 ->
              result

        PrimOp (Op2 op2 e1 e2)
          | Just emit <- PrimitiveExprs.binary codegenStateRef modNameStr op2 ->
              let
                res1 = translateExpr child nextId e1
                res2 = translateExpr child res1.nextId e2
                result = emit { expr: res1.expr, exprType: res1.exprType } { expr: res2.expr, exprType: res2.exprType }
              in
                { stmts: res1.stmts <> res2.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: res2.nextId }

        PrimEffect eff ->
          EffectExprs.primitive translateExpr context nextId eff

        _ -> { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: GoVar "gopurs_runtime.Value{}", exprType: TypeValue, nextId }

module Gopurs.CodePointFold (optimize, emit) where

import Prelude

import Control.Alternative (guard)
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Array.NonEmpty as NEA
import Data.Foldable (all, foldM)
import Data.Map as Map
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..), fromMaybe, isJust)
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..))
import Gopurs.ArrayIndexedFold (readOnlyScalar)
import Gopurs.CallAnalysis (collectCurriedAbs, collectGoSpine, getGoSpineArgs, qualifiedTarget)
import Gopurs.CallArguments as CallArguments
import Gopurs.ExprAnalysis (unwrapTcoExpr)
import Gopurs.ExprContext (ExprContext, ExprResult, StmtTree(..), TranslateExpr, bindParameters, childContext, flattenStmts)
import Gopurs.GoAst (GoExpr(..), GoType(..), rawGo)
import Gopurs.GoConversions (coerceGoExpr)
import Gopurs.GoTypes (appliedAdt)
import Gopurs.ImmediateApplications.Scope (maximumLevel)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco as Tco
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Convert (BackendModule)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (ExprType(Any, Array, Func, Int, String, ADT, TypeVar), Ident(..), Literal(..), ModuleName(..), Qualified(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.FreeVars (localId)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Semantics (NeutralExpr(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendSyntax(..), Level(..))

-- Expose only a closed primitive fold composed with the canonical conversion.
-- Its callback and literal seed have no creation effects to postpone. Running
-- before worker discovery also puts the new signature in the usual cache key.
optimize :: BackendModule -> BackendModule
optimize mod = mod { bindings = map (\group -> if group.recursive then group else
  group { bindings = map (\(Tuple name value) -> Tuple name (fromMaybe value (expand value))) group.bindings }) mod.bindings }

expand :: NeutralExpr -> Maybe NeutralExpr
expand original = do
  guard (compatible (Func [ String ] Int) original)
  let composition = application original
  guard (namedN "Control.Semigroupoid" "compose" composition.head)
  Tuple folder conversion <- case composition.args of
    [ dictionary, folder, conversion ] | namedN "Control.Semigroupoid" "semigroupoidFn" dictionary -> Just (Tuple folder conversion)
    _ -> Nothing
  guard (namedN "Data.String.CodePoints" "toCodePointArray" conversion)
  guard (compatible (Func [ String ] (Array Int)) conversion && compatible (Func [ Array Int ] Int) folder)
  let folding = application folder
  guard (namedN "Data.Foldable" "foldlArray" folding.head)
  Tuple callback seed <- case folding.args of
    [ callback, seed ] -> Just (Tuple callback seed)
    _ -> Nothing
  guard (compatible Int seed && case strip seed of
    Lit (LitInt _) -> true
    _ -> false)
  guard (closed [] callback && isJust (primitiveCallback (Tco.analyze [] callback)))
  let
    level = Level (maximumLevel original + 1)
    name = Just (Ident "__gopurs_codepoint_input")
    input = NeutralExpr (Typed String (NeutralExpr (Local name level)))
    converted = NeutralExpr (Typed (Array Int) (NeutralExpr (App conversion (NEA.singleton input))))
    result = NeutralExpr (Typed Int (NeutralExpr (App folding.head (NEA.cons' callback [ seed, converted ]))))
  pure (NeutralExpr (Typed (Func [ String ] Int) (NeutralExpr (Abs (NEA.singleton (Tuple name level)) result))))

-- The only removed allocation belongs to an immediately consumed, canonical
-- conversion of an immutable string. Decoding is total; callback invocation
-- order and each Int operation remain unchanged. Unknown callbacks keep the
-- ordinary array path, even when their annotations claim a pure function.
emit :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> Tco.TcoExpr -> Array Tco.TcoExpr -> Maybe ExprResult
emit translate context nextId fn args = do
  guard (named "Data.Foldable" "foldlArray" fn && Array.null context.recVars)
  Tuple callback (Tuple seed converted) <- case args of
    [ callback, seed, converted ] -> Just (Tuple callback (Tuple seed converted))
    _ -> Nothing
  let Tuple conversion spine = collectGoSpine converted
  guard (named "Data.String.CodePoints" "toCodePointArray" conversion)
  guard (compatibleT (Func [ String ] (Array Int)) conversion)
  input <- case getGoSpineArgs spine of
    [ input ] -> Just input
    _ -> Nothing
  grouped <- primitiveCallback callback
  guard (compatibleT Int seed && compatibleT String input && compatibleT (Array Int) converted)
  let
    params = map (\(Tuple name level) -> Tuple (localId name level) TypeInt64) (NEA.toArray grouped.args)
    callbackContext = context
      { depth = context.depth + 1, bound = bindParameters params context.bound
      , tcoIdent = Nothing, loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: true, inEffectBlock: false }
      , mbExpectedExprType = Just Int, mbExpectedGoType = Just TypeInt64 }
    capture index currentId value = if index == 0 then
      let callbackBody = translate callbackContext currentId grouped.body
      in { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: GoFuncLit params (flattenStmts callbackBody.stmts) (integer callbackBody.expr callbackBody.exprType) TypeInt64
         , exprType: TypeFunc [ TypeInt64, TypeInt64 ] TypeInt64, nextId: callbackBody.nextId }
      else translate (childContext context Nothing) currentId value
    captured = CallArguments.capture { prefix: "codePointFold_arg_", markUsed: true } capture nextId [ callback, seed, input ]
    arg index = fromMaybe (rawGo "nil") (Array.index captured.exprs index)
    argType index = fromMaybe TypeValue (Array.index captured.exprTypes index)
    str = coerceGoExpr context.codegenStateRef context.modNameStr (arg 2) (argType 2) TypeString
    body =
      [ GoAssign "codePointFold_input" str
      , GoAssign "codePointFold_result" (integer (arg 1) (argType 1))
      , GoForRange "codePointFold_offset := 0; codePointFold_offset < len(codePointFold_input);"
          [ GoAssign "codePointFold_value" (GoCall (GoVar "rune")
              [ GoIndex (GoVar "codePointFold_input") (GoVar "codePointFold_offset") ])
          , GoAssign "codePointFold_width" (GoInt 1)
          -- ASCII is exactly one code point of width one. Keep the more
          -- complex decoder off this common path; every other byte retains
          -- the complete UTF-8/WTF-8 and replacement-character semantics.
          , GoIfElse (GoBinOp ">=" (GoVar "codePointFold_value") (GoInt 128))
              [ GoMutate "codePointFold_value, codePointFold_width"
                  (GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "DecodeStringCodePoint") [ rawGo "codePointFold_input[codePointFold_offset:]" ]) ] []
          , GoMutate "codePointFold_result" (GoCall (arg 0)
              [ GoVar "codePointFold_result", GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoVar "codePointFold_value" ] ])
          , GoMutate "codePointFold_offset" (GoBinOp "+" (GoVar "codePointFold_offset") (GoVar "codePointFold_width"))
          ]
      ]
  pure { stmts: captured.stmts, expr: GoCall (GoFuncLit [] body (GoVar "codePointFold_result") TypeInt64) []
       , exprType: TypeInt64, nextId: captured.nextId }
  where
  integer expression from = coerceGoExpr context.codegenStateRef context.modNameStr expression from TypeInt64

primitiveCallback :: Tco.TcoExpr -> Maybe { args :: NEA.NonEmptyArray (Tuple (Maybe Ident) Level), body :: Tco.TcoExpr }
primitiveCallback callback = do
  guard (lambdaCompatible [ Int, Int ] callback)
  case unwrapTcoExpr callback of
    Abs args body -> do
      let grouped = collectCurriedAbs args body
      guard (NEA.length grouped.args == 2)
      guard (readOnlyScalar (map (\(Tuple _ level) -> level) (NEA.toArray grouped.args)) grouped.body)
      pure grouped
    _ -> Nothing

-- Each adjacent lambda may carry a TAST suffix. Checking only the outer
-- annotation would miss a contradictory type on the second parameter.
lambdaCompatible :: Array ExprType -> Tco.TcoExpr -> Boolean
lambdaCompatible arguments expression =
  compatibleT (if Array.null arguments then Int else Func arguments Int) expression &&
    if Array.null arguments then true else case unwrapTcoExpr expression of
      Abs parameters body -> NEA.length parameters <= Array.length arguments &&
        lambdaCompatible (Array.drop (NEA.length parameters) arguments) body
      _ -> false

named :: String -> String -> Tco.TcoExpr -> Boolean
named moduleName name expression = case qualifiedTarget expression of
  Just target -> target.mbMod == Just (ModuleName moduleName) && target.name == name
  Nothing -> false

namedN :: String -> String -> NeutralExpr -> Boolean
namedN moduleName name value = case strip value of
  Var (Qualified (Just (ModuleName owner)) (Ident identifier)) -> owner == moduleName && identifier == name
  _ -> false

application :: NeutralExpr -> { head :: NeutralExpr, args :: Array NeutralExpr }
application value = case strip value of
  App fn args -> let prior = application fn in { head: prior.head, args: prior.args <> NEA.toArray args }
  _ -> { head: value, args: [] }

-- Residual generic annotations may wrap the instantiated TAST. Require every
-- wrapper to admit the same specialization, never overwrite a concrete type.
compatible :: ExprType -> NeutralExpr -> Boolean
compatible expected (NeutralExpr syntax) = case syntax of
  Typed actual value -> isJust (refine expected actual Map.empty) && compatible expected value
  TypeApp value _ -> compatible expected value
  _ -> true

compatibleT :: ExprType -> Tco.TcoExpr -> Boolean
compatibleT expected (Tco.TcoExpr _ syntax) = case syntax of
  Typed actual value -> isJust (refine expected actual Map.empty) && compatibleT expected value
  TypeApp value _ -> compatibleT expected value
  _ -> true

refine :: ExprType -> ExprType -> Map.Map String ExprType -> Maybe (Map.Map String ExprType)
refine expected supplied variables = case normalize supplied, expected of
  Any, _ -> Just variables
  TypeVar name, _ -> case Map.lookup name variables of
    Just previous | previous /= expected -> Nothing
    _ -> Just (Map.insert name expected variables)
  Array element, Array wanted -> refine wanted element variables
  ADT "Prim.Array" [ "Prim", "Array" ] [ element ], Array wanted -> refine wanted element variables
  Func arguments result, Func wantedArguments wantedResult -> do
    let actualSignature = arrows arguments result
        wantedSignature = arrows wantedArguments wantedResult
    guard (Array.length actualSignature.args == Array.length wantedSignature.args)
    foldM (\known (Tuple wanted argument) -> refine wanted argument known) variables
      (Array.snoc (Array.zip wantedSignature.args actualSignature.args) (Tuple wantedSignature.result actualSignature.result))
  actual, _ | actual == expected -> Just variables
  _, _ -> Nothing
  where
  arrows args result = case normalize result of
    Func more remaining -> arrows (args <> more) remaining
    normalized -> { args, result: normalized }

-- The TAST also spells instantiated function/array constructors through
-- TypeApp. These are the same concrete types, not permission to erase an
-- incompatible wrapper or to reinterpret a user ADT with a similar name.
normalize :: ExprType -> ExprType
normalize ty = case appliedAdt ty of
  Just { fullName: "Prim.Function", path: [ "Prim", "Function" ], args: [ argument, result ] } -> Func [ argument ] result
  Just { fullName: "Prim.Array", path: [ "Prim", "Array" ], args: [ element ] } -> Array element
  _ -> ty

closed :: Array Level -> NeutralExpr -> Boolean
closed locals expression = case strip expression of
  Local _ level -> Array.elem level locals
  Var _ -> false
  Abs parameters body -> closed (locals <> map (\(Tuple _ level) -> level) (NEA.toArray parameters)) body
  Let _ level value body -> closed locals value && closed (Array.snoc locals level) body
  LetRec _ _ _ -> false
  syntax -> all (closed locals) syntax

strip :: NeutralExpr -> BackendSyntax NeutralExpr
strip (NeutralExpr syntax) = case syntax of
  Typed _ expression -> strip expression
  TypeApp expression _ -> strip expression
  _ -> syntax

module Gopurs.ControlExprs
  ( failure
  , branch
  , booleanAnd
  , booleanOr
  ) where

import Prelude
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Array.NonEmpty (NonEmptyArray, toArray)
import Data.Foldable (foldl)
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..), fromMaybe)
import Gopurs.ExprAnalysis (getExprType, unwrapTcoExpr)
import Gopurs.ExprContext (ExprContext, ExprResult, TranslateExpr, StmtTree(..), flattenStmts)
import Gopurs.GoAst (rawGo, GoExpr(..), GoType(..), goTypeToStr)
import Gopurs.GoConversions (coerceGoExpr, unboxGoExpr)
import Gopurs.GoTypes (exprTypeToGoType)
import Gopurs.Printer (printGoExpr)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco (TcoExpr)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (ExprType(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendSyntax(Fail), Pair(..))

failure :: ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> String -> ExprResult
failure { metadata, modNameStr, mbExpectedExprType, mbExpectedGoType } nextId tcoExpr msg =
  let
    expectedGoType = fromMaybe inferredGoType mbExpectedGoType
    inferredGoType = exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr
      ( case getExprType tcoExpr of
          Any -> fromMaybe Any mbExpectedExprType
          ty -> ty
      )
    expectedGoTypeStr = goTypeToStr expectedGoType
  in
    { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: rawGo ("func() " <> expectedGoTypeStr <> " { panic(" <> printGoExpr (GoString msg) <> ") }()"), exprType: expectedGoType, nextId }

branch :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> NonEmptyArray (Pair TcoExpr) -> TcoExpr -> ExprResult
branch translate context@{ codegenStateRef, depth, modNameStr, mbExpectedGoType, options: { isTail } } nextId branches def =
  let
    resDef = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), tcoIdent = Nothing, options = { isTail, inEffectBlock: false } }) nextId def

    computedBranches = foldl
      ( \acc (Pair condExpr bodyExpr) ->
          let
            resCond = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), tcoIdent = Nothing, loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) acc.nextId condExpr
            resBody = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), tcoIdent = Nothing, options = { isTail, inEffectBlock: false } }) resCond.nextId bodyExpr
          in
            { nextId: resBody.nextId, results: acc.results <> [ { cond: resCond, body: resBody } ] }
      )
      { nextId: resDef.nextId, results: [] }
      (toArray branches)

    isFailNode = case unwrapTcoExpr def of
      Fail _ -> true
      _ -> false

    allTypes = (if isFailNode then [] else [ resDef.exprType ]) <> map (\r -> r.body.exprType) computedBranches.results

    hasTypeValue = Array.any
      ( \t -> case t of
          TypeValue -> true
          _ -> false
      )
      allTypes

    -- The consumer fixes the join representation when its ABI is known.
    -- Generic branches adapt at their exit; native branches then avoid a
    -- structural box/unbox round trip through the shared result slot.
    expectedGoType = fromMaybe inferredGoType mbExpectedGoType

    inferredGoType =
      if hasTypeValue then TypeValue
      else
        let
          nubbed = Array.nub (map goTypeToStr allTypes)
        in
          if Array.length nubbed == 1 then fromMaybe TypeValue (Array.head allTypes)
          else TypeValue

    tmpVar = "__t" <> show computedBranches.nextId
    declTmp = StmtLeaf (rawGo ("var " <> tmpVar <> " " <> goTypeToStr expectedGoType))
    labelName = "end_branch_" <> show computedBranches.nextId

    buildIfs = foldl
      ( \acc r ->
          let
            goIf = GoIfElse (unboxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr r.cond.expr r.cond.exprType TypeBool) (flattenStmts r.body.stmts <> [ GoMutate tmpVar (coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr r.body.expr r.body.exprType expectedGoType), rawGo ("goto " <> labelName) ]) []
          in
            acc <> StmtLeaf (rawGo "{") <> r.cond.stmts <> StmtLeaf goIf <> StmtLeaf (rawGo "}")
      )
      StmtEmpty
      computedBranches.results
  in
    { stmts: declTmp <> buildIfs <> StmtLeaf (rawGo "{") <> resDef.stmts <> StmtLeaf (GoMutate tmpVar (coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resDef.expr resDef.exprType expectedGoType)) <> StmtLeaf (rawGo "}") <> StmtLeaf (rawGo (labelName <> ":")), expr: GoVar tmpVar, exprType: expectedGoType, nextId: computedBranches.nextId + 1 }

booleanAnd :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> TcoExpr -> ExprResult
booleanAnd translate context@{ codegenStateRef, depth, modNameStr } nextId e1 e2 =
  let
    res1 = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), tcoIdent = Nothing, loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) nextId e1
    res2 = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), tcoIdent = Nothing, loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) res1.nextId e2
  in
    if isEmptyStmts res2.stmts then
      { expr: GoBinOp "&&" (unboxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr res1.expr res1.exprType TypeBool) (unboxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr res2.expr res2.exprType TypeBool), exprType: TypeBool, stmts: res1.stmts <> res2.stmts, nextId: res2.nextId }
    else
      let
        tmpVar = "__t_and_" <> show res2.nextId
        declTmp = StmtLeaf (rawGo ("var " <> tmpVar <> " bool = false\nif " <> printGoExpr (unboxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr res1.expr res1.exprType TypeBool) <> " {\n"))
        assignTmp = StmtLeaf (rawGo (tmpVar <> " = " <> printGoExpr (unboxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr res2.expr res2.exprType TypeBool) <> "\n}"))
      in
        { expr: rawGo tmpVar, exprType: TypeBool, stmts: res1.stmts <> declTmp <> res2.stmts <> assignTmp, nextId: res2.nextId + 1 }

booleanOr :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> TcoExpr -> ExprResult
booleanOr translate context@{ codegenStateRef, depth, modNameStr } nextId e1 e2 =
  let
    res1 = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), tcoIdent = Nothing, loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) nextId e1
    res2 = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), tcoIdent = Nothing, loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) res1.nextId e2
  in
    if isEmptyStmts res2.stmts then
      { expr: GoBinOp "||" (unboxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr res1.expr res1.exprType TypeBool) (unboxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr res2.expr res2.exprType TypeBool), exprType: TypeBool, stmts: res1.stmts <> res2.stmts, nextId: res2.nextId }
    else
      let
        tmpVar = "__t_or_" <> show res2.nextId
        declTmp = StmtLeaf (rawGo ("var " <> tmpVar <> " bool = true\nif !(" <> printGoExpr (unboxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr res1.expr res1.exprType TypeBool) <> ") {\n"))
        assignTmp = StmtLeaf (rawGo (tmpVar <> " = " <> printGoExpr (unboxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr res2.expr res2.exprType TypeBool) <> "\n}"))
      in
        { expr: rawGo tmpVar, exprType: TypeBool, stmts: res1.stmts <> declTmp <> res2.stmts <> assignTmp, nextId: res2.nextId + 1 }

isEmptyStmts :: StmtTree -> Boolean
isEmptyStmts StmtEmpty = true
isEmptyStmts (StmtAppend s1 s2) = isEmptyStmts s1 && isEmptyStmts s2
isEmptyStmts _ = false

module Gopurs.EffectExprs
  ( bindEffect
  , pureValue
  , defer
  , primitive
  , wrap
  , wrapCachedInt
  ) where

import Prelude
import Control.Alternative (guard)
import Data.Map as Map
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..))
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..))
import Gopurs.ExprAnalysis (executeIfOpaque, getExprType, isEffectNode, unwrapTcoExpr)
import Gopurs.ExprContext (ExprContext, ExprResult, TranslateExpr, StmtTree(..), flattenStmts)
import Gopurs.GoAst (GoExpr(..), GoType(..))
import Gopurs.GoConversions (boxGoExpr)
import Gopurs.ImmediateFfiEffects as ImmediateFfiEffects
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco (TcoExpr(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (ExprType(..), Ident)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.FreeVars (localId)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendEffect(..), BackendSyntax(Abs, EffectDefer, Let, LetRec), Level)

bindEffect :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> Maybe Ident -> Level -> TcoExpr -> TcoExpr -> ExprResult
bindEffect translate context nextId mbIdent lvl binding body =
  case ImmediateFfiEffects.direct translate context nextId mbIdent lvl binding body of
    Just result -> result
    Nothing -> ordinaryBind translate context nextId mbIdent lvl binding body

ordinaryBind :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> Maybe Ident -> Level -> TcoExpr -> TcoExpr -> ExprResult
ordinaryBind translate context@{ codegenStateRef, depth, modNameStr, bound, options: { isTail } } nextId mbIdent lvl binding body =
  let
    stripEffectDefer (TcoExpr a syn) = case unwrapTcoExpr (TcoExpr a syn) of
      EffectDefer inner -> let Tuple _ i = stripEffectDefer inner in Tuple true i
      Abs _ inner -> let Tuple _ i = stripEffectDefer inner in Tuple true i
      Let ident lvl_ val body_ -> let Tuple stripped i = stripEffectDefer body_ in Tuple stripped (TcoExpr a (Let ident lvl_ val i))
      LetRec lvl_ bindings_ body_ -> let Tuple stripped i = stripEffectDefer body_ in Tuple stripped (TcoExpr a (LetRec lvl_ bindings_ i))
      _ -> Tuple false (TcoExpr a syn)
    Tuple wasStripped realBinding = stripEffectDefer binding
    originalName = localId mbIdent lvl
    name = originalName <> "_" <> show nextId
    newBound = Map.insert originalName { name, goType: TypeValue } bound
    resBinding = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), tcoIdent = Nothing, loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: true }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) (nextId + 1) realBinding
    resBody = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), bound = newBound, tcoIdent = Nothing, options = { isTail, inEffectBlock: true } }) resBinding.nextId body
    bindingExpr = if wasStripped then boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resBinding.expr resBinding.exprType else executeIfOpaque realBinding (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resBinding.expr resBinding.exprType)
    bodyExpr = executeIfOpaque body resBody.expr
  in
    { stmts: resBinding.stmts <> StmtLeaf (GoAssign name bindingExpr) <> resBody.stmts, expr: bodyExpr, exprType: resBody.exprType, nextId: resBody.nextId }

pureValue :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> ExprResult
pureValue translate context@{ depth } nextId binding =
  translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), tcoIdent = Nothing, loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) nextId binding

defer :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> ExprResult
defer translate context@{ codegenStateRef, depth, modNameStr } nextId binding =
  let
    resBinding = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), tcoIdent = Nothing, loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: true }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) nextId binding
    funcExpr = GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Func")
      [ GoFuncBlock [ Tuple "_" TypeValue ]
          (flattenStmts resBinding.stmts <> [ GoReturn (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resBinding.expr resBinding.exprType) ])
          TypeValue
      ]
  in
    { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: funcExpr, exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resBinding.nextId }

primitive :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> BackendEffect TcoExpr -> ExprResult
primitive translate context@{ codegenStateRef, depth, modNameStr } nextId eff =
  case eff of
  EffectRefNew a ->
    let
      resA = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), tcoIdent = Nothing, loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) nextId a
    in
      { stmts: resA.stmts
      , expr: GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "NewSTRef")
          [ boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resA.expr resA.exprType ]
      , exprType: TypeValue
      , nextId: resA.nextId + 1
      }
  EffectRefRead a ->
    let
      resA = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), tcoIdent = Nothing, loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) nextId a
    in
      { stmts: resA.stmts
      , expr: GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "ReadSTRef")
          [ boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resA.expr resA.exprType ]
      , exprType: TypeValue
      , nextId: resA.nextId
      }
  EffectRefWrite ref val ->
    let
      resRef = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), tcoIdent = Nothing, loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) nextId ref
      resVal = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), tcoIdent = Nothing, loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) resRef.nextId val
    in
      { stmts: resRef.stmts <> resVal.stmts
      , expr: GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "WriteSTRef")
          [ boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resRef.expr resRef.exprType
          , boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resVal.expr resVal.exprType
          ]
      , exprType: TypeValue
      , nextId: resVal.nextId
      }

wrap :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> ExprResult
wrap translate context nextId tcoExpr =
  let
    res = translate (context { options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: true }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) nextId tcoExpr
  in
    { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: boxedAction context res, exprType: TypeValue, nextId: res.nextId }

-- ModuleBindings calls this only for values initialized by a cached getter.
-- Match exactly the effect syntax wrap already defers: aliases, factories and
-- EffectDefer retain their existing construction/evaluation boundaries.
wrapCachedInt :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> Maybe ExprResult
wrapCachedInt translate context nextId expression = do
  case getExprType expression of
    ADT "Effect.Effect" _ [ Int ] -> pure unit
    _ -> Nothing
  guard (isEffectNode expression)
  let
    result = translate (context { options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: true }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) nextId expression
    -- Translate once, retaining the original boxed body as an independent
    -- entry point. Each invocation executes exactly one of these bodies.
    nativeResult = case result.exprType, result.expr of
      TypeInt64, value -> Just value
      TypeValue, GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Int") [ value ] -> Just value
      _, _ -> Nothing
    action = case nativeResult of
      Just value ->
        let native = GoFuncBlock [] (flattenStmts result.stmts <> [ GoReturn value ]) TypeInt64
        in GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "WithFunctionData") [ boxedAction context result, native ]
      -- Boxed dynamic results retain the FFI's complete Unbox semantics.
      -- Reuse this translation even when it cannot provide a native entry.
      Nothing -> boxedAction context result
  pure { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: action, exprType: TypeValue, nextId: result.nextId }

boxedAction :: ExprContext -> ExprResult -> GoExpr
boxedAction { codegenStateRef, modNameStr } result =
  GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Func")
    [ GoFuncBlock [ Tuple "_" TypeValue ]
        (flattenStmts result.stmts <> [ GoReturn (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr result.expr result.exprType) ])
        TypeValue
    ]

module Gopurs.FfiBridge.ImmediateEffects
  ( key
  , signature
  , worker
  ) where

import Prelude

import Control.Alternative (guard)
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..), fromMaybe)
import Data.String as String
import Gopurs.CodegenState (FunctionInfo)
import Gopurs.FfiBridge.Effects as Effects
import Gopurs.FfiBridge.TypeSupport (getTastArgType, tastForArity)
import Gopurs.FfiBridge.Values as Values
import Gopurs.FfiTypes (FfiDecl, TypeNode(..))
import Gopurs.GoAst (GoType(..), goTypeToStr)
import Gopurs.GoSymbol (GoReference(..), foreignSymbol)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (DataDecl, ExprType(..))

-- '$' cannot occur in a PureScript value identifier. Keep these signatures in
-- the existing worker table without making them ordinary callable bindings.
key :: String -> String
key name = "$gopursRunEffect$" <> name

type Candidate = { result :: ExprType, nativeResult :: Maybe TypeNode }

candidate :: FfiDecl -> ExprType -> Maybe Candidate
candidate declaration tast = do
  contract <- Effects.effectContract tast
  guard (contract.kind == "effect" && not declaration.isVar && Array.null declaration.typeParams)
  guard (Array.length declaration.args > 0 && Array.length declaration.args == Array.length contract.args)
  guard (Effects.problem declaration tast == Nothing)
  case declaration.ret, declaration.results of
    Just (TFunc [] result), [ _ ] -> Just { result: contract.result, nativeResult: result }
    _, _ -> Nothing

workerName :: FfiDecl -> String
workerName declaration = declaration.name <> "_runEffectWorker"

-- A polymorphic argument already crosses this native interface as Value.
-- Let the caller retain that conversion; Foreign and structured arguments
-- still need their ordinary bridge adaptation inside the worker.
argumentType :: ExprType -> Int -> TypeNode -> GoType
argumentType tast index native = case native, getTastArgType tast index of
  TNamed name, Just (TypeVar _) | name == "any" || name == "interface{}" -> TypeInterface "interface{}"
  _, _ -> TypeValue

signature :: String -> FfiDecl -> ExprType -> Maybe FunctionInfo
signature owner declaration tast = do
  _ <- candidate declaration tast
  let callTast = fromMaybe tast (tastForArity (Array.length declaration.args) tast)
  pure
    { arrayFold: Nothing, reference: SymbolReference (foreignSymbol owner (workerName declaration))
    , fArgs: Array.mapWithIndex (argumentType callTast) declaration.args
    , fRet: TypeValue
    , arity: Array.length declaration.args
    }

-- Only an immediately executed action uses this worker. Its original boxed
-- entry remains authoritative for saved actions and first-class functions.
-- The factory is still called before its thunk, and dynamic native results
-- retain Values.toValue's ordinary Box fallback (they need not be Value).
worker :: Array DataDecl -> FfiDecl -> ExprType -> Maybe String
worker dataDecls declaration tast = do
  c <- candidate declaration tast
  let
    callTast = fromMaybe tast (tastForArity (Array.length declaration.args) tast)
    params = String.joinWith ", " (Array.mapWithIndex (\i native -> "arg" <> show i <> " " <> goTypeToStr (argumentType callTast i native)) declaration.args)
    convert i native = case argumentType callTast i native of
      TypeInterface _ -> [ "go_arg" <> show i <> " := arg" <> show i ]
      _ -> Values.boxedArgument dataDecls (Just callTast) i native
    conversions = String.joinWith "\n" (Array.concat (Array.mapWithIndex convert declaration.args))
    args = String.joinWith ", " (Array.mapWithIndex (\i _ -> "go_arg" <> show i) declaration.args)
    result = case c.nativeResult of
      Nothing -> "go_action()\nreturn gopurs_runtime.Value{}"
      Just native -> "go_result := go_action()\nreturn " <> Values.toValue dataDecls native (Just c.result) "go_result"
  pure ("func " <> workerName declaration <> "(" <> params <> ") gopurs_runtime.Value {\n"
    <> conversions <> "\ngo_action := " <> declaration.name <> "(" <> args <> ")\n" <> result <> "\n}\n")

module Gopurs.FfiBridge.Signatures
  ( NativeCandidate
  , matchDeclaration
  , nativeCandidate
  , functionInfo
  , workerReturnsNative
  ) where

import Prelude

import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..))
import Data.String as String
import Data.String.Pattern (Pattern(..))
import Data.Traversable (traverse)
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..))
import Gopurs.CodegenState (FunctionInfo)
import Gopurs.FfiTypes (FfiDecl, TypeNode(..))
import Gopurs.FfiBridge.TypeSupport (isPointerNode)
import Gopurs.GoAst (GoType(..), capitalize)
import Gopurs.GoSymbol (GoReference(..), foreignSymbol)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (ExprType(..))

-- Worker generation and direct-call publication share this candidate. A
-- generated worker can still have an unsupported direct-call signature.
type NativeCandidate =
  { declaration :: FfiDecl
  , tast :: ExprType
  , requiresWorker :: Boolean
  , callName :: String
  }

matchDeclaration :: String -> Array FfiDecl -> String -> Maybe FfiDecl
matchDeclaration modNameStr decls pursName =
  let
    name = modNameStr <> "_" <> capitalize pursName
    findDecl n = Array.find (\d -> d.name == n) decls
  in
    case findDecl name of
      Just d -> Just d
      Nothing -> findDecl (name <> "_")

nativeCandidate :: FfiDecl -> ExprType -> Maybe NativeCandidate
nativeCandidate declaration tast
  -- The generic boxed entry instantiates its type parameters explicitly.
  -- Direct pointer adapters must not emit an uninstantiated Go function.
  | not (Array.null declaration.typeParams)
      && (Array.any isPointerNode declaration.args || case declaration.ret of
        Just result -> isPointerNode result
        Nothing -> false) = Nothing
  | Array.length declaration.results <= 1 && not (Array.any containsStruct (declaration.args <> declaration.results)) && not (mentionsForeign tast) && isPureConcreteResult tast && not declaration.isVar && Array.length declaration.args >= 1 =
      let
        requiresWorker = hasFunctionParameter declaration.args || Array.any isPointerNode declaration.args || case declaration.ret of
          Nothing -> true
          Just result -> needsValueWorker result || isPointerNode result
      in
        Just
          { declaration
          , tast
          , requiresWorker
          , callName: declaration.name <> if requiresWorker then "_nativeWorker" else ""
          }
  | otherwise = Nothing

hasFunctionParameter :: Array TypeNode -> Boolean
hasFunctionParameter = Array.any case _ of
  TFunc _ _ -> true
  _ -> false

functionInfo :: String -> NativeCandidate -> Maybe FunctionInfo
functionInfo unit { declaration, tast, requiresWorker, callName } = do
  args <- traverse argumentType declaration.args
  ret <- case declaration.ret of
    Just t | requiresWorker && workerReturnsNative declaration -> typeNodeToGoType t
    Just _ | requiresWorker -> boxedResult
    Just t -> typeNodeToGoType t
    Nothing -> boxedResult
  pure { arrayFold: Nothing, reference: SymbolReference (foreignSymbol unit callName), fArgs: args, fRet: ret, arity: Array.length declaration.args }
  where
  argumentType (TFunc _ _) | requiresWorker = Just TypeValue
  argumentType t | requiresWorker && isPointerNode t = Just TypeValue
  argumentType t = typeNodeToGoType t

  boxedResult = if isRecordResult tast then Nothing else Just TypeValue

-- Pointer adapters need boxed inputs, but scalar outputs can keep the same
-- direct representation as a handwritten scalar FFI function.
workerReturnsNative :: FfiDecl -> Boolean
workerReturnsNative declaration = Array.any isPointerNode declaration.args && case declaration.ret of
  Just t -> case typeNodeToGoType t of
    Just TypeString -> true
    Just TypeInt64 -> true
    Just TypeFloat64 -> true
    Just TypeBool -> true
    Just TypeUint32 -> true
    Just TypeValue -> true
    _ -> false
  Nothing -> false

isRecordResult :: ExprType -> Boolean
isRecordResult = case _ of
  Func _ ret -> isRecordResult ret
  Record _ -> true
  Row _ _ -> true
  _ -> false

typeNodeToGoType :: TypeNode -> Maybe GoType
typeNodeToGoType = case _ of
  TNamed "gopurs_runtime.Value" -> Just TypeValue
  TNamed "string" -> Just TypeString
  TNamed "int64" -> Just TypeInt64
  TNamed "float64" -> Just TypeFloat64
  TNamed "bool" -> Just TypeBool
  TNamed "uint32" -> Just TypeUint32
  TNamed "any" -> Just (TypeInterface "any")
  TNamed "interface{}" -> Just (TypeInterface "interface{}")
  TArray elem -> TypeNativeArray <$> typeNodeToGoType elem
  _ -> Nothing

needsValueWorker :: TypeNode -> Boolean
needsValueWorker = case _ of
  TNamed "any" -> true
  TNamed "interface{}" -> true
  TArray elem -> needsValueWorker elem
  _ -> false

-- Keep the existing admission rule: inspect the final PureScript result,
-- rejecting quantified, constrained, unknown and effectful results.
isPureConcreteResult :: ExprType -> Boolean
isPureConcreteResult = case _ of
  Func _ ret -> isPureConcreteResult ret
  ForAll _ _ -> false
  ConstrainedType _ _ -> false
  TypeVar _ -> false
  Any -> false
  other -> not (mentionsEffect other)

mentionsEffect :: ExprType -> Boolean
mentionsEffect = case _ of
  ADT fullName _ args -> String.contains (Pattern "Effect") fullName || Array.any mentionsEffect args
  TypeApp c args -> mentionsEffect c || Array.any mentionsEffect args
  Array t -> mentionsEffect t
  Func args ret -> Array.any mentionsEffect args || mentionsEffect ret
  Record row -> mentionsEffect row
  Row fields tail ->
    Array.any (\(Tuple _ v) -> mentionsEffect v) fields
      || case tail of
        Just t -> mentionsEffect t
        Nothing -> false
  ForAll _ t -> mentionsEffect t
  ConstrainedType constraints t ->
    Array.any (\(Tuple _ as) -> Array.any mentionsEffect as) constraints || mentionsEffect t
  _ -> false

-- Dynamic Foreign boundaries require unboxing dictated by the PureScript type;
-- do not advertise their boxed entry as a direct native call.
mentionsForeign :: ExprType -> Boolean
mentionsForeign = case _ of
  ADT name _ args -> name == "Foreign.Foreign" || Array.any mentionsForeign args
  Func args ret -> Array.any mentionsForeign args || mentionsForeign ret
  Array t -> mentionsForeign t
  Record t -> mentionsForeign t
  Row fields tail -> Array.any (\(Tuple _ t) -> mentionsForeign t) fields || case tail of
    Just t -> mentionsForeign t
    Nothing -> false
  TypeApp t args -> mentionsForeign t || Array.any mentionsForeign args
  ForAll _ t -> mentionsForeign t
  ConstrainedType _ t -> mentionsForeign t
  _ -> false

-- Structured fields must go through the TAST-guided adapter. In particular a
-- callback worker returning an array of structs cannot use generic Box.
containsStruct :: TypeNode -> Boolean
containsStruct = case _ of
  TStruct _ _ -> true
  TIdentified _ _ underlying -> case underlying of
    Just t -> containsStruct t
    Nothing -> false
  TPointer t -> containsStruct t
  TArray t -> containsStruct t
  TMap k v -> containsStruct k || containsStruct v
  TFunc args ret -> Array.any containsStruct args || case ret of
    Just t -> containsStruct t
    Nothing -> false
  _ -> false
