-- Fuse a closed range / head-dependent exclusion / sum pipeline. The proof
-- describes its complete recurrences; no function or constructor spelling is
-- significant. The private bitmap represents the surviving ordered interval.
module Gopurs.ListProgressionFold (prepare) where

import Prelude

import Control.Alternative (guard)
import Control.Monad.State (State, put, runState)
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Array.NonEmpty as NEA
import Data.Foldable (all, foldl)
import Data.Map as Map
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..), fromMaybe)
import Data.Newtype (unwrap)
import Data.Set as Set
import Data.String as String
import Data.String.Pattern (Pattern(..), Replacement(..))
import Data.Traversable (traverse)
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..), fst, snd)
import Gopurs.CodegenState (FunctionInfo)
import Gopurs.GoAst (GoDecl(..), GoExpr(..), GoType(..), rawGo, sanitizeName)
import Gopurs.GoSymbol (GoReference(..), GoSymbol, generated)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Convert (BackendModule)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (ExprType(..), Ident(..), Literal(..), ModuleName, Qualified(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Semantics (NeutralExpr(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendAccessor(..), BackendOperator(..), BackendOperator1(..), BackendOperator2(..), BackendOperatorNum(..), BackendOperatorOrd(..), BackendSyntax(..), Level, Pair(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax as Syn

type Ref = Tuple (Maybe Ident) Level
type Shape = { ty :: ExprType, empty :: Qualified Ident, cons :: Qualified Ident }
type Lambda = { args :: Array Ref, body :: NeutralExpr }
type Loop = { self :: Ref, args :: Array Ref, body :: NeutralExpr, initial :: Array NeutralExpr }
type Context =
  { module_ :: BackendModule
  , sieves :: Map.Map Ident Shape
  , locals :: Map.Map Ref NeutralExpr
  , helper :: Ident
  }

prepare :: BackendModule -> { module :: BackendModule, declarations :: Array GoDecl, functions :: Map.Map String FunctionInfo }
prepare mod =
  let bindings = Array.concatMap _.bindings mod.bindings
      filters = Map.fromFoldable $ Array.mapMaybe (\(Tuple name value) ->
        map (Tuple name) (recognizeFilter mod value)) bindings
      sieves = Map.fromFoldable $ Array.mapMaybe (\(Tuple name value) ->
        map (Tuple name) (recognizeSieve mod filters name value)) bindings
  in if Map.isEmpty sieves then { module: mod, declarations: [], functions: Map.empty }
     else prepareRecognized mod sieves

prepareRecognized :: BackendModule -> Map.Map Ident Shape -> { module :: BackendModule, declarations :: Array GoDecl, functions :: Map.Map String FunctionInfo }
prepareRecognized mod sieves =
  let helper = reserveName mod
      context = { module_: mod, sieves, locals: Map.empty, helper }
      Tuple groups changed = runState (traverse (\group -> do
        rewritten <- traverse (\(Tuple name value) -> Tuple name <$> rewrite context value) group.bindings
        pure (group { bindings = rewritten })) mod.bindings) false
      owner = String.replaceAll (Pattern ".") (Replacement "_") (unwrap mod.name)
      symbol = generated owner ("Call_" <> owner <> "_" <> sanitizeName (unwrap helper))
  in { module: mod { bindings = groups }
     , declarations: if changed then [ declaration symbol ] else []
     , functions: if changed then Map.singleton (sanitizeName (unwrap helper))
         { arrayFold: Nothing, reference: SymbolReference symbol, fArgs: [ TypeInt64, TypeInt64, TypeInt64 ], fRet: TypeInt64, arity: 3 }
       else Map.empty
     }

reserveName :: BackendModule -> Ident
reserveName mod = choose 0
  where
  reserved = Set.fromFoldable $ map (sanitizeName <<< unwrap)
    (map fst (Array.concatMap _.bindings mod.bindings) <> Array.fromFoldable (Map.keys mod.foreign))
  choose index =
    let name = "__gopurs_list_progression_fold_" <> show index
    in if Set.member (sanitizeName name) reserved then choose (index + 1) else Ident name

-- Bounds are guarded in the source IR. Wider Go intermediates make 2*p and
-- the final increment safe even near MaxInt32. The sum retains Int32 wrapping.
-- Start at 2*p, never p*p: heads may be composite when the lower bound is >2.
declaration :: GoSymbol -> GoDecl
declaration symbol = GoFunctionDecl
  { name: symbol
  , params: [ Tuple "lower" TypeInt64, Tuple "upper" TypeInt64, Tuple "seed" TypeInt64 ]
  , result: TypeInt64
  , body: GoBlock
      [ GoAssign "rejected" (rawGo "make([]bool, upper-lower+1)")
      , GoAssign "total" (GoVar "seed")
      , GoForRange "value := lower; value <= upper; value++"
          [ GoIfElse (GoIndex (GoVar "rejected") (GoBinOp "-" (GoVar "value") (GoVar "lower")))
              [ GoContinue "" ] []
          , GoMutate "total" (GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoCall (GoVar "int32") [ GoBinOp "+" (GoVar "total") (GoVar "value") ] ])
          , GoForRange "multiple := value + value; multiple <= upper; multiple += value"
              [ GoMutate "rejected[multiple-lower]" (GoVar "true") ]
          ]
      , GoReturn (GoVar "total")
      ]
  }

strip :: NeutralExpr -> BackendSyntax NeutralExpr
strip (NeutralExpr syntax) = case syntax of
  Typed _ value -> strip value
  Syn.TypeApp value _ -> strip value
  _ -> syntax

annotation :: NeutralExpr -> Maybe ExprType
annotation (NeutralExpr syntax) = case syntax of
  Typed ty _ -> Just ty
  Syn.TypeApp value _ -> annotation value
  _ -> Nothing

signature :: NeutralExpr -> Maybe { args :: Array ExprType, result :: ExprType }
signature value = flatten <$> annotation value
  where
  flatten (Func args result) = let rest = flatten result in { args: args <> rest.args, result: rest.result }
  flatten result = { args: [], result }

abstractions :: NeutralExpr -> Lambda
abstractions value = case strip value of
  Abs args body -> let rest = abstractions body in { args: NEA.toArray args <> rest.args, body: rest.body }
  _ -> { args: [], body: value }

application :: NeutralExpr -> { head :: NeutralExpr, args :: Array NeutralExpr }
application value = case strip value of
  App fn args -> let prior = application fn in { head: prior.head, args: prior.args <> NEA.toArray args }
  _ -> { head: value, args: [] }

localRef :: NeutralExpr -> Maybe Ref
localRef value = case strip value of
  Local name level -> Just (Tuple name level)
  _ -> Nothing

isLocal :: Ref -> NeutralExpr -> Boolean
isLocal ref value = localRef value == Just ref

global :: ModuleName -> NeutralExpr -> Maybe Ident
global current value = case strip value of
  Var (Qualified owner name) | owner == Just current || owner == Nothing -> Just name
  _ -> Nothing

single :: forall a. Array a -> Maybe a
single [ a ] = Just a
single _ = Nothing

two :: forall a. Array a -> Maybe (Tuple a a)
two [ a, b ] = Just (Tuple a b)
two _ = Nothing

literal :: Int -> NeutralExpr -> Boolean
literal expected value = case strip value of
  Lit (LitInt found) -> expected == found
  _ -> false

scalarValue :: NeutralExpr -> Boolean
scalarValue value = annotation value == Just Int && case strip value of
  Local _ _ -> true
  Lit (LitInt _) -> true
  _ -> false

listShape :: BackendModule -> ExprType -> Maybe Shape
listShape mod ty = do
  info <- case ty of
    ADT full _ args -> Just { full, args }
    _ -> Nothing
  decl <- Array.find (\decl -> unwrap mod.name <> "." <> decl.name == info.full) mod.dataDecls
  guard (Array.length decl.vars == Array.length info.args && all (_ == Int) info.args)
  let variables = Map.fromFoldable (Array.zip decl.vars info.args)
      substitute = case _ of
        TypeVar name -> fromMaybe (TypeVar name) (Map.lookup name variables)
        ADT name path args -> ADT name path (map substitute args)
        other -> other
  Tuple empty cons <- case decl.constructors of
    [ a, b ] | Array.null a.fields -> Just (Tuple a b)
    [ a, b ] | Array.null b.fields -> Just (Tuple b a)
    _ -> Nothing
  guard (map substitute cons.fields == [ Int, ty ])
  pure { ty, empty: Qualified (Just mod.name) (Ident empty.name), cons: Qualified (Just mod.name) (Ident cons.name) }

emptyList :: Shape -> NeutralExpr -> Boolean
emptyList shape value = case strip value of
  CtorSaturated name _ _ _ fields -> name == shape.empty && Array.null fields
  Var name -> name == shape.empty
  _ -> false

field :: Shape -> Ref -> Int -> NeutralExpr -> Boolean
field shape ref index value = case strip value of
  Accessor base (GetCtorField name _ _ _ _ found) -> name == shape.cons && index == found && isLocal ref base
  _ -> false

consFields :: Shape -> NeutralExpr -> Maybe (Tuple NeutralExpr NeutralExpr)
consFields shape value = case strip value of
  CtorSaturated name _ _ _ [ Tuple _ head, Tuple _ tail ] | name == shape.cons -> Just (Tuple head tail)
  _ -> Nothing

listCases :: Shape -> Ref -> NeutralExpr -> Maybe { empty :: NeutralExpr, cons :: NeutralExpr }
listCases shape ref value = case strip value of
  Branch cases failure -> case NEA.toArray cases, strip failure of
    [ Pair nilTest nilBody, Pair consTest consBody ], Fail _
      | tag shape.empty nilTest && tag shape.cons consTest -> Just { empty: nilBody, cons: consBody }
    _, _ -> Nothing
  _ -> Nothing
  where
  tag expected input = case strip input of
    PrimOp (Op1 (OpIsTag found) argument) -> expected == found && isLocal ref argument
    _ -> false

localLoop :: Array ExprType -> ExprType -> NeutralExpr -> Maybe Loop
localLoop args result value = case strip value of
  LetRec level bindings body -> do
    let entry = application body
    self <- localRef entry.head
    selected <- snd <$> Array.find (\(Tuple name _) -> self == Tuple (Just name) level) (NEA.toArray bindings)
    guard (all (not <<< Array.null <<< _.args <<< abstractions <<< snd) bindings)
    found <- signature selected
    guard (found.args == args && found.result == result)
    let lambda = abstractions selected
    guard (Array.length lambda.args == Array.length args)
    pure { self, args: lambda.args, body: lambda.body, initial: entry.args }
  _ -> Nothing

selfCall :: Ref -> NeutralExpr -> Maybe (Array NeutralExpr)
selfCall self value = do
  let call = application value
  guard (isLocal self call.head)
  pure call.args

reverseOf :: Shape -> Ref -> NeutralExpr -> Boolean
reverseOf shape source value = fromMaybe false do
  loop <- localLoop [ shape.ty, shape.ty ] shape.ty value
  Tuple input acc <- two loop.args
  Tuple initial seed <- two loop.initial
  guard (isLocal source initial && emptyList shape seed)
  cases <- listCases shape input loop.body
  guard (isLocal acc cases.empty)
  Tuple tail constructed <- selfCall loop.self cases.cons >>= two
  Tuple head rest <- consFields shape constructed
  pure (field shape input 1 tail && field shape input 0 head && isLocal acc rest)

recognizeFilter :: BackendModule -> NeutralExpr -> Maybe Shape
recognizeFilter mod value = do
  sig <- signature value
  ty <- case sig.args of
    [ Func [ Int ] Boolean, ty ] | ty == sig.result -> Just ty
    _ -> Nothing
  shape <- listShape mod ty
  let lambda = abstractions value
  Tuple predicate source <- two lambda.args
  loop <- localLoop [ ty, ty ] ty lambda.body
  Tuple input acc <- two loop.args
  Tuple initial seed <- two loop.initial
  guard (isLocal source initial && emptyList shape seed)
  cases <- listCases shape input loop.body
  guard (reverseOf shape acc cases.empty)
  branch <- case strip cases.cons of
    Branch choices no -> case NEA.toArray choices of
      [ Pair condition yes ] -> Just { condition, yes, no }
      _ -> Nothing
    _ -> Nothing
  let called = application branch.condition
  argument <- single called.args
  guard (isLocal predicate called.head && field shape input 0 argument)
  Tuple yesTail yesAcc <- selfCall loop.self branch.yes >>= two
  Tuple noTail noAcc <- selfCall loop.self branch.no >>= two
  Tuple head rest <- consFields shape yesAcc
  guard (field shape input 1 yesTail && field shape input 1 noTail)
  guard (field shape input 0 head && isLocal acc rest && isLocal acc noAcc)
  pure shape

recognizeSieve :: BackendModule -> Map.Map Ident Shape -> Ident -> NeutralExpr -> Maybe Shape
recognizeSieve mod filters name value = do
  sig <- signature value
  ty <- single sig.args
  guard (sig.result == ty)
  shape <- listShape mod ty
  let lambda = abstractions value
  input <- single lambda.args
  cases <- listCases shape input lambda.body
  guard (emptyList shape cases.empty)
  head <- case strip cases.cons of
    Let name_ level selected body | field shape input 0 selected -> Just { ref: Tuple name_ level, body }
    _ -> Nothing
  Tuple first rest <- consFields shape head.body
  guard (isLocal head.ref first)
  let recur = application rest
  guard (global mod.name recur.head == Just name)
  filtered <- single recur.args
  let call = application filtered
  filter <- global mod.name call.head >>= flip Map.lookup filters
  guard (filter == shape)
  Tuple predicate tail <- two call.args
  guard (field shape input 1 tail && excludesMultiples head.ref predicate)
  pure shape

-- The only discarded callback is this complete primitive expression. In the
-- guarded positive interval it is pure, total, and equivalent to marking the
-- arithmetic progression. Opaque calls and additional captures are rejected.
excludesMultiples :: Ref -> NeutralExpr -> Boolean
excludesMultiples head value = fromMaybe false do
  sig <- signature value
  guard (sig.args == [ Int ] && sig.result == Boolean)
  let lambda = abstractions value
  item <- single lambda.args
  case strip lambda.body of
    PrimOp (Op1 OpBooleanNot equal) -> case strip equal of
      PrimOp (Op2 (OpIntOrd OpEq) modulo zero) | literal 0 zero -> case strip modulo of
        PrimOp (Op2 (OpIntNum OpMod) x divisor) -> pure (isLocal item x && isLocal head divisor)
        _ -> Nothing
      _ -> Nothing
    _ -> Nothing

recognizeFolder :: BackendModule -> Ref -> NeutralExpr -> Maybe Shape
recognizeFolder mod self value = do
  sig <- signature value
  ty <- case sig.args, sig.result of
    [ ty, Int ], Int -> Just ty
    _, _ -> Nothing
  shape <- listShape mod ty
  let lambda = abstractions value
  Tuple input acc <- two lambda.args
  cases <- listCases shape input lambda.body
  guard (isLocal acc cases.empty)
  Tuple tail total <- selfCall self cases.cons >>= two
  guard (field shape input 1 tail)
  guard case strip total of
    PrimOp (Op2 (OpIntNum OpAdd) old item) -> isLocal acc old && field shape input 0 item
    _ -> false
  pure shape

rangeBounds :: Shape -> NeutralExpr -> Maybe { lower :: NeutralExpr, upper :: NeutralExpr }
rangeBounds shape value = do
  loop <- localLoop [ Int, shape.ty ] shape.ty value
  Tuple counter acc <- two loop.args
  Tuple upper seed <- two loop.initial
  guard (scalarValue upper && emptyList shape seed)
  branch <- case strip loop.body of
    Branch choices step -> case NEA.toArray choices of
      [ Pair condition result ] | isLocal acc result -> Just { condition, step }
      _ -> Nothing
    _ -> Nothing
  lower <- case strip branch.condition of
    PrimOp (Op2 (OpIntOrd OpLt) current lower) | isLocal counter current && scalarValue lower -> Just lower
    _ -> Nothing
  -- A bound referencing either loop argument is not invariant or available
  -- at its call site. Only already evaluated enclosing values may be captured.
  guard (not (isLocal counter lower || isLocal acc lower || isLocal loop.self lower))
  Tuple next built <- selfCall loop.self branch.step >>= two
  guard case strip next of
    PrimOp (Op2 (OpIntNum OpSubtract) current amount) -> isLocal counter current && literal 1 amount
    _ -> false
  Tuple head tail <- consFields shape built
  guard (isLocal counter head && isLocal acc tail)
  pure { lower, upper }

rewrite :: Context -> NeutralExpr -> State Boolean NeutralExpr
rewrite context original@(NeutralExpr syntax) = case fuse context original of
  Just replacement -> put true *> pure replacement
  Nothing -> case syntax of
    LetRec level bindings body -> do
      let locals = Map.union (Map.fromFoldable (map (\(Tuple name value) -> Tuple (Tuple (Just name) level) value) (NEA.toArray bindings))) context.locals
          nested = context { locals = locals }
      rewritten <- traverse (\(Tuple name value) -> Tuple name <$> rewrite nested value) bindings
      rest <- rewrite nested body
      pure (NeutralExpr (LetRec level rewritten rest))
    Abs args body ->
      let locals = foldl (flip Map.delete) context.locals args
      in NeutralExpr <<< Abs args <$> rewrite (context { locals = locals }) body
    UncurriedAbs args body ->
      let locals = foldl (flip Map.delete) context.locals args
      in NeutralExpr <<< UncurriedAbs args <$> rewrite (context { locals = locals }) body
    UncurriedEffectAbs args body ->
      let locals = foldl (flip Map.delete) context.locals args
      in NeutralExpr <<< UncurriedEffectAbs args <$> rewrite (context { locals = locals }) body
    Let name level value body -> do
      next <- rewrite context value
      rest <- rewrite (context { locals = Map.delete (Tuple name level) context.locals }) body
      pure (NeutralExpr (Let name level next rest))
    EffectBind name level value body -> do
      next <- rewrite context value
      rest <- rewrite (context { locals = Map.delete (Tuple name level) context.locals }) body
      pure (NeutralExpr (EffectBind name level next rest))
    _ -> NeutralExpr <$> traverse (rewrite context) syntax

fuse :: Context -> NeutralExpr -> Maybe NeutralExpr
fuse context original = do
  let call = application original
  self <- localRef call.head
  folder <- Map.lookup self context.locals
  shape <- recognizeFolder context.module_ self folder
  Tuple source seed <- two call.args
  guard (scalarValue seed)
  let recur = application source
  selected <- global context.module_.name recur.head >>= flip Map.lookup context.sieves
  guard (selected == shape)
  produced <- single recur.args
  bounds <- rangeBounds shape produced
  let lower = bounds.lower
      upper = bounds.upper
      integer n = typed Int (NeutralExpr (Lit (LitInt n)))
      binary ty op a b = typed ty (NeutralExpr (PrimOp (Op2 op a b)))
      compare op = binary Boolean (OpIntOrd op)
      both = binary Boolean OpBooleanAnd
      tests =
        [ compare OpGte lower (integer 2)
        , compare OpGte upper lower
        , compare OpLte upper (integer 2147483647)
        , compare OpLte (binary Int (OpIntNum OpSubtract) upper lower) (integer 1048575)
        , compare OpGte seed (integer (-2147483647 - 1))
        , compare OpLte seed (integer 2147483647)
        ]
      condition = Array.foldr both (typed Boolean (NeutralExpr (Lit (LitBoolean true)))) tests
      worker = typed (Func [ Int, Int, Int ] Int) (NeutralExpr (Var (Qualified (Just context.module_.name) context.helper)))
      fast = typed Int (NeutralExpr (App worker (NEA.cons' lower [ upper, seed ])))
  -- Keep the original application and its scopes verbatim in the fallback.
  -- All duplicated operands are already evaluated locals or literal values.
  pure (typed Int (NeutralExpr (Branch (NEA.singleton (Pair condition fast)) original)))

typed :: ExprType -> NeutralExpr -> NeutralExpr
typed ty = NeutralExpr <<< Typed ty

module Gopurs.LocalWorkers
  ( parameters
  , signature
  , needsWrapper
  , emit
  ) where

import Prelude
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Foldable (any)
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..))
import Data.String as String
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..), snd)
import Gopurs.CodegenState (FunctionInfo)
import Gopurs.CallAnalysis (collectGoSpine, getGoSpineArgs)
import Gopurs.ExprAnalysis (extractExprFuncType, getExprType, unwrapTcoExpr)
import Gopurs.ExprContext (ExprContext, ExprResult, TranslateExpr, flattenStmts)
import Gopurs.GoAst (GoExpr(..), GoType(..), goTypeToStr, rawGo)
import Gopurs.GoSymbol (GoReference(..))
import Gopurs.GoConversions (boxGoExpr, coerceGoExpr)
import Gopurs.GoFunctions (Parameters, curriedFunction, iterationBindings, loopParameters, namedParameters)
import Gopurs.Int32Loops as Int32Loops
import Gopurs.AffineLoops as AffineLoops
import Gopurs.GoTypes (exprTypeToGoType)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco (TcoExpr)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.FreeVars (localId)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendSyntax(App, Local))

-- Local workers use annotation slots directly. Module workers have a separate
-- ABI policy, including read-only record projections and native sum results.
parameters :: ExprContext -> Array String -> TcoExpr -> Parameters
parameters { metadata, modNameStr } names value =
  let
    types = case extractExprFuncType (getExprType value) of
      Just { fArgs } -> map (exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr) fArgs
      Nothing -> []
  in
    namedParameters names types

workerName :: String -> String -> String
workerName modName name = "Call_local_" <> modName <> "_" <> name

signature :: ExprContext -> String -> Parameters -> GoType -> FunctionInfo
signature { modNameStr } name params result =
  { arrayFold: Nothing, reference: LocalReference (workerName modNameStr name), fArgs: map snd params, fRet: result, arity: Array.length params }

-- Inspect the current TCO expression, not usage annotations from an earlier
-- IR. Saturated curried calls use the published native worker directly.
-- Every other occurrence keeps the wrapper, including partial applications,
-- returned functions, callback arguments and uses in peer closures.
needsWrapper :: String -> Int -> TcoExpr -> Boolean
needsWrapper target arity expression =
  let
    visit = needsWrapper target arity
    syntax = unwrapTcoExpr expression
  in case syntax of
    Local ident level -> localId ident level == target
    App _ _ ->
      let
        Tuple fn spine = collectGoSpine expression
        args = getGoSpineArgs spine
      in case unwrapTcoExpr fn of
        Local ident level | localId ident level == target && arity > 0 && Array.length args >= arity && onlyCurriedApplications expression -> any visit args
        _ -> any visit syntax
    _ -> any visit syntax

-- collectGoSpine also flattens uncurried applications. Keep their wrappers,
-- including when an uncurried application is nested under a curried one.
onlyCurriedApplications :: TcoExpr -> Boolean
onlyCurriedApplications expression = case unwrapTcoExpr expression of
  App fn _ -> onlyCurriedApplications fn
  Local _ _ -> true
  _ -> false

-- The translated body determines the native result. Only the curried wrapper
-- crosses Value. Declarations stay separate so recursive callers can place the
-- whole group's declarations before any assignment captures a peer worker.
emit :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> String -> Parameters -> Boolean -> Maybe TcoExpr -> ExprResult -> { declarations :: Array GoExpr, assignments :: Array GoExpr }
emit translate context@{ codegenStateRef, modNameStr, bound } name params keepWrapper loopBody result =
  let
    nativeName = workerName modNameStr name
    resultType = result.exprType
    declarations =
      [ rawGo ("var " <> nativeName <> " func(" <> String.joinWith ", " (map (goTypeToStr <<< snd) params) <> ") " <> goTypeToStr resultType)
      , rawGo ("_ = " <> nativeName)
      ]
        <> if keepWrapper then
          [ rawGo ("var " <> name <> " gopurs_runtime.Value")
          , rawGo ("_ = " <> name)
          ]
        else []
    body = flattenStmts result.stmts <> [ GoReturn result.expr ]
    functionBody = case loopBody of
      Just source -> AffineLoops.wrap translate context (AffineLoops.localTarget bound name) params resultType source
        (Int32Loops.loop name params resultType body)
      Nothing -> GoBlock (iterationBindings params <> body)
    nativeAssignment = GoMutate nativeName (GoFuncBlock (loopParameters params) [ functionBody ] resultType)
    call = GoCall (GoVar nativeName) (map (\(Tuple param ty) ->
      coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr (GoVar (param <> "_loop_val")) TypeValue ty) params)
    boxedResult = boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr call resultType
    wrapper = if Array.null params then
      curriedFunction [ Tuple "_" TypeValue ] TypeValue (GoBlock [ GoReturn boxedResult ])
      else Array.foldr (\(Tuple param _) inner ->
        GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Func")
          [ GoFuncLit [ Tuple (param <> "_loop_val") TypeValue ] [] inner TypeValue ]) boxedResult params
  in
    { declarations, assignments: [ nativeAssignment ] <> if keepWrapper then [ GoMutate name wrapper ] else [] }

module Gopurs.ModuleBindings
  ( TcoBindingGroup
  , prepare
  , declarations
  ) where

import Prelude
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Array.NonEmpty (fromArray)
import Data.Foldable (foldl)
import Data.Map as Map
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..), fromMaybe)
import Data.Traversable (traverse)
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..))
import Effect.Ref (Ref)
import Gopurs.CallAnalysis (extractUncurriedAbs)
import Gopurs.CodegenState (CodegenMetadata, CodegenState, FunctionInfo)
import Gopurs.EffectExprs as EffectExprs
import Gopurs.ExprAnalysis (extractFuncType)
import Gopurs.ExprContext (ModuleFunctions, TranslateExpr, wrapInStmts)
import Gopurs.GoAst (GoDecl(..), GoType(..), sanitizeName)
import Gopurs.GoSymbol (GoReference(..), generated)
import Gopurs.GoConversions (adtPayloadTypes, boxGoExpr, getUnboxedADT)
import Gopurs.GoTypes (exprTypeToGoType)
import Gopurs.ModuleWorkers as ModuleWorkers
import Gopurs.ListFilter as ListFilter
import Gopurs.NativeRecordArgs (workerArguments)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco (TcoExpr(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco as Tco
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Convert (BackendModule)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (ExprType(..), Ident(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendSyntax(Typed))

type TcoBindingGroup =
  { recursive :: Boolean
  , bindings :: Array (Tuple Ident TcoExpr)
  }

-- Analyze recursion before publishing the native signatures used by calls.
prepare :: CodegenMetadata -> String -> BackendModule -> { bindings :: Array TcoBindingGroup, functions :: ModuleFunctions }
prepare metadata modNameStr mod =
  let
    Tuple _ tcoBindings = foldl
      ( \(Tuple env acc) group ->
          let
            neBindings = fromArray group.bindings

            env' = case neBindings of
              Just ne | group.recursive -> Tco.topLevelTcoEnvGroup mod.name ne <> env
              _ -> env
            tcoBinds = map
              (\(Tuple id val) -> Tuple id (Tco.analyze env' val))
              group.bindings
          in
            Tuple env' (Array.snoc acc { recursive: group.recursive, bindings: tcoBinds })
      )
      (Tuple [] [])
      mod.bindings

    moduleFunctions :: ModuleFunctions
    moduleFunctions = Map.fromFoldable $ Array.concatMap
      ( \group ->
          if group.recursive then
            let
              mutRecBinds = traverse (\(Tuple _ val) -> extractUncurriedAbs val) group.bindings
            in
              case mutRecBinds of
                Just _ -> map (bindingSignature metadata modNameStr) group.bindings
                Nothing -> map (\(Tuple (Ident name) _) -> Tuple (sanitizeName name) (boxedSignature modNameStr name)) group.bindings
          else
            map (bindingSignature metadata modNameStr) group.bindings
      )
      tcoBindings
  in
    { bindings: tcoBindings, functions: moduleFunctions }

boxedSignature :: String -> String -> FunctionInfo
boxedSignature modNameStr name =
  { arrayFold: Nothing, reference: SymbolReference (generated modNameStr ("Call_" <> modNameStr <> "_" <> sanitizeName name)), fArgs: [], fRet: TypeValue, arity: 0 }

-- Syntax fixes worker arity. A computation between lambdas leaves a boxed
-- function result; fully consumed native sums use their specialized ABI.
-- Read-only record projections are selected here and reused by ModuleWorkers.
bindingSignature :: CodegenMetadata -> String -> Tuple Ident TcoExpr -> Tuple String FunctionInfo
bindingSignature metadata modNameStr (Tuple (Ident name) value) =
  let
    fallback = boxedSignature modNameStr name
    toGoType = exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr
    signature = case extractUncurriedAbs value of
      Just { args, body } ->
        let
          annotation = extractFuncType value
          parameters = case annotation of
            Just { fArgs, fRet } -> workerArguments toGoType args body
              (Array.take (Array.length args) fArgs)
              (if Array.length args < Array.length fArgs then Any else fRet)
              <> Array.replicate (Array.length args - Array.length fArgs) TypeValue
            Nothing -> Array.replicate (Array.length args) TypeValue
          result = case annotation of
            Just { fArgs, fRet } | Array.length args >= Array.length fArgs ->
              workerResultType toGoType fRet
            _ -> TypeValue
        in
          fallback
            { fArgs = fromMaybe parameters (ListFilter.workerArguments metadata (Array.zip args parameters) result value)
            , fRet = result, arity = Array.length args }
      Nothing -> fallback
  in
    Tuple (sanitizeName name) signature

-- The ordinary native sum ABI intentionally boxes non-record payloads. For a
-- Tuple containing an array or an ADT pointer this would copy those payloads
-- merely to return them to a concrete caller, which immediately unboxes them.
-- The instantiated pointer layout is already established by the TAST and ADT
-- metadata. Publish that same layout to callers and retain the canonical box
-- only in the public getter. No body-specific or consumer-name rule is needed.
workerResultType :: (ExprType -> GoType) -> ExprType -> GoType
workerResultType toGoType result =
  let native = toGoType result
  in case native, getUnboxedADT result of
    TypeStructPointer pointer, Just (Tuple "Data.Tuple.Tuple" _)
      | Array.any erasedCompositeSlot pointer.typeArgs -> native
    _, Just (Tuple adtName adt) -> TypeStructValue adtName (adt.signature (adtPayloadTypes toGoType result))
    _, Nothing -> native
  where
  erasedCompositeSlot = case _ of
    TypeNativeArray _ -> true
    TypeStructPointer _ -> true
    _ -> false

-- Declarations and loop bodies share the same child translator as local
-- bindings. Each recursive group publishes its function declarations together.
declarations :: TranslateExpr -> CodegenMetadata -> Ref CodegenState -> String -> ModuleFunctions -> Array TcoBindingGroup -> Array GoDecl
declarations translate metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr moduleFunctions groups =
  Array.concatMap
    ( \group ->
        let
          recVars = if group.recursive then map (\(Tuple (Ident name) _) -> sanitizeName name) group.bindings else []

          context = { metadata, codegenStateRef, depth: 0, modNameStr, recVars, moduleFunctions, bound: Map.empty, tcoIdent: Nothing, loopCtx: [], options: { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType: Nothing, mbExpectedGoType: Nothing }

          processBindingGroup :: Array (Tuple Ident TcoExpr) -> Array GoDecl
          processBindingGroup binds =
            let
              mutRecBinds = traverse (\(Tuple (Ident name) val) -> map (\abs -> { ident: sanitizeName name, args: abs.args, body: abs.body, val: val }) (extractUncurriedAbs val)) binds
            in
              case mutRecBinds of
                Just fns ->
                  map (ModuleWorkers.declaration translate context (group.recursive && Array.length group.bindings == 1)) fns
                Nothing ->
                  Array.concatMap
                    ( \(Tuple (Ident name) expr) ->
                        let
                          bindingContext = context { depth = 0, bound = Map.empty, tcoIdent = (Just (sanitizeName name)), loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType = (Just (annotationType expr)) }
                          res = case EffectExprs.wrapCachedInt translate bindingContext 0 expr of
                            Just cached -> cached
                            Nothing -> translate bindingContext 0 expr
                        in
                          [ GoCachedValue { identifier: generated modNameStr (modNameStr <> "_" <> sanitizeName name), expression: wrapInStmts [] res.stmts TypeValue (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr res.expr res.exprType), goType: TypeValue } ]
                    )
                    binds
        in
          if group.recursive then
            processBindingGroup group.bindings
          else
            Array.concatMap (\b -> processBindingGroup [ b ]) group.bindings
    )
    groups

-- Cached values use only an outer annotation, not primitive-result inference.
annotationType :: TcoExpr -> ExprType
annotationType (TcoExpr _ (Typed ty _)) = ty
annotationType _ = Any

-- | Consuming workers for a closed, first-order forest language. These proofs
-- | belong to the final backend IR and never use source usage annotations.
module Gopurs.Ownership (prepare) where

import Prelude

import Control.Alternative (guard)
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Array.NonEmpty as NEA
import Data.Foldable (all, foldMap)
import Data.Map as Map
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..), fromMaybe, isJust)
import Data.Newtype (unwrap)
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..))
import Gopurs.CodegenState (CodegenMetadata, FunctionInfo)
import Gopurs.GoAst (GoDecl, sanitizeName)
import Gopurs.GoSymbol (GoReference(..), generated)
import Data.String as String
import Data.String.Pattern (Pattern(..), Replacement(..))
import Gopurs.Ownership.Analysis (freshTree, qualify, spine, strip)
import Gopurs.Ownership.Candidates as Candidates
import Gopurs.Ownership.Types (Candidate, Candidates)
import Gopurs.Ownership.Workers as Workers
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Convert (BackendModule)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (ExprType(..), ModuleName, Qualified(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Semantics (NeutralExpr(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendSyntax(..))

-- Admission and name reservation precede the consuming-contract fixed point.
-- Publish declarations/signatures only for survivors, then rewrite fresh entry
-- calls. Ordinary function bindings remain available with persistent semantics.
prepare :: CodegenMetadata -> BackendModule ->
  { module :: BackendModule, declarations :: Array GoDecl, functions :: Map.Map String FunctionInfo }
prepare metadata mod =
  let initial = Candidates.collect metadata mod
      accepted = validateCandidates metadata mod.name initial
      workers = Array.fromFoldable (Map.values accepted)
      declarations = foldMap (fromMaybe [] <<< Workers.declarations metadata mod.name accepted) workers
      functions = functionSignatures (String.replaceAll (Pattern ".") (Replacement "_") (unwrap mod.name)) workers
      bindings = map (\group -> group { bindings = map (\(Tuple name expr) ->
        Tuple name (rewrite metadata mod.name accepted expr)) group.bindings }) mod.bindings
  in { module: mod { bindings = bindings }, declarations, functions }

-- Removing a rejected function invalidates every caller which depended on its
-- consuming contract. The fixed point includes mutually recursive families.
-- Workers.declarations is an all-or-nothing proof/emission attempt; rerunning it
-- on the accepted set preserves the same per-worker fresh-name sequence.
validateCandidates :: CodegenMetadata -> ModuleName -> Candidates -> Candidates
validateCandidates metadata moduleName candidates =
  let accepted = Map.filter (isJust <<< Workers.declarations metadata moduleName candidates) candidates
  in if Map.size accepted == Map.size candidates then accepted else validateCandidates metadata moduleName accepted

functionSignatures :: String -> Array Candidate -> Map.Map String FunctionInfo
functionSignatures unit = Map.fromFoldable <<< map (\fn -> Tuple (sanitizeName $ unwrap fn.worker)
  { arrayFold: Nothing, reference: SymbolReference (generated unit fn.native), fArgs: fn.argTypes, fRet: fn.spec.goType, arity: Array.length fn.args })

-- Every tree argument must be fresh on entry. Scalar arguments retain their
-- ordinary evaluation; only the closed constructor trees need this proof.
freshCall :: CodegenMetadata -> ModuleName -> Candidates -> NeutralExpr -> Maybe { fn :: Candidate, args :: Array NeutralExpr }
freshCall metadata moduleName candidates expr = do
  let call = spine expr
  fn <- case strip call.head of
    Var qualified -> case qualify moduleName qualified of
      Qualified (Just mod) name | mod == moduleName -> Map.lookup name candidates
      _ -> Nothing
    _ -> Nothing
  guard (Array.length call.args == Array.length fn.args)
  let context = { metadata, moduleName, candidates, candidate: fn }
  guard (all (\(Tuple ty value) -> ty /= fn.spec.goType || freshTree context value)
    (Array.zip fn.argTypes call.args))
  pure { fn, args: call.args }

rewrite :: CodegenMetadata -> ModuleName -> Candidates -> NeutralExpr -> NeutralExpr
rewrite metadata moduleName candidates original@(NeutralExpr syn) =
  let choose = do
        { fn, args: supplied } <- freshCall metadata moduleName candidates original
        args <- NEA.fromArray (map (rewrite metadata moduleName candidates) supplied)
        let signature = Func (map (\ty -> if ty == fn.spec.goType then fn.spec.ty else Any) fn.argTypes) fn.spec.ty
        pure $ NeutralExpr $ Typed fn.spec.ty $ NeutralExpr $ App
          (NeutralExpr $ Typed signature $ NeutralExpr $ Var $ Qualified (Just moduleName) fn.worker) args
  in fromMaybe (NeutralExpr $ map (rewrite metadata moduleName candidates) syn) choose

-- @inline Main.snapshot never
-- @inline Main.effectSnapshot never
-- @inline Main.rounds never
-- @inline Main.effectRounds never
-- @inline Main.localRounds never
module Main where

-- @dependencies: prelude effect console refs

import Prelude
import Effect (Effect)
import Effect.Console (log, logShow)
import Effect.Ref as Ref

-- Closed record evaluation retains a strict global binding demand even when
-- the caller projects only the integer field.
snapshot :: Int -> { value :: Int, witness :: Unit }
snapshot remaining
  | remaining == 0 = { value: 0, witness: unit }
  | otherwise =
      let previous = snapshot (remaining - 1)
      in { value: previous.value + 1, witness: previous.witness }

effectSnapshot :: Int -> { value :: Int, witness :: String -> Effect Unit }
effectSnapshot remaining
  | remaining == 0 = { value: 0, witness: log }
  | otherwise =
      let previous = effectSnapshot (remaining - 1)
      in { value: previous.value + 1, witness: previous.witness }

rounds :: Int -> Int -> Int
rounds remaining total
  | remaining == 0 = total
  | otherwise = rounds (remaining - 1) (total + (snapshot 7).value)

effectRounds :: Int -> Int -> Int
effectRounds remaining total
  | remaining == 0 = total
  | otherwise = effectRounds (remaining - 1) (total + (effectSnapshot 5).value)

localRounds :: Int -> Int -> Int -> Int
localRounds offset count seed =
  let
    repeat remaining total
      | remaining == 0 = total
      | otherwise = repeat (remaining - 1) (total + (snapshot 11).value)
  in offset + repeat count seed

main :: Effect Unit
main = do
  repetitions <- Ref.new 20
  count <- Ref.read repetitions
  maximum <- Ref.new 2147483647
  maxInt <- Ref.read maximum
  logShow [ rounds 0 maxInt, rounds 1 0, rounds count 0, rounds 5 (-40), rounds 2 maxInt ]
  logShow [ localRounds 3 count 0, localRounds 3 0 (-17), localRounds 0 2 maxInt ]
  logShow [ effectRounds 0 maxInt, effectRounds count 2, effectRounds 2 maxInt ]

module Gopurs.AffineLoops (wrap, globalTarget, localTarget) where

import Prelude

import Control.Alternative (guard)
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Array.NonEmpty as NEA
import Data.Foldable (any, foldl)
import Data.Map as Map
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..))
import Data.Newtype (unwrap)
import Data.String as String
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..))
import Gopurs.ExprContext (ExprContext, LocalEnv, TranslateExpr, childContext, flattenStmts)
import Gopurs.FilteredSumLoops as FilteredSumLoops
import Gopurs.GoAst (GoExpr(..), GoType(..), sanitizeName)
import Gopurs.GoFunctions (Parameters)
import Gopurs.RecordAffineLoops as RecordAffineLoops
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco (TcoExpr(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (Ident(..), Literal(..), Qualified(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.FreeVars (localId)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendSyntax, Pair(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax as Syn

data Increment = Constant Int | Remainders Int
type Recurrence = { counter :: String, accumulator :: String, increment :: Increment, reads :: Array TcoExpr }

-- Match the complete pure recurrence before changing its execution count. The
-- original loop remains the fallback for zero, negative and wide entry values.
-- Unused global reads retain their first demand in source order. Generated
-- PureScript getters memoize initialization; foreign getters return a binding
-- materialized at package initialization (Printer/FfiBridge). Reading a Var
-- never invokes the function or Effect it may contain. Calls, accessors,
-- callbacks and effects are not admitted as reads.
wrap :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> (TcoExpr -> Boolean) -> Parameters -> GoType -> TcoExpr -> GoExpr -> GoExpr
wrap translate context self params result body original = case recognize self params body of
  Just recurrence | result == TypeInt64 ->
    let
      counter = GoVar (recurrence.counter <> "_loop")
      accumulator = GoVar (recurrence.accumulator <> "_loop")
      positive = GoBinOp ">" counter (integer 0)
      bounded = GoBinOp "<=" counter (integer top)
      signed = GoBinOp "==" accumulator (cast "int64" (cast "int32" accumulator))
      admitted = GoBinOp "&&" (GoBinOp "&&" positive bounded) signed
      -- The counter, constant/divisor and seed fit signed Int32. Both the
      -- constant sum and positive remainder-period products fit Int64.
      -- IntMul intentionally has JS
      -- Number rounding semantics, so it cannot implement this exact sum.
      total = GoBinOp "+" accumulator (incrementSum counter recurrence.increment)
      value = cast "int64" (cast "int32" total)
    in GoBlock [ GoIfElse admitted (emitReads translate context recurrence.reads <> [ GoReturn value ]) [], original ]
  _ -> RecordAffineLoops.wrap self params result body
    (FilteredSumLoops.wrap self params result body original)

recognize :: (TcoExpr -> Boolean) -> Parameters -> TcoExpr -> Maybe Recurrence
recognize self params body = do
  Tuple first second <- case params of
    [ Tuple first TypeInt64, Tuple second TypeInt64 ] | first /= second -> Just (Tuple first second)
    _ -> Nothing
  branch <- case syntax body of
    Syn.Branch branches step -> case NEA.toArray branches of
      [ Pair condition seed ] -> Just { condition, seed, step }
      _ -> Nothing
    _ -> Nothing
  counter <- case syntax branch.condition of
    Syn.PrimOp (Syn.Op2 (Syn.OpIntOrd Syn.OpEq) left right)
      | literal 0 right -> localName left
      | literal 0 left -> localName right
    _ -> Nothing
  guard (counter == first || counter == second)
  let accumulator = if counter == first then second else first
  guard (local accumulator branch.seed)
  prefix <- strictReads 64 branch.step
  args <- case syntax prefix.body of
    Syn.App target args | self target -> Just (NEA.toArray args)
    Syn.UncurriedApp target args | self target -> Just args
    _ -> Nothing
  Tuple nextCounter nextAccumulator <- case args of
    [ a, b ] -> Just (if counter == first then Tuple a b else Tuple b a)
    _ -> Nothing
  guard (case syntax nextCounter of
    Syn.PrimOp (Syn.Op2 (Syn.OpIntNum Syn.OpSubtract) left right) -> local counter left && literal 1 right
    _ -> false)
  operand <- case syntax nextAccumulator of
    Syn.PrimOp (Syn.Op2 (Syn.OpIntNum Syn.OpAdd) left right)
      | local accumulator left -> Just right
      | local accumulator right -> Just left
    _ -> Nothing
  -- Closed scalar evaluation may retain strict reads inside the increment
  -- operand. The other operand and counter update are already proven pure;
  -- these demands therefore follow the step prefix in either argument order.
  suffix <- strictReads (64 - Array.length prefix.reads) operand
  increment <- case syntax suffix.body of
    Syn.PrimOp (Syn.Op2 (Syn.OpIntNum Syn.OpMod) value divisor) | local counter value -> do
      modulus <- intLiteral divisor
      guard (modulus > 0 && modulus <= top)
      pure (Remainders modulus)
    _ -> do
      constant <- intLiteral suffix.body
      guard (constant >= bottom && constant <= top)
      pure (Constant constant)
  pure { counter, accumulator, increment, reads: prefix.reads <> suffix.reads }

incrementSum :: GoExpr -> Increment -> GoExpr
incrementSum counter = case _ of
  Constant value -> GoBinOp "*" counter (integer value)
  Remainders modulus ->
    let divisor = integer modulus
        quotient = GoBinOp "/" counter divisor
        remainder = GoBinOp "%" counter divisor
        cycles = GoBinOp "/" (GoBinOp "*" (GoBinOp "*" quotient divisor) (integer (modulus - 1))) (integer 2)
        suffix = GoBinOp "/" (GoBinOp "*" remainder (GoBinOp "+" remainder (integer 1))) (integer 2)
    -- Sum k mod d for k=1..n, with n,d positive: whole periods then 1..r.
    -- q*d*(d-1) and r*(r+1) are at most MaxInt32*(MaxInt32-1).
    in GoBinOp "+" cycles suffix

-- Match the whole suffix, including every local level, before discarding a
-- binding. Locals, projections and arbitrary initializers keep the old loop.
strictReads :: Int -> TcoExpr -> Maybe { reads :: Array TcoExpr, body :: TcoExpr }
strictReads remaining expression = case syntax expression of
  Syn.Let ident level value body -> do
    guard (remaining > 0)
    case syntax value of
      Syn.Var _ -> pure unit
      _ -> Nothing
    guard (not (usesLocal ident level body))
    suffix <- strictReads (remaining - 1) body
    pure { reads: Array.cons value suffix.reads, body: suffix.body }
  _ -> Just { reads: [], body: expression }

usesLocal :: Maybe Ident -> Syn.Level -> TcoExpr -> Boolean
usesLocal ident level (TcoExpr _ value) = case value of
  Syn.Local name at -> ident == name && level == at
  _ -> any (usesLocal ident level) value

-- Translate each demand normally so its representation and any strict
-- conversion remain intact. Never inherit the recurrence's Int result type.
emitReads :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Array TcoExpr -> Array GoExpr
emitReads translate context values =
  (foldl emit { next: 0, statements: [] } values).statements
  where
  emit acc value =
    let result = translate (childContext context Nothing) acc.next value
    in { next: result.nextId
       , statements: acc.statements <> flattenStmts result.stmts <> [ GoMutate "_" result.expr ]
       }

syntax :: TcoExpr -> BackendSyntax TcoExpr
syntax (TcoExpr _ value) = case value of
  Syn.Typed _ inner -> syntax inner
  _ -> value

localName :: TcoExpr -> Maybe String
localName expr = case syntax expr of
  Syn.Local ident level -> Just (localId ident level)
  _ -> Nothing

local :: String -> TcoExpr -> Boolean
local name expr = localName expr == Just name

intLiteral :: TcoExpr -> Maybe Int
intLiteral expr = case syntax expr of
  Syn.Lit (LitInt value) -> Just value
  _ -> Nothing

literal :: Int -> TcoExpr -> Boolean
literal value expr = intLiteral expr == Just value

globalTarget :: String -> String -> TcoExpr -> Boolean
globalTarget moduleName name expr = case syntax expr of
  Syn.Var (Qualified (Just owner) (Ident ident)) ->
    String.replaceAll (String.Pattern ".") (String.Replacement "_") (unwrap owner) == moduleName
      && sanitizeName ident == name
  _ -> false

localTarget :: LocalEnv -> String -> TcoExpr -> Boolean
localTarget bound name expr = case localName expr >>= flip Map.lookup bound of
  Just binding -> binding.name == name
  Nothing -> false

cast :: String -> GoExpr -> GoExpr
cast name value = GoCall (GoVar name) [ value ]

integer :: Int -> GoExpr
integer = cast "int64" <<< GoInt
