common C reference cases') for variant in VARIANTS: verify(variant, campaign['core_campaign'][variant]) require(set(core[variant]) == set(ROWS), 'Incomplete primary core measurements') for name, value in zip(ROWS, campaign['core_campaign'][variant]['times_us']): close(positive(core[variant][name]), value, variant + ' primary ' + name) close(campaign['primary_total_ms'][variant], sum(core[variant].values()) / 1000, variant + ' primary total') all_campaign = campaign['all_campaign'] tests = all_campaign['all_tests'] require(all_campaign['mode'] == 'comparison' and len(tests) == 37 and set(ROWS).issubset(tests), 'Expected 14 core and 23 library AppAll cases') require(all_campaign['order'] == ['before', 'after', 'after', 'before', 'before', 'after'], 'Unexpected AppAll process order') require(set(tests) == set(references), 'JS references must cover exactly the 37 cases') runs = all_campaign['checked_runs'] require(len(runs) == 6 and [run['variant'] for run in runs] == all_campaign['order'], 'Missing checked AppAll processes') for run in runs: result = run['result'] require(result['values_validated'] and len(result['values']) == 14 and result['library']['values_validated'] and len(result['library']['values']) == 23, 'Unvalidated AppAll oracles') for name, case in tests.items(): require(case['js_reference'] == references[name], 'JS reference drift: ' + name) for variant in VARIANTS: samples = case['samples_us'][variant] require(len(samples) == 3, 'Expected three samples: ' + name) close(positive(case['medians_us'][variant]), statistics.median(positive(sample) for sample in samples), name + ' median') # App/AppAll core measurements are different experiments. Publish primary # App medians for the 14 core cases, and AppAll medians for the 23 additions. times = {name: core['after'][name] if name in core['after'] else case['medians_us']['after'] for name, case in tests.items()} js = {name: positive(entry['time_us']) for name, entry in references.items()} summaries = {'C': summarize(times, c), 'JS': summarize(times, js)} require(summaries['C']['count'] == 37 and summaries['JS']['count'] == 37, 'Unexpected aggregate coverage') require(times == campaign['matched37_times_us']['after'], 'Publication must use primary App14 and library AppAll23 measurements') for metric, key in zip(METRICS, ('total', 'arithmetic', 'median', 'geometric')): close(summaries['C'][metric], campaign['aggregates']['after'][key], 'primary Go/C ' + key) rows = [{'case': name, 'go_us': value, 'origin': 'primary_times_us.after' if name in core['after'] else 'all_campaign.all_tests.medians_us.after', 'c_us': c.get(name), 'js_us': js[name], 'go_over_c': value / c[name] if name in c else None, 'go_over_js': value / js[name]} for name, value in times.items()] return times, c, js, summaries, rows def go_section(lines): starts = [i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if line.rstrip('\r\n') == '#### Go'] require(len(starts) == 1, 'Expected one exact #### Go section') start = starts[0] end = next((i for i in range(start + 1, len(lines)) if re.match(r'^#{1,4} ', lines[i])), len(lines)) return start, end def cells(line): require(line.startswith('|') and line.rstrip().endswith('|'), 'Expected a pipe-delimited table row') return [part.strip() for part in line.split('|')[1:-1]] def check_published_reference(lines, title, reference): starts = [i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if line.rstrip('\r\n') == '#### ' + title] require(len(starts) == 1, 'Missing unique reference section: ' + title) start = starts[0] end = next((i for i in range(start + 1, len(lines)) if re.match(r'^#{1,4} ', lines[i])), len(lines)) found = {} for line in lines[start + 1:end]: if not line.startswith('| ['): continue row = cells(line) label = re.fullmatch(r'\[([^\]]+)\]\([^)]+\)', row[0]) if label and label[1] in reference: require(label[1] not in found, 'Duplicate reference row: ' + label[1]) found[label[1]] = re.sub(r'', '', row[1]) require(found == {name: format_time(value) for name, value in reference.items()}, 'Published ' + title + ' timings differ from the frozen references; review before publishing') def review_live_readme(original, frozen): snapshot = WORK / 'README.before.md' baseline = snapshot.read_bytes() require(sha(baseline) == frozen['documentary_baseline_sha256']['README.md'], 'The initial historical README snapshot changed') old = baseline.decode().splitlines(keepends=True) current = original.decode().splitlines(keepends=True) def release_cells(lines): start, end = go_section(lines) return [(cells(line)[0], cells(line)[1]) for line in lines[start + 1:end] if line.startswith('|')] require(release_cells(old) == release_cells(current), 'A Go Release baseline cell changed externally') def reference_cells(lines, title): starts = [i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if line.rstrip('\r\n') == '#### ' + title] require(len(starts) == 1, 'Missing unique reference section: ' + title) start = starts[0] end = next((i for i in range(start + 1, len(lines)) if re.match(r'^#{1,4} ', lines[i])), len(lines)) return [(cells(line)[0], cells(line)[1].replace('≈ ', '')) for line in lines[start + 1:end] if line.startswith('| [')] for title in ('C (reference)', 'JavaScript'): require(reference_cells(old, title) == reference_cells(current, title), 'Published ' + title + ' reference measurements changed externally') edits = [{'before_line': a + 1, 'after_line': c + 1, 'before': ''.join(old[a:b]), 'after': ''.join(current[c:d])} for tag, a, b, c, d in difflib.SequenceMatcher(a=old, b=current).get_opcodes() if tag != 'equal'] external_diff = ''.join(difflib.unified_diff(old, current, fromfile='frozen/README.md', tofile='pre-publication/README.md')) changed_lines = sum(max(len(entry['before'].splitlines()), len(entry['after'].splitlines())) for entry in edits) return {'frozen_sha256': sha(baseline), 'pre_publication_sha256': sha(original), 'go_release_cells_unchanged': True, 'reference_numbers_unchanged': True, 'external_changed_lines': changed_lines, 'external_changes': edits, 'external_diff_sha256': sha(external_diff.encode())}, external_diff def propose(original, times, c, js, summaries): lines = original.decode('utf-8').splitlines(keepends=True) start, end = go_section(lines) check_published_reference(lines, 'C (reference)', c) check_published_reference(lines, 'JavaScript', js) table_count = sum(bool(TABLE_SEPARATOR.fullmatch(line.rstrip('\r\n'))) for line in lines) require(table_count == 17, 'Expected the existing 17 README tables') header = next(line for line in lines[start:end] if line.startswith('Go Benchmark')) require('[gopurs](' in header.split('|')[1] and '--dev' not in header.split('|')[1], 'Column 1 must be gopurs Release') updates, located = {}, [] state, total = None, None for index in range(start + 1, end): line = lines[index] if not line.startswith('|'): continue row = cells(line) require(len(row) == 6, 'Unexpected Go table width') if not row[0] and re.match(r'^\*\*(Stable|WIP|Backlog)\*\*', row[1]): state = re.match(r'^\*\*(Stable|WIP|Backlog)\*\*', row[1])[1] label = re.fullmatch(r'\[([^\]]+)\]\([^)]+\)', row[0]) if label and label[1] in times: name = label[1] require(state == 'WIP', 'Refusing to modify a non-WIP measurement: ' + name) require(name not in located, 'Duplicate Go benchmark: ' + name) require(cells(lines[index + 1])[0] == '↳ /C' and cells(lines[index + 2])[0] == '↳ /JS', 'Expected adjacent benchmark ratios') located.append(name) updates[index] = format_time(times[name]) updates[index + 1] = format_number(times[name] / c[name]) + 'x' if name in c else '—' updates[index + 2] = format_number(times[name] / js[name]) + 'x' if row[0] == '**Total WIP**': require(total is None, 'Duplicate Total WIP row') total = index require(set(located) == set(times) and len(located) == 37, 'Expected all 37 measured WIP rows') require(total is not None, 'Missing Total WIP') updates[total] = '' + format_time(sum(times.values()) / 1000, 'ms') + '' for offset, (reference, metric) in enumerate(((r, m) for r in ('C', 'JS') for m in METRICS), 1): label = '↳ ' + ('' if metric == '/' else metric) + '/' + reference require(cells(lines[total + offset])[0] == label, 'Unexpected total metric: ' + label) updates[total + offset] = statistics_cell(summaries[reference], metric) require(len(updates) == 120 and all(start < index < end for index in updates), 'Only 37 times, 74 ratios and 9 total cells may be proposed') revised = list(lines) changes = [] for index, value in sorted(updates.items()): parts = lines[index].split('|') old = parts[2] spaces = re.fullmatch(r'(\s*)(\S(?:.*\S)?)(\s*)', old) require(spaces is not None, 'Expected a nonempty existing Go Release cell') parts[2] = spaces[1] + value + spaces[3] revised[index] = '|'.join(parts) if revised[index] != lines[index]: changes.append({'line': index + 1, 'table_column_index': 1, 'row': cells(lines[index])[0], 'before': old.strip(), 'after': value}) # Check the complete document, including other Go columns, status rows, # Backlog, all other tables, prose, original whitespace and line endings. for index, (before, after) in enumerate(zip(lines, revised)): if index not in updates: require(before == after, 'A protected line changed') else: a, b = before.split('|'), after.split('|') require(len(a) == len(b) and a[:2] == b[:2] and a[3:] == b[3:], 'A cell outside Go Release column index 1 changed') proposed = ''.join(revised).encode('utf-8') require(len(lines) == len(revised) and table_count == sum( bool(TABLE_SEPARATOR.fullmatch(line.rstrip('\r\n'))) for line in revised), 'The README table structure changed') return proposed, {'tables_preserved': table_count, 'lines_preserved': len(lines), 'eligible_cells': len(updates), 'changed_cells': len(changes), 'only_section': '#### Go', 'only_table_column_index': 1, 'changes': changes} def main(): parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__) parser.add_argument('--campaign', type=Path, default=WORK / 'campaign/results.json') parser.add_argument('--readme', type=Path, default=ROOT / 'README.md') parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, help='fresh audit directory; default: timestamped under proofs/readme-publication') parser.add_argument('--write', action='store_true', help='publish after all validation; default only archives the proposal') args = parser.parse_args() campaign_bytes = args.campaign.read_bytes() campaign = json.loads(campaign_bytes) reference_path = Path(__file__).with_name('references.json') reference_bytes = reference_path.read_bytes() frozen = campaign['frozen_reference'] require(sha(reference_bytes) == frozen['reference_files_sha256'][str(reference_path)], 'The frozen JavaScript reference file changed') publisher = ROOT / 'bin/benchmark/publish.py' require(sha(publisher.read_bytes()) == frozen['source_sha256']['bin/benchmark/publish.py'], 'The number formatter changed since the campaign was frozen') times, c, js, summaries, rows = campaign_values(campaign, json.loads(reference_bytes)['columns']['js-pure']) original = args.readme.read_bytes() external, external_diff = review_live_readme(original, frozen) proposed, structural = propose(original, times, c, js, summaries) diff = ''.join(difflib.unified_diff(original.decode().splitlines(True), proposed.decode().splitlines(True), fromfile='a/readme.md', tofile='b/readme.md')) now = datetime.now(timezone.utc) output = args.output or WORK / 'proofs/readme-publication' / now.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S.%fZ') output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False) snapshot = WORK / 'README.before.md' pre_publication = WORK / 'README.pre-publication.md' if pre_publication.exists(): require(pre_publication.read_bytes() == original, 'Live README changed after pre-publication capture; review the new edits') else: pre_publication.write_bytes(original) audit = {'created_at_utc': now.isoformat(), 'mode': 'write' if args.write else 'dry-run', 'readme': str(args.readme.resolve()), 'campaign': str(args.campaign.resolve()), 'campaign_sha256': sha(campaign_bytes), 'script_sha256': sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes()), 'formatter_sha256': sha(publisher.read_bytes()), 'references_sha256': sha(reference_bytes), 'readme_before_sha256': sha(original), 'readme_proposed_sha256': sha(proposed), 'initial_snapshot_sha256': sha(snapshot.read_bytes()) if snapshot.exists() else None, 'input_policy': 'Read the live README; never restore the initial snapshot; preserve all non-target bytes.', 'external_edits': external, 'pre_publication_snapshot': str(pre_publication), 'measurements': rows, 'total_wip_ms': sum(times.values()) / 1000, 'aggregates': summaries, 'structural_checks': structural, 'publication_completed': False} (output / 'README.frozen.md').write_bytes(snapshot.read_bytes()) (output / 'README.input.md').write_bytes(original) (output / 'external-readme-edits.patch').write_text(external_diff) (output / 'README.proposed.md').write_bytes(proposed) (output / 'readme.patch').write_bytes(diff.encode()) (output / 'audit.json').write_bytes(json_bytes(audit)) if args.write: # Detect edits made during calculation/archive, preserving edits made # before invocation because the proposal was based on that live input. require(args.readme.read_bytes() == original, 'README changed during publication; rerun on the new version') temporary = None try: with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=args.readme.parent, prefix='.go-readme-', delete=False) as stream: temporary = Path(stream.name) stream.write(proposed) os.chmod(temporary, args.readme.stat().st_mode) require(args.readme.read_bytes() == original, 'README changed before replacement; rerun') os.replace(temporary, args.readme) finally: if temporary is not None and temporary.exists(): temporary.unlink() require(args.readme.read_bytes() == proposed, 'README verification failed after replacement') audit['publication_completed'] = True (output / 'audit.json').write_bytes(json_bytes(audit)) print(json.dumps({'mode': audit['mode'], 'audit_directory': str(output.resolve()), 'changed_cells': structural['changed_cells'], 'eligible_cells': structural['eligible_cells'], 'go_c': summaries['C'], 'go_js': summaries['JS'], 'readme_written': audit['publication_completed']}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)) if __name__ == '__main__': try: main() except (ValueError, KeyError, OSError) as error: print('ERROR: ' + str(error), file=sys.stderr) sys.exit(1)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
import hashlib,json,os,re,runpy,subprocess,sys
sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
W=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];R=W.parents[2];C=R.parent/'gopurs/gopurs-prime-night';D=W/'smoke-tco-js';P=W/'proofs/tco-smoke-js'
resume='--resume' in sys.argv
assert resume or (not D.exists() and not P.exists());P.mkdir(exist_ok=resume)
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
inputs={str(p):sha(p) for p in (R/'src/Test/TCO').rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
inputs.update({str(p):sha(p) for p in (R/'src/Bench').rglob('*') if p.is_file()})
compiler={str(C/n):sha(C/n) for n in ['bin/gopurs.js','src/Gopurs/AffineLoops.purs']}
driver=runpy.run_path(str(R/'bin/native/driver.py'))
if not resume:driver['prepare'](D,'go',SimpleNamespace(mode='pure',include_library=False,clean=False))
source='''module AppTCOSmoke where
import Prelude
import Effect (Effect)
import Effect.Console (logShow)
import Test.TCO as TCO
main :: Effect Unit
main = TCO.act >>= logShow
'''
(D/'src/AppTCOSmoke.purs').write_text(source);(P/'AppTCOSmoke.purs').write_text(source)
env={**os.environ,'GOPURS_JS':'1','GOWORK':'off','GOPURS_DAEMON':'0','GOPURS_RESIDENT':'0','GOPURS_FORCE_BUILD':'1','GOPURS_PREPARE_JOBS':'2','GOPURS_PBO_JOBS':'2','GOPURS_EMIT_JOBS':'2','GOPURS_PIPELINE':'1'}
env['PATH']=str(R/'run/bak/js/node_modules/.bin')+os.pathsep+env['PATH'];commands=[]
def run(command,cwd,label):
 command=list(map(str,command));commands.append({'command':command,'cwd':str(cwd)})
 with (P/(label+'.log')).open('w') as out:r=subprocess.run(command,cwd=cwd,env=env,stdout=out,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 assert r.returncode==0,label
if not resume:
 run(['spago','build'],D,'frontend')
 ports=driver['go_dependency_ports']((D/'spago.yaml').read_text(),D)
 if ports:run(['node',driver['go_dependency_helper'](),D/'output',*ports],D,'dependencies')
run([C/'bin/gopurs','--release','--main','AppTCOSmoke'],D,'backend')
texts={p:p.read_text() for p in (D/'output/purescript').rglob('*.go')}
token='func Call_Test_TCO_deepTailRec(';owners=[(p,t) for p,t in texts.items() if token in t];assert len(owners)==1
def extract(text,name):
 start=text.index('func '+name+'(');opening=text.index('{',start);depth=0
 pattern=r'"(?:\\.|[^"\\])*"|`[^`]*`|//[^\n]*|/\*[\s\S]*?\*/|[{}]'
 for match in re.finditer(pattern,text[opening:]):
  if match[0]=='{':depth+=1
  elif match[0]=='}':
   depth-=1
   if depth==0:return text[start:opening+match.end()]
 raise AssertionError('Unclosed function')
def normalize(s):return re.sub(r'\b(?:r_|gopurs_runtime)\.','r.',re.sub(r'\bg[0-9a-f]{6}\.','package.',s))
path,text=owners[0];body=extract(text,'Call_Test_TCO_deepTailRec')
old_sources={p:p.read_text() for p in (W/'before-core/output/purescript').rglob('*.go')}
old_path,old_text=next((p,t) for p,t in old_sources.items() if token in t)
old_body=extract(old_text,'Call_Test_TCO_deepTailRec')
(P/'baseline-deepTailRec.go.txt').write_text(old_body)
assert normalize(body[body.index('{')+1:-1]).strip().endswith(normalize(old_body[old_body.index('{')+1:-1]).strip()),'Original fallback changed'
old_act=next(extract(t,'Get_Test_TCO_act') for t in old_sources.values() if 'func Get_Test_TCO_act(' in t)
new_act=next(extract(t,'Get_Test_TCO_act') for t in texts.values() if 'func Get_Test_TCO_act(' in t)
assert normalize(old_act)==normalize(new_act),'Opaque action changed'
(P/'act.go.txt').write_text(new_act)
assert sha(D/'src/Test/TCO/TCO.purs')==sha(R/'src/Test/TCO/TCO.purs')
(P/'deepTailRec.go.txt').write_text(body)
assert '2147483647' in body and '/' in body and '%' in body and 'int32' in body
assert 'IntMod' in body and 'IntSub' in body,'original fallback missing'
assert 'Get_Bench_opaque' in text or any('Get_Bench_opaque' in t for t in texts.values())
run(['go','mod','tidy'],D/'output','modules')
run(['go','build',*driver['go_build_flags'](False),'-o',D/'smoke','./main'],D/'output','go-build')
r=subprocess.run([str(D/'smoke')],cwd=D,env=env,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True);(P/'stdout.txt').write_text(r.stdout);(P/'stderr.txt').write_text(r.stderr);assert r.stdout=='100000\n' and not r.stderr
assert all(sha(p)==h for p,h in inputs.items());assert all(sha(p)==h for p,h in compiler.items())
m={'validated':True,'fixed_expected_cases':1,'expected':100000,'source':'unchanged Test.TCO.act via diagnostic console entry point; no benchmark timing','compiler':str(C),'compiler_sha256':compiler,'protected_source_sha256':inputs,'commands':commands,'generated_worker_path':str(path),'generated_worker_file_sha256':sha(path),'binary_sha256':sha(D/'smoke'),'resume_note':'Initial extraction stopped at a local var; the second assertion only lacked normalization of the gopurs_runtime import alias. Both diagnostic failures and their script versions are retained. Final run repeats backend generation with the corrected balanced-brace parser, reusing unchanged frontend inputs.','original_fallback_exact_after_alias_normalization':True,'opaque_action_exact_after_alias_normalization':True,'baseline_worker_source_sha256':sha(old_path),'activation':'positive canonical-count/seed guard plus division/remainder period formula; original IntMod/IntSub loop retained','artifact_sha256':{p.name:sha(p) for p in P.iterdir() if p.is_file()}}
(P/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(m,indent=2)+'\n');print('Real Test.TCO formula active, output100000; fallback and opaque input preserved, sources unchanged.')

+module Gopurs.CodePointTakeFold (emit) where
+
+import Prelude
+
+import Control.Alternative (guard)
+import Control.Monad.State (evalState)
+import Data.Array as Array
+import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..))
+import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..))
+import Gopurs.CallAnalysis (collectGoSpine, getGoSpineArgs, qualifiedTarget)
+import Gopurs.CodePointFold as CodePointFold
+import Gopurs.CodegenState (CodePointFoldDescriptor)
+import Gopurs.ExprContext (ExprContext, ExprResult, TranslateExpr)
+import Gopurs.ImmediateApplications.Scope (freshen, maximumLevel)
+import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco (TcoExpr(..))
+import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco as Tco
+import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (ExprType(Int, String, Func), Literal(..), ModuleName(..))
+import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Semantics (NeutralExpr(..))
+import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendSyntax(..))
+
+-- Remove only the immediately consumed canonical take. The count and string
+-- are captured in their original order, even for empty/negative prefixes.
+-- Neither a stored substring nor an unknown/captured consumer is rewritten.
+emit :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> CodePointFoldDescriptor -> TcoExpr -> Maybe ExprResult
+emit translate context nextId descriptor producer = do
+  guard (Array.null context.recVars && CodePointFold.validDescriptor descriptor && onlyCurried producer)
+  guard (CodePointFold.compatibleT String producer)
+  let Tuple function spine = collectGoSpine producer
+  target <- qualifiedTarget function
+  guard (target.mbMod == Just (ModuleName "Data.String.CodePoints") && target.name == "take")
+  guard (CodePointFold.compatibleT (Func [ Int, String ] String) function)
+  Tuple count input <- case getGoSpineArgs spine of
+    [ count, input ] -> Just (Tuple count input)
+    _ -> Nothing
+  let
+    start = max (maximumLevel (neutral producer)) (maximumLevel descriptor.callback) + nextId + 1
+    callback = Tco.analyze [] (evalState (freshen descriptor.callback) start)
+    seed = Tco.analyze [] (NeutralExpr (Typed Int (NeutralExpr (Lit (LitInt descriptor.seed)))))
+  CodePointFold.emitBounded translate context nextId callback seed count input
+
+onlyCurried :: TcoExpr -> Boolean
+onlyCurried (TcoExpr _ syntax) = case syntax of
+  App function _ -> onlyCurried function
+  Typed _ value -> onlyCurried value
+  TypeApp value _ -> onlyCurried value
+  UncurriedApp _ _ -> false
+  UncurriedEffectApp _ _ -> false
+  _ -> true
+
+neutral :: TcoExpr -> NeutralExpr
+neutral (TcoExpr _ syntax) = NeutralExpr (map neutral syntax)

-- Fuse a closed range / head-dependent exclusion / sum pipeline. The proof
-- describes its complete recurrences; no function or constructor spelling is
-- significant. The private bitmap represents the surviving ordered interval.
module Gopurs.ListProgressionFold (prepare) where

import Prelude

import Control.Alternative (guard)
import Control.Monad.State (State, put, runState)
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Array.NonEmpty as NEA
import Data.Foldable (all, foldl)
import Data.Map as Map
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..), fromMaybe)
import Data.Newtype (unwrap)
import Data.Set as Set
import Data.String as String
import Data.String.Pattern (Pattern(..), Replacement(..))
import Data.Traversable (traverse)
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..), fst, snd)
import Gopurs.CodegenState (FunctionInfo)
import Gopurs.GoAst (GoDecl(..), GoExpr(..), GoType(..), rawGo, sanitizeName)
import Gopurs.GoSymbol (GoReference(..), GoSymbol, generated)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Convert (BackendModule)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (ExprType(..), Ident(..), Literal(..), ModuleName, Qualified(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Semantics (NeutralExpr(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendAccessor(..), BackendOperator(..), BackendOperator1(..), BackendOperator2(..), BackendOperatorNum(..), BackendOperatorOrd(..), BackendSyntax(..), Level, Pair(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax as Syn

type Ref = Tuple (Maybe Ident) Level
type Shape = { ty :: ExprType, empty :: Qualified Ident, cons :: Qualified Ident }
type Lambda = { args :: Array Ref, body :: NeutralExpr }
type Loop = { self :: Ref, args :: Array Ref, body :: NeutralExpr, initial :: Array NeutralExpr }
type Context =
  { module_ :: BackendModule
  , sieves :: Map.Map Ident Shape
  , locals :: Map.Map Ref NeutralExpr
  , helper :: Ident
  }

prepare :: BackendModule -> { module :: BackendModule, declarations :: Array GoDecl, functions :: Map.Map String FunctionInfo }
prepare mod =
  let bindings = Array.concatMap _.bindings mod.bindings
      filters = Map.fromFoldable $ Array.mapMaybe (\(Tuple name value) ->
        map (Tuple name) (recognizeFilter mod value)) bindings
      sieves = Map.fromFoldable $ Array.mapMaybe (\(Tuple name value) ->
        map (Tuple name) (recognizeSieve mod filters name value)) bindings
  in if Map.isEmpty sieves then { module: mod, declarations: [], functions: Map.empty }
     else prepareRecognized mod sieves

prepareRecognized :: BackendModule -> Map.Map Ident Shape -> { module :: BackendModule, declarations :: Array GoDecl, functions :: Map.Map String FunctionInfo }
prepareRecognized mod sieves =
  let helper = reserveName mod
      context = { module_: mod, sieves, locals: Map.empty, helper }
      Tuple groups changed = runState (traverse (\group -> do
        rewritten <- traverse (\(Tuple name value) -> Tuple name <$> rewrite context value) group.bindings
        pure (group { bindings = rewritten })) mod.bindings) false
      owner = String.replaceAll (Pattern ".") (Replacement "_") (unwrap mod.name)
      symbol = generated owner ("Call_" <> owner <> "_" <> sanitizeName (unwrap helper))
  in { module: mod { bindings = groups }
     , declarations: if changed then [ declaration symbol ] else []
     , functions: if changed then Map.singleton (sanitizeName (unwrap helper))
         { arrayFold: Nothing, reference: SymbolReference symbol, fArgs: [ TypeInt64, TypeInt64, TypeInt64 ], fRet: TypeInt64, arity: 3 }
       else Map.empty
     }

reserveName :: BackendModule -> Ident
reserveName mod = choose 0
  where
  reserved = Set.fromFoldable $ map (sanitizeName <<< unwrap)
    (map fst (Array.concatMap _.bindings mod.bindings) <> Array.fromFoldable (Map.keys mod.foreign))
  choose index =
    let name = "__gopurs_list_progression_fold_" <> show index
    in if Set.member (sanitizeName name) reserved then choose (index + 1) else Ident name

-- Bounds are guarded in the source IR. Wider Go intermediates make 2*p and
-- the final increment safe even near MaxInt32. The sum retains Int32 wrapping.
-- A prefix starting at 2 is a prime sieve, so its odd bitmap can start marking
-- at p*p. Other lower bounds may select composite heads and retain 2*p below.
declaration :: GoSymbol -> GoDecl
declaration symbol = GoFunctionDecl
  { name: symbol
  , params: [ Tuple "lower" TypeInt64, Tuple "upper" TypeInt64, Tuple "seed" TypeInt64 ]
  , result: TypeInt64
  , body: GoBlock
      [ GoIfElse (GoBinOp "==" (GoVar "lower") (rawGo "int64(2)")) primePrefix []
      , GoAssign "rejected" (rawGo "make([]bool, upper-lower+1)")
      , GoAssign "total" (GoVar "seed")
      , GoForRange "value := lower; value <= upper; value++"
          [ GoIfElse (GoIndex (GoVar "rejected") (GoBinOp "-" (GoVar "value") (GoVar "lower")))
              [ GoContinue "" ] []
          , GoMutate "total" (GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoCall (GoVar "int32") [ GoBinOp "+" (GoVar "total") (GoVar "value") ] ])
          , GoForRange "multiple := value + value; multiple <= upper; multiple += value"
              [ GoMutate "rejected[multiple-lower]" (GoVar "true") ]
          ]
      , GoReturn (GoVar "total")
      ]
  }

-- The existing admission guard bounds this prefix to at most 1,048,577.
-- Its positive sum and Int32 seed therefore fit Int64 before the final wrap.
-- Even values are excluded by 2; entry i represents the odd value 2*i+1.
-- The local scratch buffer is per invocation and never escapes or aliases.
primePrefix :: Array GoExpr
primePrefix =
  [ rawGo "var local [512]bool"
  , rawGo "var rejected []bool"
  , GoAssign "size" (rawGo "(upper+1)/2")
  , GoIfElse (rawGo "size <= int64(len(local))")
      [ GoMutate "rejected" (rawGo "local[:size]") ]
      [ GoMutate "rejected" (rawGo "make([]bool, size)") ]
  , GoForRange "prime := int64(3); prime*prime <= upper; prime += 2"
      [ GoIfElse (rawGo "!rejected[prime/2]")
          [ GoForRange "multiple := prime*prime; multiple <= upper; multiple += prime+prime"
              [ GoMutate "rejected[multiple/2]" (GoVar "true") ]
          ] []
      ]
  , GoAssign "total" (rawGo "seed+2")
  , GoForRange "value := int64(3); value <= upper; value += 2"
      [ GoIfElse (rawGo "!rejected[value/2]")
          [ GoMutate "total" (GoBinOp "+" (GoVar "total") (GoVar "value")) ] []
      ]
  , GoReturn (rawGo "int64(int32(total))")
  ]

strip :: NeutralExpr -> BackendSyntax NeutralExpr
strip (NeutralExpr syntax) = case syntax of
  Typed _ value -> strip value
  Syn.TypeApp value _ -> strip value
  _ -> syntax

annotation :: NeutralExpr -> Maybe ExprType
annotation (NeutralExpr syntax) = case syntax of
  Typed ty _ -> Just ty
  Syn.TypeApp value _ -> annotation value
  _ -> Nothing

signature :: NeutralExpr -> Maybe { args :: Array ExprType, result :: ExprType }
signature value = flatten <$> annotation value
  where
  flatten (Func args result) = let rest = flatten result in { args: args <> rest.args, result: rest.result }
  flatten result = { args: [], result }

abstractions :: NeutralExpr -> Lambda
abstractions value = case strip value of
  Abs args body -> let rest = abstractions body in { args: NEA.toArray args <> rest.args, body: rest.body }
  _ -> { args: [], body: value }

application :: NeutralExpr -> { head :: NeutralExpr, args :: Array NeutralExpr }
application value = case strip value of
  App fn args -> let prior = application fn in { head: prior.head, args: prior.args <> NEA.toArray args }
  _ -> { head: value, args: [] }

localRef :: NeutralExpr -> Maybe Ref
localRef value = case strip value of
  Local name level -> Just (Tuple name level)
  _ -> Nothing

isLocal :: Ref -> NeutralExpr -> Boolean
isLocal ref value = localRef value == Just ref

global :: ModuleName -> NeutralExpr -> Maybe Ident
global current value = case strip value of
  Var (Qualified owner name) | owner == Just current || owner == Nothing -> Just name
  _ -> Nothing

single :: forall a. Array a -> Maybe a
single [ a ] = Just a
single _ = Nothing

two :: forall a. Array a -> Maybe (Tuple a a)
two [ a, b ] = Just (Tuple a b)
two _ = Nothing

literal :: Int -> NeutralExpr -> Boolean
literal expected value = case strip value of
  Lit (LitInt found) -> expected == found
  _ -> false

scalarValue :: NeutralExpr -> Boolean
scalarValue value = annotation value == Just Int && case strip value of
  Local _ _ -> true
  Lit (LitInt _) -> true
  _ -> false

listShape :: BackendModule -> ExprType -> Maybe Shape
listShape mod ty = do
  info <- case ty of
    ADT full _ args -> Just { full, args }
    _ -> Nothing
  decl <- Array.find (\decl -> unwrap mod.name <> "." <> decl.name == info.full) mod.dataDecls
  guard (Array.length decl.vars == Array.length info.args && all (_ == Int) info.args)
  let variables = Map.fromFoldable (Array.zip decl.vars info.args)
      substitute = case _ of
        TypeVar name -> fromMaybe (TypeVar name) (Map.lookup name variables)
        ADT name path args -> ADT name path (map substitute args)
        other -> other
  Tuple empty cons <- case decl.constructors of
    [ a, b ] | Array.null a.fields -> Just (Tuple a b)
    [ a, b ] | Array.null b.fields -> Just (Tuple b a)
    _ -> Nothing
  guard (map substitute cons.fields == [ Int, ty ])
  pure { ty, empty: Qualified (Just mod.name) (Ident empty.name), cons: Qualified (Just mod.name) (Ident cons.name) }

emptyList :: Shape -> NeutralExpr -> Boolean
emptyList shape value = case strip value of
  CtorSaturated name _ _ _ fields -> name == shape.empty && Array.null fields
  Var name -> name == shape.empty
  _ -> false

field :: Shape -> Ref -> Int -> NeutralExpr -> Boolean
field shape ref index value = case strip value of
  Accessor base (GetCtorField name _ _ _ _ found) -> name == shape.cons && index == found && isLocal ref base
  _ -> false

consFields :: Shape -> NeutralExpr -> Maybe (Tuple NeutralExpr NeutralExpr)
consFields shape value = case strip value of
  CtorSaturated name _ _ _ [ Tuple _ head, Tuple _ tail ] | name == shape.cons -> Just (Tuple head tail)
  _ -> Nothing

listCases :: Shape -> Ref -> NeutralExpr -> Maybe { empty :: NeutralExpr, cons :: NeutralExpr }
listCases shape ref value = case strip value of
  Branch cases failure -> case NEA.toArray cases, strip failure of
    [ Pair nilTest nilBody, Pair consTest consBody ], Fail _
      | tag shape.empty nilTest && tag shape.cons consTest -> Just { empty: nilBody, cons: consBody }
    _, _ -> Nothing
  _ -> Nothing
  where
  tag expected input = case strip input of
    PrimOp (Op1 (OpIsTag found) argument) -> expected == found && isLocal ref argument
    _ -> false

localLoop :: Array ExprType -> ExprType -> NeutralExpr -> Maybe Loop
localLoop args result value = case strip value of
  LetRec level bindings body -> do
    let entry = application body
    self <- localRef entry.head
    selected <- snd <$> Array.find (\(Tuple name _) -> self == Tuple (Just name) level) (NEA.toArray bindings)
    guard (all (not <<< Array.null <<< _.args <<< abstractions <<< snd) bindings)
    found <- signature selected
    guard (found.args == args && found.result == result)
    let lambda = abstractions selected
    guard (Array.length lambda.args == Array.length args)
    pure { self, args: lambda.args, body: lambda.body, initial: entry.args }
  _ -> Nothing

selfCall :: Ref -> NeutralExpr -> Maybe (Array NeutralExpr)
selfCall self value = do
  let call = application value
  guard (isLocal self call.head)
  pure call.args

reverseOf :: Shape -> Ref -> NeutralExpr -> Boolean
reverseOf shape source value = fromMaybe false do
  loop <- localLoop [ shape.ty, shape.ty ] shape.ty value
  Tuple input acc <- two loop.args
  Tuple initial seed <- two loop.initial
  guard (isLocal source initial && emptyList shape seed)
  cases <- listCases shape input loop.body
  guard (isLocal acc cases.empty)
  Tuple tail constructed <- selfCall loop.self cases.cons >>= two
  Tuple head rest <- consFields shape constructed
  pure (field shape input 1 tail && field shape input 0 head && isLocal acc rest)

recognizeFilter :: BackendModule -> NeutralExpr -> Maybe Shape
recognizeFilter mod value = do
  sig <- signature value
  ty <- case sig.args of
    [ Func [ Int ] Boolean, ty ] | ty == sig.result -> Just ty
    _ -> Nothing
  shape <- listShape mod ty
  let lambda = abstractions value
  Tuple predicate source <- two lambda.args
  loop <- localLoop [ ty, ty ] ty lambda.body
  Tuple input acc <- two loop.args
  Tuple initial seed <- two loop.initial
  guard (isLocal source initial && emptyList shape seed)
  cases <- listCases shape input loop.body
  guard (reverseOf shape acc cases.empty)
  branch <- case strip cases.cons of
    Branch choices no -> case NEA.toArray choices of
      [ Pair condition yes ] -> Just { condition, yes, no }
      _ -> Nothing
    _ -> Nothing
  let called = application branch.condition
  argument <- single called.args
  guard (isLocal predicate called.head && field shape input 0 argument)
  Tuple yesTail yesAcc <- selfCall loop.self branch.yes >>= two
  Tuple noTail noAcc <- selfCall loop.self branch.no >>= two
  Tuple head rest <- consFields shape yesAcc
  guard (field shape input 1 yesTail && field shape input 1 noTail)
  guard (field shape input 0 head && isLocal acc rest && isLocal acc noAcc)
  pure shape

recognizeSieve :: BackendModule -> Map.Map Ident Shape -> Ident -> NeutralExpr -> Maybe Shape
recognizeSieve mod filters name value = do
  sig <- signature value
  ty <- single sig.args
  guard (sig.result == ty)
  shape <- listShape mod ty
  let lambda = abstractions value
  input <- single lambda.args
  cases <- listCases shape input lambda.body
  guard (emptyList shape cases.empty)
  head <- case strip cases.cons of
    Let name_ level selected body | field shape input 0 selected -> Just { ref: Tuple name_ level, body }
    _ -> Nothing
  Tuple first rest <- consFields shape head.body
  guard (isLocal head.ref first)
  let recur = application rest
  guard (global mod.name recur.head == Just name)
  filtered <- single recur.args
  let call = application filtered
  filter <- global mod.name call.head >>= flip Map.lookup filters
  guard (filter == shape)
  Tuple predicate tail <- two call.args
  guard (field shape input 1 tail && excludesMultiples head.ref predicate)
  pure shape

-- The only discarded callback is this complete primitive expression. In the
-- guarded positive interval it is pure, total, and equivalent to marking the
-- arithmetic progression. Opaque calls and additional captures are rejected.
excludesMultiples :: Ref -> NeutralExpr -> Boolean
excludesMultiples head value = fromMaybe false do
  sig <- signature value
  guard (sig.args == [ Int ] && sig.result == Boolean)
  let lambda = abstractions value
  item <- single lambda.args
  case strip lambda.body of
    PrimOp (Op1 OpBooleanNot equal) -> case strip equal of
      PrimOp (Op2 (OpIntOrd OpEq) modulo zero) | literal 0 zero -> case strip modulo of
        PrimOp (Op2 (OpIntNum OpMod) x divisor) -> pure (isLocal item x && isLocal head divisor)
        _ -> Nothing
      _ -> Nothing
    _ -> Nothing

recognizeFolder :: BackendModule -> Ref -> NeutralExpr -> Maybe Shape
recognizeFolder mod self value = do
  sig <- signature value
  ty <- case sig.args, sig.result of
    [ ty, Int ], Int -> Just ty
    _, _ -> Nothing
  shape <- listShape mod ty
  let lambda = abstractions value
  Tuple input acc <- two lambda.args
  cases <- listCases shape input lambda.body
  guard (isLocal acc cases.empty)
  Tuple tail total <- selfCall self cases.cons >>= two
  guard (field shape input 1 tail)
  guard case strip total of
    PrimOp (Op2 (OpIntNum OpAdd) old item) -> isLocal acc old && field shape input 0 item
    _ -> false
  pure shape

rangeBounds :: Shape -> NeutralExpr -> Maybe { lower :: NeutralExpr, upper :: NeutralExpr }
rangeBounds shape value = do
  loop <- localLoop [ Int, shape.ty ] shape.ty value
  Tuple counter acc <- two loop.args
  Tuple upper seed <- two loop.initial
  guard (scalarValue upper && emptyList shape seed)
  branch <- case strip loop.body of
    Branch choices step -> case NEA.toArray choices of
      [ Pair condition result ] | isLocal acc result -> Just { condition, step }
      _ -> Nothing
    _ -> Nothing
  lower <- case strip branch.condition of
    PrimOp (Op2 (OpIntOrd OpLt) current lower) | isLocal counter current && scalarValue lower -> Just lower
    _ -> Nothing
  -- A bound referencing either loop argument is not invariant or available
  -- at its call site. Only already evaluated enclosing values may be captured.
  guard (not (isLocal counter lower || isLocal acc lower || isLocal loop.self lower))
  Tuple next built <- selfCall loop.self branch.step >>= two
  guard case strip next of
    PrimOp (Op2 (OpIntNum OpSubtract) current amount) -> isLocal counter current && literal 1 amount
    _ -> false
  Tuple head tail <- consFields shape built
  guard (isLocal counter head && isLocal acc tail)
  pure { lower, upper }

rewrite :: Context -> NeutralExpr -> State Boolean NeutralExpr
rewrite context original@(NeutralExpr syntax) = case fuse context original of
  Just replacement -> put true *> pure replacement
  Nothing -> case syntax of
    LetRec level bindings body -> do
      let locals = Map.union (Map.fromFoldable (map (\(Tuple name value) -> Tuple (Tuple (Just name) level) value) (NEA.toArray bindings))) context.locals
          nested = context { locals = locals }
      rewritten <- traverse (\(Tuple name value) -> Tuple name <$> rewrite nested value) bindings
      rest <- rewrite nested body
      pure (NeutralExpr (LetRec level rewritten rest))
    Abs args body ->
      let locals = foldl (flip Map.delete) context.locals args
      in NeutralExpr <<< Abs args <$> rewrite (context { locals = locals }) body
    UncurriedAbs args body ->
      let locals = foldl (flip Map.delete) context.locals args
      in NeutralExpr <<< UncurriedAbs args <$> rewrite (context { locals = locals }) body
    UncurriedEffectAbs args body ->
      let locals = foldl (flip Map.delete) context.locals args
      in NeutralExpr <<< UncurriedEffectAbs args <$> rewrite (context { locals = locals }) body
    Let name level value body -> do
      next <- rewrite context value
      rest <- rewrite (context { locals = Map.delete (Tuple name level) context.locals }) body
      pure (NeutralExpr (Let name level next rest))
    EffectBind name level value body -> do
      next <- rewrite context value
      rest <- rewrite (context { locals = Map.delete (Tuple name level) context.locals }) body
      pure (NeutralExpr (EffectBind name level next rest))
    _ -> NeutralExpr <$> traverse (rewrite context) syntax

fuse :: Context -> NeutralExpr -> Maybe NeutralExpr
fuse context original = do
  let call = application original
  self <- localRef call.head
  folder <- Map.lookup self context.locals
  shape <- recognizeFolder context.module_ self folder
  Tuple source seed <- two call.args
  guard (scalarValue seed)
  let recur = application source
  selected <- global context.module_.name recur.head >>= flip Map.lookup context.sieves
  guard (selected == shape)
  produced <- single recur.args
  bounds <- rangeBounds shape produced

      upper = bounds.upper
      integer n = typed Int (NeutralExpr (Lit (LitInt n)))
      binary ty op a b = typed ty (NeutralExpr (PrimOp (Op2 op a b)))
      compare op = binary Boolean (OpIntOrd op)
      both = binary Boolean OpBooleanAnd
      tests =
        [ compare OpGte lower (integer 2)
        , compare OpGte upper lower
        , compare OpLte upper (integer 2147483647)
        , compare OpLte (binary Int (OpIntNum OpSubtract) upper lower) (integer 1048575)
        , compare OpGte seed (integer (-2147483647 - 1))
        , compare OpLte seed (integer 2147483647)
        ]
      condition = Array.foldr both (typed Boolean (NeutralExpr (Lit (LitBoolean true)))) tests
      worker = typed (Func [ Int, Int, Int ] Int) (NeutralExpr (Var (Qualified (Just context.module_.name) context.helper)))
      fast = typed Int (NeutralExpr (App worker (NEA.cons' lower [ upper, seed ])))
  -- Keep the original application and its scopes verbatim in the fallback.
  -- All duplicated operands are already evaluated locals or literal values.
  pure (typed Int (NeutralExpr (Branch (NEA.singleton (Pair condition fast)) original)))

typed :: ExprType -> NeutralExpr -> NeutralExpr
typed ty = NeutralExpr <<< Typed ty

"""Compare the actual dynamic-input loop proofs across frozen builds."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json
W=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
rows={};data=[]
for side in ['before','after']:
 d=W/'proofs'/('loop-inputs-'+side);m=json.loads((d/'manifest.json').read_text())
 assert m['status']=='passed' and m['side']==side
 assert m['prime_cases']==265 and m['tco_cases']==88 and m['actual_default_actions']==2
 assert m['tco_paths']==['native','boxed Apply2']
 for p,h in m['frozen_files'].items():assert sha(p)==h,(side,p)
 for p,h in m['artifacts'].items():assert sha(d/p)==h,(side,p)
 assert not (d/'stderr.txt').read_bytes()
 current={n:(d/n).read_bytes() for n in ['inputs.json','stdout.txt']};data.append(current)
 assert len(json.loads(current['inputs.json']))==353
 rows[side]={'manifest_sha256':sha(d/'manifest.json'),'inputs_sha256':sha(d/'inputs.json'),'stdout_sha256':sha(d/'stdout.txt'),'benchmark_sha256':sha(W/(side+'-core')/'benchmark')}
assert data[0]==data[1]
r={'status':'passed','prime_cases_per_build':265,'tco_cases_per_build':88,'tco_paths':['native','boxed Apply2'],'default_actions_per_build':2,'identical_inputs_and_stdout':True,'rows':rows}

module Gopurs.ControlExprs
  ( failure
  , branch
  , branchWith
  , booleanAnd
  , booleanOr
  ) where

import Prelude
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Array.NonEmpty (NonEmptyArray, toArray)
import Data.Foldable (foldl)
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..), fromMaybe)
import Gopurs.ExprAnalysis (getExprType, unwrapTcoExpr)
import Gopurs.ExprContext (ExprContext, ExprResult, TranslateExpr, StmtTree(..), flattenStmts)
import Gopurs.GoAst (rawGo, GoExpr(..), GoType(..), goTypeToStr)
import Gopurs.GoConversions (coerceGoExpr, unboxGoExpr)
import Gopurs.GoTypes (exprTypeToGoType)
import Gopurs.Printer (printGoExpr)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco (TcoExpr)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (ExprType(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendSyntax(Fail), Pair(..))

failure :: ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> String -> ExprResult
failure { metadata, modNameStr, mbExpectedExprType, mbExpectedGoType } nextId tcoExpr msg =
  let
    expectedGoType = fromMaybe inferredGoType mbExpectedGoType
    inferredGoType = exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr
      ( case getExprType tcoExpr of
          Any -> fromMaybe Any mbExpectedExprType
          ty -> ty
      )
    expectedGoTypeStr = goTypeToStr expectedGoType
  in
    { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: rawGo ("func() " <> expectedGoTypeStr <> " { panic(" <> printGoExpr (GoString msg) <> ") }()"), exprType: expectedGoType, nextId }

branch :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> NonEmptyArray (Pair TcoExpr) -> TcoExpr -> ExprResult
branch translate = branchWith translate translate

-- Conditions always use the ordinary translator. A consumer which is already
-- executing the selected result may supply a distinct translator for bodies.
branchWith :: TranslateExpr -> TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> NonEmptyArray (Pair TcoExpr) -> TcoExpr -> ExprResult
branchWith translate translateBody context@{ codegenStateRef, depth, modNameStr, mbExpectedGoType, options: { isTail } } nextId branches def =
  let
    resDef = translateBody (context { depth = (depth + 1), tcoIdent = Nothing, options = { isTail, inEffectBlock: false } }) nextId def

    computedBranches = foldl
      ( \acc (Pair condExpr bodyExpr) ->
          let
            resCond = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), tcoIdent = Nothing, loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) acc.nextId condExpr
            resBody = translateBody (context { depth = (depth + 1), tcoIdent = Nothing, options = { isTail, inEffectBlock: false } }) resCond.nextId bodyExpr
          in
            { nextId: resBody.nextId, results: acc.results <> [ { cond: resCond, body: resBody } ] }
      )
      { nextId: resDef.nextId, results: [] }
      (toArray branches)

    isFailNode = case unwrapTcoExpr def of
      Fail _ -> true
      _ -> false

    allTypes = (if isFailNode then [] else [ resDef.exprType ]) <> map (\r -> r.body.exprType) computedBranches.results

    hasTypeValue = Array.any
      ( \t -> case t of
          TypeValue -> true
          _ -> false
      )
      allTypes

    -- The consumer fixes the join representation when its ABI is known.
    -- Generic branches adapt at their exit; native branches then avoid a
    -- structural box/unbox round trip through the shared result slot.
    expectedGoType = fromMaybe inferredGoType mbExpectedGoType

    inferredGoType =
      if hasTypeValue then TypeValue
      else
        let
          nubbed = Array.nub (map goTypeToStr allTypes)
        in
          if Array.length nubbed == 1 then fromMaybe TypeValue (Array.head allTypes)
          else TypeValue

    tmpVar = "__t" <> show computedBranches.nextId
    declTmp = StmtLeaf (rawGo ("var " <> tmpVar <> " " <> goTypeToStr expectedGoType))
    labelName = "end_branch_" <> show computedBranches.nextId

    buildIfs = foldl
      ( \acc r ->
          let
            goIf = GoIfElse (unboxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr r.cond.expr r.cond.exprType TypeBool) (flattenStmts r.body.stmts <> [ GoMutate tmpVar (coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr r.body.expr r.body.exprType expectedGoType), rawGo ("goto " <> labelName) ]) []
          in
            acc <> StmtLeaf (rawGo "{") <> r.cond.stmts <> StmtLeaf goIf <> StmtLeaf (rawGo "}")
      )
      StmtEmpty
      computedBranches.results
  in
    { stmts: declTmp <> buildIfs <> StmtLeaf (rawGo "{") <> resDef.stmts <> StmtLeaf (GoMutate tmpVar (coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resDef.expr resDef.exprType expectedGoType)) <> StmtLeaf (rawGo "}") <> StmtLeaf (rawGo (labelName <> ":")), expr: GoVar tmpVar, exprType: expectedGoType, nextId: computedBranches.nextId + 1 }

booleanAnd :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> TcoExpr -> ExprResult
booleanAnd translate context@{ codegenStateRef, depth, modNameStr } nextId e1 e2 =
  let
    res1 = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), tcoIdent = Nothing, loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) nextId e1
    res2 = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), tcoIdent = Nothing, loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) res1.nextId e2
  in
    if isEmptyStmts res2.stmts then
      { expr: GoBinOp "&&" (unboxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr res1.expr res1.exprType TypeBool) (unboxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr res2.expr res2.exprType TypeBool), exprType: TypeBool, stmts: res1.stmts <> res2.stmts, nextId: res2.nextId }
    else
      let
        tmpVar = "__t_and_" <> show res2.nextId
        declTmp = StmtLeaf (rawGo ("var " <> tmpVar <> " bool = false\nif " <> printGoExpr (unboxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr res1.expr res1.exprType TypeBool) <> " {\n"))
        assignTmp = StmtLeaf (rawGo (tmpVar <> " = " <> printGoExpr (unboxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr res2.expr res2.exprType TypeBool) <> "\n}"))
      in
        { expr: rawGo tmpVar, exprType: TypeBool, stmts: res1.stmts <> declTmp <> res2.stmts <> assignTmp, nextId: res2.nextId + 1 }

booleanOr :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> TcoExpr -> ExprResult
booleanOr translate context@{ codegenStateRef, depth, modNameStr } nextId e1 e2 =
  let
    res1 = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), tcoIdent = Nothing, loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) nextId e1
    res2 = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), tcoIdent = Nothing, loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) res1.nextId e2
  in
    if isEmptyStmts res2.stmts then
      { expr: GoBinOp "||" (unboxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr res1.expr res1.exprType TypeBool) (unboxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr res2.expr res2.exprType TypeBool), exprType: TypeBool, stmts: res1.stmts <> res2.stmts, nextId: res2.nextId }
    else
      let
        tmpVar = "__t_or_" <> show res2.nextId
        declTmp = StmtLeaf (rawGo ("var " <> tmpVar <> " bool = true\nif !(" <> printGoExpr (unboxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr res1.expr res1.exprType TypeBool) <> ") {\n"))
        assignTmp = StmtLeaf (rawGo (tmpVar <> " = " <> printGoExpr (unboxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr res2.expr res2.exprType TypeBool) <> "\n}"))
      in
        { expr: rawGo tmpVar, exprType: TypeBool, stmts: res1.stmts <> declTmp <> res2.stmts <> assignTmp, nextId: res2.nextId + 1 }

isEmptyStmts :: StmtTree -> Boolean
isEmptyStmts StmtEmpty = true
isEmptyStmts (StmtAppend s1 s2) = isEmptyStmts s1 && isEmptyStmts s2
isEmptyStmts _ = false

module Gopurs.EffectExprs
  ( bindEffect
  , pureValue
  , defer
  , primitive
  , wrap
  , wrapCachedInt
  ) where

import Prelude
import Control.Alternative (guard)
import Data.Map as Map
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..))
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..))
import Gopurs.ExprAnalysis (executeIfOpaque, getExprType, isEffectNode, unwrapTcoExpr)
import Gopurs.ExprContext (ExprContext, ExprResult, TranslateExpr, StmtTree(..), flattenStmts)
import Gopurs.GoAst (GoExpr(..), GoType(..))
import Gopurs.GoConversions (boxGoExpr)
import Gopurs.ImmediateFfiEffects as ImmediateFfiEffects
import Gopurs.ImmediateEffectBranches as ImmediateEffectBranches
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco (TcoExpr(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (ExprType(..), Ident)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.FreeVars (localId)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendEffect(..), BackendSyntax(Abs, EffectDefer, Let, LetRec), Level)

bindEffect :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> Maybe Ident -> Level -> TcoExpr -> TcoExpr -> ExprResult
bindEffect translate context nextId mbIdent lvl binding body =
  case ImmediateFfiEffects.direct translate context nextId mbIdent lvl binding body of
    Just result -> result
    Nothing -> ordinaryBind translate context nextId mbIdent lvl binding body

ordinaryBind :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> Maybe Ident -> Level -> TcoExpr -> TcoExpr -> ExprResult
ordinaryBind translate context@{ codegenStateRef, depth, modNameStr, bound, options: { isTail } } nextId mbIdent lvl binding body =
  let
    stripEffectDefer (TcoExpr a syn) = case unwrapTcoExpr (TcoExpr a syn) of
      EffectDefer inner -> let Tuple _ i = stripEffectDefer inner in Tuple true i
      Abs _ inner -> let Tuple _ i = stripEffectDefer inner in Tuple true i
      Let ident lvl_ val body_ -> let Tuple stripped i = stripEffectDefer body_ in Tuple stripped (TcoExpr a (Let ident lvl_ val i))
      LetRec lvl_ bindings_ body_ -> let Tuple stripped i = stripEffectDefer body_ in Tuple stripped (TcoExpr a (LetRec lvl_ bindings_ i))
      _ -> Tuple false (TcoExpr a syn)
    Tuple wasStripped realBinding = stripEffectDefer binding
    originalName = localId mbIdent lvl
    name = originalName <> "_" <> show nextId
    newBound = Map.insert originalName { name, goType: TypeValue } bound
    resBinding = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), tcoIdent = Nothing, loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: true }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) (nextId + 1) realBinding
    bodyContext = context { depth = (depth + 1), bound = newBound, tcoIdent = Nothing, options = { isTail, inEffectBlock: true } }
    executedBody = ImmediateEffectBranches.emit translate bodyContext resBinding.nextId body
    resBody = case executedBody of
      Just result -> result
      Nothing -> translate bodyContext resBinding.nextId body
    bindingExpr = if wasStripped then boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resBinding.expr resBinding.exprType else executeIfOpaque realBinding (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resBinding.expr resBinding.exprType)
    bodyExpr = case executedBody of
      Just _ -> resBody.expr
      Nothing -> executeIfOpaque body resBody.expr
  in
    { stmts: resBinding.stmts <> StmtLeaf (GoAssign name bindingExpr) <> resBody.stmts, expr: bodyExpr, exprType: resBody.exprType, nextId: resBody.nextId }

pureValue :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> ExprResult
pureValue translate context@{ depth } nextId binding =
  translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), tcoIdent = Nothing, loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) nextId binding

defer :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> ExprResult
defer translate context@{ codegenStateRef, depth, modNameStr } nextId binding =
  let
    resBinding = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), tcoIdent = Nothing, loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: true }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) nextId binding
    funcExpr = GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Func")
      [ GoFuncBlock [ Tuple "_" TypeValue ]
          (flattenStmts resBinding.stmts <> [ GoReturn (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resBinding.expr resBinding.exprType) ])
          TypeValue
      ]
  in
    { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: funcExpr, exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resBinding.nextId }

primitive :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> BackendEffect TcoExpr -> ExprResult
primitive translate context@{ codegenStateRef, depth, modNameStr } nextId eff =
  case eff of
  EffectRefNew a ->
    let
      resA = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), tcoIdent = Nothing, loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) nextId a
    in
      { stmts: resA.stmts
      , expr: GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "NewSTRef")
          [ boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resA.expr resA.exprType ]
      , exprType: TypeValue
      , nextId: resA.nextId + 1
      }
  EffectRefRead a ->
    let
      resA = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), tcoIdent = Nothing, loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) nextId a
    in
      { stmts: resA.stmts
      , expr: GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "ReadSTRef")
          [ boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resA.expr resA.exprType ]
      , exprType: TypeValue
      , nextId: resA.nextId
      }
  EffectRefWrite ref val ->
    let
      resRef = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), tcoIdent = Nothing, loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) nextId ref
      resVal = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), tcoIdent = Nothing, loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) resRef.nextId val
    in
      { stmts: resRef.stmts <> resVal.stmts
      , expr: GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "WriteSTRef")
          [ boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resRef.expr resRef.exprType
          , boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resVal.expr resVal.exprType
          ]
      , exprType: TypeValue
      , nextId: resVal.nextId
      }

wrap :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> ExprResult
wrap translate context nextId tcoExpr =
  let
    res = translate (context { options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: true }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) nextId tcoExpr
  in
    { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: boxedAction context res, exprType: TypeValue, nextId: res.nextId }

-- ModuleBindings calls this only for values initialized by a cached getter.
-- Match exactly the effect syntax wrap already defers: aliases, factories and
-- EffectDefer retain their existing construction/evaluation boundaries.
wrapCachedInt :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> Maybe ExprResult
wrapCachedInt translate context nextId expression = do
  case getExprType expression of
    ADT "Effect.Effect" _ [ Int ] -> pure unit
    _ -> Nothing
  guard (isEffectNode expression)
  let
    result = translate (context { options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: true }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) nextId expression
    -- Translate once, retaining the original boxed body as an independent
    -- entry point. Each invocation executes exactly one of these bodies.
    nativeResult = case result.exprType, result.expr of
      TypeInt64, value -> Just value
      TypeValue, GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Int") [ value ] -> Just value
      _, _ -> Nothing
    action = case nativeResult of
      Just value ->
        let native = GoFuncBlock [] (flattenStmts result.stmts <> [ GoReturn value ]) TypeInt64
        in GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "WithFunctionData") [ boxedAction context result, native ]
      -- Boxed dynamic results retain the FFI's complete Unbox semantics.
      -- Reuse this translation even when it cannot provide a native entry.
      Nothing -> boxedAction context result
  pure { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: action, exprType: TypeValue, nextId: result.nextId }

boxedAction :: ExprContext -> ExprResult -> GoExpr
boxedAction { codegenStateRef, modNameStr } result =
  GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Func")
    [ GoFuncBlock [ Tuple "_" TypeValue ]
        (flattenStmts result.stmts <> [ GoReturn (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr result.expr result.exprType) ])
        TypeValue
    ]

module Gopurs.ImmediateEffectBranches (emit) where

import Prelude

import Control.Alternative (guard)
import Data.Foldable (any)
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..))
import Gopurs.ControlExprs as ControlExprs
import Gopurs.ExprAnalysis (isEffectNode, unwrapTcoExpr)
import Gopurs.ExprContext (ExprContext, ExprResult, TranslateExpr)
import Gopurs.GoAst (GoExpr(..), GoType(..), rawGo)
import Gopurs.GoConversions (boxGoExpr)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco (TcoExpr)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendSyntax(Branch), Pair(..))

-- Called only where ordinaryBind would immediately Apply the selected action.
-- It does not rewrite branch values saved for later execution. Known effect
-- nodes use exactly the context normally used inside EffectExprs.wrap; other
-- leaves retain their original construction and one runtime Apply. Conditions
-- keep their original order, short circuiting and ordinary translation.
emit :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> Maybe ExprResult
emit translate context nextId expression = case unwrapTcoExpr expression of
  Branch branches otherwise -> do
    guard (benefits expression)
    let joined = context { mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Just TypeValue }
    pure (ControlExprs.branchWith translate (execute translate) joined nextId branches otherwise)
  _ -> Nothing

benefits :: TcoExpr -> Boolean
benefits expression = case unwrapTcoExpr expression of
  Branch branches otherwise -> any (\(Pair _ body) -> benefits body) branches || benefits otherwise
  _ -> isEffectNode expression

execute :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> ExprResult
execute translate context nextId expression = case emit translate context nextId expression of
  Just result -> result
  Nothing ->
    let
      known = isEffectNode expression
      -- EffectExprs.wrap clears these expected types and disables tail calls
      -- inside its closure. Keep that same boundary when removing the closure.
      translated = translate (context
        { options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: known }
        , mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) nextId expression
      boxed = boxGoExpr context.codegenStateRef context.modNameStr translated.expr translated.exprType
      result = if known then boxed else GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Apply")
        [ boxed, rawGo "gopurs_runtime.Value{}" ]
    in translated { expr = result, exprType = TypeValue }

module Main where

-- @dependencies: prelude effect console refs exceptions either foldable-traversable
-- @inline Main.choose never
-- @inline Main.nested never
-- @inline Main.factory never
-- @inline Main.condition never
-- @inline Main.makeSaved never
-- @inline Main.returned never

import Prelude
import Data.Either (isLeft)
import Data.Foldable (for_)
import Effect (Effect)
import Effect.Console (log, logShow)
import Effect.Exception (throw, try)
import Effect.Ref as Ref
import Effect.Unsafe (unsafePerformEffect)

tick :: forall a. Ref.Ref String -> String -> a -> Effect a
tick trace label value = do
  Ref.modify_ (_ <> label) trace
  pure value

condition :: Ref.Ref String -> String -> Boolean -> Boolean
condition trace label value = unsafePerformEffect (tick trace label value)

factory :: Ref.Ref String -> String -> Int -> Effect Int
factory trace label value = unsafePerformEffect do
  _ <- tick trace ("F" <> label) unit
  pure (tick trace ("E" <> label) value)

choose :: Ref.Ref String -> Ref.Ref Boolean -> Effect Int
choose trace flag = do
  selected <- Ref.read flag
  if condition trace "C" selected then pure 7 else factory trace "U" 19

nested :: Ref.Ref String -> Ref.Ref Boolean -> Effect Int
nested trace flag = do
  selected <- Ref.read flag
  if condition trace "A" selected then pure 11
  else if condition trace "B" (not selected) then tick trace "K" 22
  else factory trace "N" 33

makeSaved :: Ref.Ref String -> Ref.Ref Boolean -> Effect (Effect Int)
makeSaved trace flag = do
  selected <- Ref.read flag
  pending <- if condition trace "S" selected then do
    _ <- tick trace "FP" unit
    pure (tick trace "EP" 41)
    else do
      _ <- tick trace "FQ" unit
      pure (tick trace "EQ" 43)
  _ <- tick trace "D" unit
  pure pending

returned :: Ref.Ref String -> Ref.Ref Boolean -> Effect (Effect Int)
returned trace flag = do
  selected <- Ref.read flag
  if condition trace "R" selected then pure (tick trace "I" 51) else pure (factory trace "J" 53)

failing :: Ref.Ref String -> Ref.Ref Boolean -> Effect Int
failing trace flag = do
  selected <- Ref.read flag
  if unsafePerformEffect (do
    _ <- tick trace "X" unit
    if selected then throw "condition marker" else pure false)
    then pure 1
    else factory trace "Z" 2

main :: Effect Unit
main = do
  trace <- Ref.new ""
  for_ [ true, false ] \initial -> do
    flag <- Ref.new initial
    for_ [ 0, 1, 2 ] \_ -> do
      Ref.write "" trace
      a <- choose trace flag
      b <- nested trace flag
      logShow [ a, b ]
      Ref.read trace >>= log
    Ref.write "" trace
    saved <- makeSaved trace flag
    Ref.read trace >>= log
    logShow =<< saved
    logShow =<< saved
    Ref.read trace >>= log
    Ref.write "" trace
    inner <- returned trace flag
    Ref.read trace >>= log
    logShow =<< inner
    logShow =<< inner
    Ref.read trace >>= log
    Ref.write "" trace
    result <- try (failing trace flag)
    logShow (isLeft result)
    Ref.read trace >>= log
