@@ -0,0 +1,121 @@
+module Gopurs.ArrayProducerFold (emit, onlyCurried) where
+
+import Prelude
+
+import Control.Alternative (guard)
+import Control.Monad.State (evalState)
+import Data.Array as Array
+import Data.Array.NonEmpty as NEA
+import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..), fromMaybe)
+import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..))
+import Gopurs.ArrayIndexedFold (readOnlyScalar)
+import Gopurs.ArrayIntrinsics.Source (arraySource)
+import Gopurs.CallAnalysis (collectCurriedAbs, collectGoSpine, getGoSpineArgs, qualifiedTarget)
+import Gopurs.CallArguments as CallArguments
+import Gopurs.ClosedIndexedFolds (closedPrimitiveCallback, validDescriptor)
+import Gopurs.CodegenState (ArrayFoldDescriptor)
+import Gopurs.ExprAnalysis (extractFuncType, getExprType, unwrapTcoExpr)
+import Gopurs.ExprContext (ExprContext, ExprResult, StmtTree(..), TranslateExpr, bindParameters, childContext, flattenStmts)
+import Gopurs.GoAst (GoExpr(..), GoType(..), rawGo)
+import Gopurs.GoConversions (coerceGoExpr)
+import Gopurs.ImmediateApplications.Scope (freshen, maximumLevel)
+import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco (TcoExpr(..))
+import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco as Tco
+import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (ExprType(Array, Int), ModuleName(..))
+import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.FreeVars (localId)
+import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Semantics (NeutralExpr(..))
+import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendSyntax(..))
+
+-- Only an immediate producer is removed. Both callbacks are closed primitive
+-- scalar lambdas; unknown calls, captures and shared produced arrays keep their
+-- original path. The input buffers are read without mutation or ownership claims.
+emit :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> ArrayFoldDescriptor -> TcoExpr -> Maybe ExprResult
+emit translate context nextId descriptor producer = do
+  guard (Array.null context.recVars && validDescriptor descriptor && onlyCurried producer)
+  guard (getExprType producer == Array Int)
+  let Tuple function spine = collectGoSpine producer
+  target <- qualifiedTarget function
+  let arguments = getGoSpineArgs spine
+  plan <- if target.mbMod == Just (ModuleName "Data.Semigroup") && target.name == "concatArray" then do
+    guard (Array.length arguments == 2)
+    pure { mapped: false, arguments }
+    else if target.mbMod == Just (ModuleName "Data.Functor") && target.name == "arrayMap" then do
+      guard (Array.length arguments == 2)
+      callback <- Array.head arguments
+      signature <- extractFuncType callback
+      guard (signature.fArgs == [ Int ] && signature.fRet == Int && closedPrimitiveCallback 1 (neutral callback))
+      case unwrapTcoExpr callback of
+        Abs parameters body -> do
+          let grouped = collectCurriedAbs parameters body
+          guard (NEA.length grouped.args == 1 && readOnlyScalar (map (\(Tuple _ level) -> level) (NEA.toArray grouped.args)) grouped.body)
+          pure { mapped: true, arguments }
+        _ -> Nothing
+      else Nothing
+  let
+    -- Imported levels are alpha-renamed independently for every insertion.
+    -- The closed callback has no free references to reinterpret in this module.
+    start = max (maximumLevel (neutral producer)) (maximumLevel descriptor.callback) + nextId + 1
+    foldedCallback = Tco.analyze [] (evalState (freshen descriptor.callback) start)
+    nativeLambda currentId callback = case unwrapTcoExpr callback of
+      Abs parameters callbackBody ->
+        let
+          grouped = collectCurriedAbs parameters callbackBody
+          params = map (\(Tuple name level) -> Tuple (localId name level) TypeInt64) (NEA.toArray grouped.args)
+          callbackContext = context
+            { depth = context.depth + 1, bound = bindParameters params context.bound
+            , tcoIdent = Nothing, loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: true, inEffectBlock: false }
+            , mbExpectedExprType = Just Int, mbExpectedGoType = Just TypeInt64 }
+          result = translate callbackContext currentId grouped.body
+        in { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: GoFuncLit params (flattenStmts result.stmts) (integer result.expr result.exprType) TypeInt64
+           , exprType: TypeFunc (map (const TypeInt64) params) TypeInt64, nextId: result.nextId }
+      _ -> { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: rawGo "nil", exprType: TypeValue, nextId: currentId }
+    -- An adjacent closed mapper is captured before its input. Concat captures
+    -- both input expressions before either source buffer is inspected.
+    captured = CallArguments.capture { prefix: "arrayProducer_arg_", markUsed: false }
+      (\index currentId argument -> if plan.mapped && index == 0 then nativeLambda currentId argument
+        else translate (childContext context Nothing) currentId argument) nextId plan.arguments
+    folding = nativeLambda captured.nextId foldedCallback
+    suffix = show folding.nextId
+    variable label = "arrayProducer_" <> label <> "_" <> suffix
+    callbackName = variable "fold"
+    resultName = variable "result"
+    indexName = variable "index"
+    valueName = variable "value"
+    offsetName = variable "offset"
+    arg index = fromMaybe (rawGo "nil") (Array.index captured.exprs index)
+    source index =
+      let inputName = case arg index of
+            GoVar name -> name
+            _ -> ""
+      in arraySource inputName (variable ("source" <> show index)) (fromMaybe TypeValue (Array.index captured.exprTypes index))
+    left = source (if plan.mapped then 1 else 0)
+    right = source 1
+    loop sourceInfo offset = GoForRange (indexName <> ", " <> valueName <> " := range " <> sourceInfo.target)
+      [ GoMutate resultName (GoCall (GoVar callbackName)
+          [ GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoBinOp "+" offset (GoVar indexName) ]
+          , GoVar resultName
+          , if plan.mapped then GoCall (arg 0) [ integer (GoVar valueName) sourceInfo.elementType ]
+            else integer (GoVar valueName) sourceInfo.elementType
+          ]) ]
+    body = [ GoAssign callbackName folding.expr, GoAssign resultName (GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoInt descriptor.seed ]), left.assignment ] <>
+      (if plan.mapped then [ loop left (GoInt 0) ] else
+        [ right.assignment, GoAssign offsetName (GoCall (GoVar "len") [ rawGo left.target ])
+        , loop left (GoInt 0), loop right (GoVar offsetName) ])
+  pure { stmts: captured.stmts, expr: GoCall (GoFuncLit [] body (GoVar resultName) TypeInt64) []
+       , exprType: TypeInt64, nextId: folding.nextId + 1 }
+  where
+  integer expression from = coerceGoExpr context.codegenStateRef context.modNameStr expression from TypeInt64
+
+neutral :: TcoExpr -> NeutralExpr
+neutral (TcoExpr _ syntax) = NeutralExpr (map neutral syntax)
+
+-- An uncurried/staged invocation is a separate observable boundary. The broad
+-- spine collector must not erase it when recognizing a saturated producer.
+onlyCurried :: TcoExpr -> Boolean
+onlyCurried (TcoExpr _ syntax) = case syntax of
+  App function _ -> onlyCurried function
+  Typed _ value -> onlyCurried value
+  TypeApp value _ -> onlyCurried value
+  UncurriedApp _ _ -> false
+  UncurriedEffectApp _ _ -> false
+  _ -> true

+module Gopurs.ArrayTraverseFold (emit, justMapper) where
+
+import Prelude
+
+import Control.Alternative (guard)
+import Control.Monad.State (evalState)
+import Data.Array as Array
+import Data.Array.NonEmpty as NEA
+import Data.Foldable (foldM)
+import Data.Map as Map
+import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..), fromMaybe, isJust)
+import Data.Newtype (unwrap)
+import Data.String as String
+import Data.String.Pattern (Pattern(..), Replacement(..))
+import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..))
+import Gopurs.ArrayIntrinsics.Source (arraySource)
+import Gopurs.ArrayProducerFold (onlyCurried)
+import Gopurs.ArrayTraverse (recognizeMaybe)
+import Gopurs.ArrayTraverseTotal (totalIntegerMaybe)
+import Gopurs.CallAnalysis (collectCurriedAbs, collectGoSpine, getGoSpineArgs, qualifiedTarget)
+import Gopurs.CallArguments as CallArguments
+import Gopurs.ClosedIndexedFolds (closedPrimitiveCallback, validDescriptor)
+import Gopurs.CodegenState (ArrayFoldDescriptor)
+import Gopurs.ExprAnalysis (extractFuncType, unwrapTcoExpr)
+import Gopurs.ExprContext (ExprContext, ExprResult, StmtTree(..), TranslateExpr, bindParameters, childContext, flattenStmts)
+import Gopurs.GoAst (GoExpr(..), GoType(..), rawGo)
+import Gopurs.GoConversions (coerceGoExpr)
+import Gopurs.ImmediateApplications.Scope (freshen, maximumLevel)
+import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco (TcoExpr(..))
+import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco as Tco
+import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (ExprType(..), Ident(..), ModuleName(..), ProperName(..), Qualified(..))
+import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn as CoreFn
+import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.FreeVars (localId)
+import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Semantics (NeutralExpr(..))
+import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendAccessor(..), BackendOperator(..), BackendOperator1(..), BackendSyntax(..), Level, Pair(..))
+import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax as Syntax
+
+maybeInt :: ExprType
+maybeInt = ADT "Data.Maybe.Maybe" [ "Data", "Maybe", "Maybe" ] [ Int ]
+
+-- The callback must construct Just directly. Its payload is then checked by
+-- the existing closed scalar proof, including every nested Typed annotation.
+-- Nothing/branches/captures/foreign calls retain the ordinary traversal.
+justMapper :: Int -> TcoExpr -> Maybe NeutralExpr
+justMapper arity callback = do
+  signature <- extractFuncType callback
+  guard (signature.fArgs == Array.replicate arity Int && signature.fRet == maybeInt)
+  case unwrapTcoExpr callback of
+    Abs parameters body -> do
+      let grouped = collectCurriedAbs parameters body
+      guard (NEA.length grouped.args == arity && totalIntegerMaybe (map (\(Tuple _ level) -> level) (NEA.toArray grouped.args)) grouped.body)
+    _ -> Nothing
+  mapped <- convert arity callback
+  guard (closedPrimitiveCallback arity mapped)
+  pure mapped
+  where
+  convert remaining value = do
+    guard (annotated (Func (Array.replicate remaining Int) maybeInt) value)
+    case unwrapTcoExpr value of
+      Abs parameters body -> do
+        let count = NEA.length parameters
+        guard (count <= remaining)
+        scalar <- if count < remaining then convert (remaining - count) body else do
+          guard (annotated maybeInt body)
+          case unwrapTcoExpr body of
+            CtorSaturated (Qualified (Just (ModuleName "Data.Maybe")) (Ident "Just")) _ (ProperName "Maybe") (Ident "Just") [ Tuple _ payload ] ->
+              pure (neutral payload)
+            _ -> Nothing
+        pure (NeutralExpr (Typed (Func (Array.replicate remaining Int) Int) (NeutralExpr (Abs parameters scalar))))
+      _ -> Nothing
+
+-- TAST can retain generic m (t b) around a canonical traversal. Refine those
+-- transparent applications against the proved result, but reject any concrete
+-- contradiction, including nested Maybe String under an outer Maybe Int.
+annotated :: ExprType -> TcoExpr -> Boolean
+annotated expected (TcoExpr _ syntax) = case syntax of
+  Typed actual value -> compatible expected actual && annotated expected value
+  Syntax.TypeApp value _ -> annotated expected value
+  _ -> true
+
+compatible :: ExprType -> ExprType -> Boolean
+compatible expected actual = isJust (refine expected actual Map.empty)
+
+refine :: ExprType -> ExprType -> Map.Map String ExprType -> Maybe (Map.Map String ExprType)
+refine expected actual variables = case expected, actual of
+  _, Any -> Just variables
+  _, TypeVar name -> bindVariable name expected variables
+  Array wanted, Array supplied -> refine wanted supplied variables
+  Array wanted, ADT "Prim.Array" [ "Prim", "Array" ] [ supplied ] -> refine wanted supplied variables
+  Array wanted, CoreFn.TypeApp (TypeVar name) [ supplied ] -> do
+    known <- bindVariable name (ADT "Prim.Array" [ "Prim", "Array" ] []) variables
+    refine wanted supplied known
+  ADT name path arguments, ADT suppliedName suppliedPath suppliedArguments -> do
+    guard (name == suppliedName && path == suppliedPath)
+    sameArguments arguments suppliedArguments variables
+  ADT name path [ wanted ], CoreFn.TypeApp (TypeVar variable) [ supplied ] -> do
+    known <- bindVariable variable (ADT name path []) variables
+    refine wanted supplied known
+  Func arguments result, Func suppliedArguments suppliedResult -> do
+    known <- sameArguments arguments suppliedArguments variables
+    refine result suppliedResult known
+  _, _ | expected == actual -> Just variables
+  _, _ -> Nothing
+  where
+  sameArguments wanted supplied known = do
+    guard (Array.length wanted == Array.length supplied)
+    foldM (\current (Tuple left right) -> refine left right current) known (Array.zip wanted supplied)
+  bindVariable name value known = case Map.lookup name known of
+    Just previous | previous /= value -> Nothing
+    _ -> Just (Map.insert name value known)
+
+emit :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> Maybe Ident -> Level -> TcoExpr -> TcoExpr -> Maybe ExprResult
+emit translate context nextId mbIdent level producer continuation = do
+  guard (Array.null context.recVars && onlyCurried producer)
+  let Tuple function spine = collectGoSpine producer
+  -- Start with direct class-method forms. FFI methods may contain their own
+  -- application stages and are not flattened by this fusion.
+  guard (directTraversal function)
+  traversal <- recognizeMaybe function (getGoSpineArgs spine)
+  guard (Array.length traversal.args == traversal.callbackOffset + 2)
+  callback <- Array.index traversal.args traversal.callbackOffset
+  input <- Array.index traversal.args (traversal.callbackOffset + 1)
+  guard (annotated (Array Int) input)
+  guard (annotated (ADT "Data.Maybe.Maybe" [ "Data", "Maybe", "Maybe" ] [ Array Int ]) producer)
+  mapper <- justMapper (if traversal.indexed then 2 else 1) callback
+  branch <- case unwrapTcoExpr continuation of
+    EffectPure value -> do
+      -- Do not move traversal work into or out of a deferred effect value.
+      guard context.options.inEffectBlock
+      guard (annotated (ADT "Effect.Effect" [ "Effect", "Effect" ] [ Int ]) continuation)
+      pure value
+    _ -> pure continuation
+  descriptor <- consumedArray context level branch
+  let whole = NeutralExpr (Let mbIdent level (neutral producer) (neutral continuation))
+  pure (emitLoop translate context nextId traversal mapper descriptor (maximumLevel whole))
+
+directTraversal :: TcoExpr -> Boolean
+directTraversal function = case unwrapTcoExpr function of
+  Accessor _ (GetProp "traverse") -> true
+  _ -> case qualifiedTarget function of
+    Just { mbMod: Just (ModuleName "Data.Traversable"), name: "traverse" } -> true
+    Just { mbMod: Just (ModuleName "Data.TraversableWithIndex"), name } -> name == "traverseWithIndex" || name == "traverseWithIndexDefault"
+    _ -> false
+
+consumedArray :: ExprContext -> Level -> TcoExpr -> Maybe ArrayFoldDescriptor
+consumedArray context level expression = do
+  guard (annotated Int expression)
+  success <- case unwrapTcoExpr expression of
+    Branch branches otherwise -> do
+      guard (case unwrapTcoExpr otherwise of
+        Fail _ -> true
+        _ -> false)
+      case NEA.toArray branches of
+        [ Pair first firstResult, Pair second secondResult ]
+          | tagged "Nothing" first && tagged "Just" second -> Just secondResult
+          | tagged "Just" first && tagged "Nothing" second -> Just firstResult
+        _ -> Nothing
+    _ -> Nothing
+  guard (annotated Int success && onlyCurried success)
+  let Tuple fn spine = collectGoSpine success
+  guard (annotated (Func [ Array Int ] Int) fn)
+  case getGoSpineArgs spine of
+    [ value ] -> do
+      guard (annotated (Array Int) value)
+      guard (case unwrapTcoExpr value of
+        Accessor object (GetCtorField (Qualified (Just (ModuleName "Data.Maybe")) (Ident "Just")) _ (ProperName "Maybe") (Ident "Just") _ 0) -> sameLocal object
+        _ -> false)
+    _ -> Nothing
+  target <- qualifiedTarget fn
+  let local = target.mbMod == Nothing || map (String.replaceAll (Pattern ".") (Replacement "_") <<< unwrap) target.mbMod == Just context.modNameStr
+  info <- if local then Map.lookup target.name context.moduleFunctions else do
+    owner <- target.mbMod
+    Map.lookup (unwrap owner <> "." <> target.name) context.metadata.globalFunctions
+  guard (info.arity == 1 && info.fArgs == [ TypeNativeArray TypeInt64 ] && info.fRet == TypeInt64)
+  descriptor <- info.arrayFold
+  guard (validDescriptor descriptor)
+  pure descriptor
+  where
+  sameLocal object = annotated (ADT "Data.Maybe.Maybe" [ "Data", "Maybe", "Maybe" ] [ Array Int ]) object
+    && case unwrapTcoExpr object of
+      Local _ actual -> actual == level
+      _ -> false
+  tagged tag condition = annotated Boolean condition && case unwrapTcoExpr condition of
+    PrimOp (Op1 (OpIsTag (Qualified (Just (ModuleName "Data.Maybe")) (Ident name))) object) -> name == tag && sameLocal object
+    _ -> false
+
+emitLoop :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> { indexed :: Boolean, callbackOffset :: Int, args :: Array TcoExpr } -> NeutralExpr -> ArrayFoldDescriptor -> Int -> ExprResult
+emitLoop translate context nextId traversal mapper descriptor lastLevel =
+  let
+    start = max lastLevel (maximumLevel descriptor.callback) + nextId + 1
+    folded = Tco.analyze [] (evalState (freshen descriptor.callback) start)
+    mapped = Tco.analyze [] mapper
+    native currentId callback = case unwrapTcoExpr callback of
+      Abs parameters callbackBody ->
+        let
+          grouped = collectCurriedAbs parameters callbackBody
+          params = map (\(Tuple name level) -> Tuple (localId name level) TypeInt64) (NEA.toArray grouped.args)
+          callbackContext = context { depth = context.depth + 1, bound = bindParameters params context.bound
+            , tcoIdent = Nothing, loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: true, inEffectBlock: false }
+            , mbExpectedExprType = Just Int, mbExpectedGoType = Just TypeInt64 }
+          result = translate callbackContext currentId grouped.body
+        in { expr: GoFuncLit params (flattenStmts result.stmts) (integer result.expr result.exprType) TypeInt64, nextId: result.nextId }
+      _ -> { expr: rawGo "nil", nextId: currentId }
+    captured = CallArguments.capture { prefix: "traverseFold_arg_", markUsed: true }
+      (\position currentId argument -> if position == traversal.callbackOffset then
+        { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: rawGo "true", exprType: TypeBool, nextId: currentId }
+        else translate (childContext context Nothing) currentId argument) nextId traversal.args
+    mapResult = native captured.nextId mapped
+    foldResult = native mapResult.nextId folded
+    suffix = show foldResult.nextId
+    variable label = "traverseFold_" <> label <> "_" <> suffix
+    arg position = fromMaybe (rawGo "nil") (Array.index captured.exprs position)
+    source = arraySource (case arg (traversal.callbackOffset + 1) of
+      GoVar name -> name
+      _ -> "") (variable "source") (fromMaybe TypeValue (Array.index captured.exprTypes (traversal.callbackOffset + 1)))
+    index = GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoVar (variable "index") ]
+    value = integer (GoVar (variable "value")) source.elementType
+    mappedValue = GoCall (GoVar (variable "map")) (if traversal.indexed then [ index, value ] else [ value ])
+    body =
+      [ GoAssign (variable "map") mapResult.expr, GoAssign (variable "fold") foldResult.expr
+      , GoAssign (variable "result") (GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoInt descriptor.seed ])
+      , source.assignment
+      , GoForRange (variable "index" <> ", " <> variable "value" <> " := range " <> source.target)
+          [ GoMutate (variable "result") (GoCall (GoVar (variable "fold")) [ index, GoVar (variable "result"), mappedValue ]) ]
+      ]
+  in { stmts: captured.stmts, expr: GoCall (GoFuncLit [] body (GoVar (variable "result")) TypeInt64) []
+     , exprType: TypeInt64, nextId: foldResult.nextId + 1 }
+  where
+  integer value from = coerceGoExpr context.codegenStateRef context.modNameStr value from TypeInt64
+
+neutral :: TcoExpr -> NeutralExpr
+neutral (TcoExpr _ syntax) = NeutralExpr (map neutral syntax)

+module Gopurs.Ownership.Continuations (share) where
+
+import Prelude
+
+import Control.Alternative (guard)
+import Control.Monad.State (StateT, get, put, runStateT)
+import Control.Monad.Trans.Class (lift)
+import Data.Array as Array
+import Data.Array.NonEmpty as NEA
+import Data.Foldable (foldMap)
+import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..))
+import Data.Traversable (traverse)
+import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..))
+import Gopurs.GoAst (GoExpr(..), rawGo)
+import Gopurs.Ownership.Analysis (strip)
+import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Semantics (NeutralExpr)
+import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendSyntax(..), Pair(..))
+
+type Shared = { blocks :: Array (Array GoExpr), leaves :: Int, saved :: Int }
+type Sharing = StateT Shared Maybe
+
+-- Only split a root decision region: its internal nodes contain conditions,
+-- never bindings, writes or calls which can donate cells. The supplied terminal
+-- emitter proves every leaf independently and starts its temporary counter at
+-- zero, so structurally equal bodies already have identical local names.
+-- A label starts a separate block; its variables cannot enter another leaf's
+-- scope. No test, read, write, allocation or consuming call moves in time.
+share
+  :: (NeutralExpr -> Maybe GoExpr)
+  -> (NeutralExpr -> Maybe (Array GoExpr))
+  -> NeutralExpr
+  -> Maybe (Array GoExpr)
+share condition terminal original = do
+  guard (case strip original of
+    Branch _ _ -> true
+    _ -> false)
+  Tuple tree state <- runStateT (visit original) { blocks: [], leaves: 0, saved: 0 }
+  -- Avoid extra jumps for tiny regions. This is a code-size threshold, not an
+  -- ownership shortcut: every candidate leaf was proved before this decision.
+  guard (state.leaves >= 4 && state.saved >= 32)
+  pure (tree <> foldMap block (Array.mapWithIndex Tuple state.blocks))
+  where
+  label index = "__owned_continuation_" <> show index
+  block (Tuple index body) = [ rawGo (label index <> ": {") ] <> body <> [ rawGo "}" ]
+
+  visit :: NeutralExpr -> Sharing (Array GoExpr)
+  visit expression = case strip expression of
+    Branch branches fallback -> do
+      cases <- traverse (\(Pair test body) -> do
+        testExpr <- lift (condition test)
+        statements <- visit body
+        pure { testExpr, statements }) (NEA.toArray branches)
+      otherwise <- visit fallback
+      pure (Array.foldr (\branch rest -> [ GoIfElse branch.testExpr branch.statements rest ]) otherwise cases)
+    _ -> do
+      body <- lift (terminal expression)
+      state <- get
+      index <- case Array.elemIndex body state.blocks of
+        Just existing -> do
+          put (state { leaves = state.leaves + 1, saved = state.saved + Array.length body })
+          pure existing
+        Nothing -> do
+          put (state { leaves = state.leaves + 1, blocks = Array.snoc state.blocks body })
+          pure (Array.length state.blocks)
+      pure [ rawGo ("goto " <> label index) ]

+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
+import { mkdirSync, readFileSync, readdirSync, rmSync, symlinkSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { delimiter, join } from 'node:path';
+import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
+import test from 'node:test';
+import { corePackages, createWorkspace, prepareFixture } from './test-workspace.mjs';
+import { findTypedCompiler } from './build/native-workspace.mjs';
+
+const root = fileURLToPath(new URL('../', import.meta.url));
+const modes = [{ name: 'js', GOPURS_JS: '1' }, { name: 'native-parallel', GOPURS_JS: '0' }]
+    .filter(mode => !process.env.GOPURS_TEST_MODES || process.env.GOPURS_TEST_MODES.split(',').includes(mode.name));
+const profiles = (process.env.GOPURS_TEST_PROFILES || 'release,dev').split(',');
+const fixture = join(root, 'tools/fixtures/array-producer-fold.purs');
+const inputs = [[], [1, 2, 3], [2147483647, -2147483648, -1, 0]];
+const parse = stdout => stdout.trim().split('\n').map(line => JSON.parse(line));
+function expected(seed = 7, weight = 1, trace = false) {
+    const out = [];
+    const consume = values => values.reduce((total, value, index) => {
+        if (trace) out.push(100 + index);
+        return (total + (((index + weight) * value) | 0)) | 0;
+    }, seed);
+    for (const values of inputs) {
+        const a = consume(values.map(x => (x + 1) | 0));
+        const b = consume([...values, ...values.toReversed()]);
+        const c = consume(values.map(x => (x + 3) | 0));
+        const d = (consume(values.map(x => (x + 1) | 0)) + values.length) | 0;
+        out.push([a, b, c, d], values, values.toReversed());
+    }
+    out.push(consume([2, 3, 4]), [1, 2, 3], 'mapper failure', [1, 2]);
+    out.push(consume([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]), [1, 2], consume([]), []);
+    return out;
+}
+function generatedText(directory) {
+    return readdirSync(directory, { withFileTypes: true }).filter(entry => entry.name !== '.gopurs-cache')
+        .map(entry => { const path = join(directory, entry.name); return entry.isDirectory() ? generatedText(path) : entry.name.endsWith('.go') ? readFileSync(path, 'utf8') : ''; }).join('\n');
+}
+function worker(source, name) {
+    const start = source.indexOf(`func ${name}(`); if (start < 0) return '';
+    const end = source.indexOf('\nfunc ', start + 1); return source.slice(start, end < 0 ? undefined : end);
+}
+function snapshots(source) {
+    return Object.fromEntries(['Get_Main_mapped', 'Call_Main_mapped', 'Get_Main_appended', 'Call_Main_appended', 'Get_Main_captured', 'Call_Main_captured',
+        'Get_Main_withUnknown', 'Call_Main_withUnknown', 'Get_Main_withFactories', 'Call_Main_withFactories', 'Call_Subject_consume']
+        .map(name => [name, worker(source, name)]));
+}
+function abi(source) { const match = worker(source, 'Call_Subject_consume').match(/^func Call_Subject_consume\([^\n]+/); assert.ok(match, 'native consumer worker remains present'); return match[0]; }
+
+// Each transition keeps consume :: Array Int -> Int and the same native worker ABI.
+// The cache must depend on descriptor contents and on its later absence.
+function variants(original) {
+    const weighted = original.replace('(index + 1)', '(index + 2)');
+    const seeded = weighted.replace(' 7 values', ' 19 values');
+    const unknown = '-- @inline Subject.step never\n' + seeded
+        .replace('import Prelude', 'import Prelude\nimport Effect.Console (logShow)\nimport Effect.Unsafe (unsafePerformEffect)')
+        .replace('foldlWithIndex (\\index total value -> total + (index + 2) * value) 19 values', 'foldlWithIndex step 19 values')
+        + '\nstep :: Int -> Int -> Int -> Int\nstep index total value = unsafePerformEffect do\n  logShow (100 + index)\n  pure (total + (index + 2) * value)\n';
+    return [
+        { name: 'callback', source: weighted, expected: expected(7, 2), eligible: true },
+        { name: 'seed', source: seeded, expected: expected(19, 2), eligible: true },
+        { name: 'unknown', source: unknown, expected: expected(19, 2, true), eligible: false },
+    ];
+}
+
+test('producer folds preserve source results, phases and imported descriptor cache transitions', async t => {
+    assert.ok(modes.length); const workspace = createWorkspace(); console.log(`Array producer fold fixture workspace: ${workspace}`);
+    let completed = 0; t.after(() => { if (completed === modes.length && process.env.GOPURS_TEST_KEEP_WORKSPACE !== '1') rmSync(workspace, { recursive: true, force: true }); });
+    const typedBin = join(workspace, 'typed-bin'); mkdirSync(typedBin); symlinkSync(findTypedCompiler(root, process.env.GOPURS_PURS), join(typedBin, 'purs'));
+    const environment = { ...process.env, PATH: [typedBin, join(root, 'node_modules/.bin'), process.env.PATH].join(delimiter), GOWORK: 'off', GOPURS_DAEMON: '0', GOPURS_RESIDENT: '0',
+        GOPURS_RUST: '0', GOPURS_GO_PACKAGES: '1', GOPURS_GO_PACKAGE_OVERLAY: '1', GOPURS_BUILD_MANIFEST: '1', GOPURS_PREPARE_JOBS: '2', GOPURS_PBO_JOBS: '2', GOPURS_EMIT_JOBS: '2', GOPURS_PIPELINE: '1', GOPURS_FORCE_BUILD: '1' };
+    for (const key of ['GOPURS_ALLOC_PROFILE', 'GOPURS_COMPILER_SNAPSHOT', 'PPROF']) delete environment[key];
+    for (const [hostIndex, mode] of modes.entries()) await t.test(mode.name, () => {
+        const directory = prepareFixture(root, workspace, fixture, hostIndex, corePackages(root)).directory;
+        const subject = join(directory, 'src/Subject.purs'); const original = readFileSync(subject, 'utf8'); let sequence = 0;
+        const run = (label, command, args, cwd = directory, overrides = {}) => {
+            console.log(`${mode.name}: ${label}`); const result = spawnSync(command, args, { cwd, env: { ...environment, GOPURS_JS: mode.GOPURS_JS, ...overrides }, encoding: 'utf8', timeout: 240000, maxBuffer: 16 * 1024 * 1024 });
+            writeFileSync(join(directory, 'logs', `${sequence++}-${label}.log`), (result.stdout || '') + (result.stderr || '')); assert.ifError(result.error); assert.equal(result.status, 0, `${label}\n${result.stdout}\n${result.stderr}`); return result.stdout;
+        };
+        const compiler = process.env.GOPURS_TEST_COMPILER || join(root, 'bin/gopurs');
+        const javascript = cwd => parse(run('javascript', 'node', ['--input-type=module', '-e', 'import {main} from "./output/Main/index.js";main();'], cwd));
+        run('frontend', 'spago', ['build', '-q', '--offline']); const oracle = javascript(directory); assert.deepEqual(oracle, expected());
+        if (process.env.GOPURS_TEST_FRONTEND_ONLY !== '1') for (const [profileIndex, profile] of profiles.entries()) {
+            writeFileSync(subject, original); run(`${profile}-frontend`, 'spago', ['build', '-q', '--offline']);
+            run(profile, compiler, [`--${profile}`, '--main', 'Main']);
+            const baselineSource = generatedText(join(directory, 'output/purescript')); const before = snapshots(baselineSource);
+            writeFileSync(join(directory, 'logs', `${profile}-workers.json`), JSON.stringify(before, null, 2) + '\n');
+            const baselineAbi = abi(baselineSource);
+            if (profile === 'release') for (const name of ['mapped', 'appended']) assert.match(before[`Get_Main_${name}`] + before[`Call_Main_${name}`], /arrayProducer_fold_/, `${name}: actual imported descriptor must activate`);

+normalize :: Int -> Snapshot -> Snapshot
+normalize 0 snapshot = snapshot
+normalize remaining snapshot = normalize (remaining - 1) (snapshot { total = snapshot.total + 0 })
+
+down :: Int -> Snapshot -> Snapshot
+down 0 snapshot = snapshot
+down remaining snapshot = down (remaining - 1) (snapshot { total = snapshot.total + (-1) })

+const metadata = withReboxFields({elidedCtors:emptySet,ctorTypes:emptyMap,pointerAdtPaths:emptyMap,
+  pointerAdtNodes:emptySet,pointerAdtLeaves:emptyMap,enumAdts:emptySet,enumCtors:emptySet,
+  globalTypes:emptyMap,globalFunctions:emptyMap,classDeclsFields:emptyMap});
+const int=C.Int.value, boolean=C.Boolean.value;
+const expr=x=>new NeutralExpr(x), typed=(ty,x)=>expr(new S.Typed(ty,x));
+const literal=n=>typed(int,expr(new S.Lit(new C.LitInt(n))));
+const local=(name,level,ty)=>typed(ty,expr(new S.Local(new Just(name),level)));
+const bin=(op,a,b,ty=int)=>typed(ty,expr(new S.PrimOp(new S.Op2(op,a,b))));
+const add=(a,b)=>bin(new S.OpIntNum(S.OpAdd.value),a,b);
+const sub=(a,b)=>bin(new S.OpIntNum(S.OpSubtract.value),a,b);
+const rec=fields=>new C.Record(new C.Row(fields.map(([k,v])=>new Tuple(k,v)),Nothing.value));
+const row=rec([['borrowed',new C.Array(int)],['stamp',C.String.value],['total',int]]);
+const single=rec([['total',int]]);
+const nested=rec([['inner',single],['total',int]]);
+const access=(x,k,ty=int)=>typed(ty,expr(new S.Accessor(x,new S.GetProp(k))));
+const update=(x,props,ty)=>typed(ty,expr(new S.Update(x,props.map(([k,v])=>new C.Prop(k,v)))));

+const lambda=(body,ty=row)=>typed(fnType(ty),expr(new S.Abs([new Tuple(new Just('left'),0),new Tuple(new Just('snapshot'),1)],body)));
+function recurrence(name,delta,options={}) {
+  const ty=options.ty??row,n=local('left',0,int),state=local('snapshot',1,ty);
+  const next=options.change?.(state,n)??update(state,[['total',add(access(state,'total'),literal(delta))]],ty);
+  const call=typed(ty,expr(new S.App(typed(fnType(ty),expr(new S.Var(new C.Qualified(new Just('HotRecords'),name)))),[sub(n,literal(1)),next])));
+  const body=typed(ty,expr(new S.Branch([new S.Pair(bin(new S.OpIntOrd(S.OpEq.value),n,literal(0),boolean),state)],call)));

+const moduleOf=bindings=>({name:'HotRecords',bindings,comments:[],imports:emptySet,exports:emptySet,reExports:emptySet,

+  writeFileSync(join(directory,'gopurs_runtime/runtime.go'),runtimeGoCode);

+import("testing";"reflect")

+  {Call_HotRecords_increase,Call_HotRecords___gopurs_affine_cold_increase,1},
+  {Call_HotRecords_decrease,Call_HotRecords___gopurs_affine_cold_decrease,-1},
+  {Call_HotRecords_normalize,Call_HotRecords___gopurs_affine_cold_normalize,0},

+ for _,c:=range cases{for _,n:=range []int64{0,1,2,7,1000,2147483647,4294967297,4294967298,4294967303,-4294967295,-4294967294}{for _,seed:=range []int64{-9223372036854775808,-2147483649,-2147483648,-1,0,2147483647,2147483648,4294967295,9223372036854775807}{

+ for _,n:=range []int64{0,1,2,2147483647,4294967297}{input:=struct{total int64}{4294967295};if Call_HotRecords_tiny(n,input)!=Call_HotRecords___gopurs_affine_cold_tiny(n,input){t.Fatal("single field")};checks++}
+ // Check the exact interval identity on boundary values and a deterministic

+ samples:=[]int64{-9223372036854775808,-4294967296,-2147483648,-1,0,1,2147483646,2147483647,2147483648,4294967295,4294967296,9223372036854775807};var random uint64=4321987
+ for i:=0;i<10000;i++{random^=random<<13;random^=random>>7;random^=random<<17;samples=append(samples,int64(random))}

# Plan d’optimisation Go/C

Mis à jour le **26 novembre 2026**. Objectif : approcher **1× sur les quatre
indicateurs Go/C**, avec les mêmes benchmarks, harnais, FFI et références C.
L’entrée reste opaque à chaque invocation. Les transformations doivent être
applicables à du code général et exploiter le typage du TAST.

## Situation actuelle — 37 cas comparables

Les 23 références C de bibliothèque ajoutées le 26 novembre complètent désormais
les 14 cas core. Les quatre indicateurs Go/C portent sur **37 cas**, avec une
référence C figée à **8,777347 ms**. Après la fusion du traverse total et les
wrappers natifs inlinables de records, les quatre indicateurs sont
**1,055523× / 5,904443× / 4,505682× / 3,450821×**
(ratio des totaux / μ / Q₂ / G). Le temps Go total est **9,264692 ms**.
La paire fraîche avant était **1,055504× / 6,496767× / 4,515829× / 3,584361×**.
Le total reste pratiquement identique (+0,0019 %), μ baisse de 9,12 %, Q₂ de
0,225 % et G de 3,73 %. La hausse primaire de concat (+6,60 %) est conservée.
Une première campagne perturbée par une activité CPU concurrente est archivée
séparément et exclue ; seule sa reprise complète fournit ces indicateurs.

### ST.Ref et Effect.Ref — optimisés en Release

- [x] Geler le compilateur, les binaires avant, les benchmarks, les ports et C37.
- [x] Prouver le gain sur une sonde puis reconnaître les quatre formes d'IR réelles.
- [x] Réduire les boucles uniquement pour une référence fraîche, sans échappement,
  suivie d'un helper arithmétique vérifié puis d'une lecture. Garder les helpers
  publics, l'évaluation stricte et le repli de l'écriture à `INT32_MAX`.
- [x] Valider 816 variantes d'IR, 24 tests connexes, la fixture via les hôtes
  JS/natif en Release/Dev et 336 contrôles d'entrée avant/après. L'appel opaque
  est conservé à chaque invocation ; Dev garde son chemin général si nécessaire.
- [x] Remesurer les 37 cas dans une paire fraîche avec C inchangé :
  **1,313850× / 10844,959754× / 9,116514× / 25,192856×** avant,
  **1,289538× / 132,263561× / 7,654367× / 10,201512×** après.
- [x] Examiner les quatre hausses supérieures à 5 % : non reproduites dans
  les contre-mesures isolées, sans remplacer les échantillons principaux.
  Publier les 37 mesures Go Release et leurs ratios dans les tableaux existants.
  [Rapport et preuves](../altbak.pub/docs/benchmark-results/2026-11-26-go-ref-loops.md).

Les quatre actions passent respectivement de **7,11 / 22,03 / 220,24 / 196,97 µs**
à **8,64 / 10,73 / 15,86 / 10,60 ns** (ST write/modify, Effect write/modify).
Le total reste dominé par RBTree ; sa mesure avant est déjà supérieure à la
baseline historique. Les gains de cette optimisation sont ceux de la paire
fraîche, sans attribuer les écarts entre campagnes au changement du compilateur.

### Array `traverse Maybe` — première optimisation livrée

- [x] Geler le compilateur, les binaires et les références de la campagne Ref.
- [x] Vérifier sur une sonde puis sur l'IR réel le coût du parcours après
  `Nothing` et des objets `Just` intermédiaires.
- [x] Émettre une boucle directe pour les callbacks `Int -> Maybe Int` dont

## Point de départ historique — 14 cas core

Baseline officielle : [README d’altbak.pub](../altbak.pub/README.md), colonne
gopurs optimisée, et [campagne State du 25 novembre](../altbak.pub/docs/benchmark-results/2026-11-25-go-state.json).
Les quatre indicateurs portent sur les **14 cas communs à Go et C**, parmi les
37 cas Go mesurés en WIP :

Les références C et JS restent figées pour les campagnes d’optimisation Go.

## 1. Coût commun aux petites actions — conversions et callbacks livrés

Church, State, Lazy, Polymorphism, RowToList, List Processing et Array Processing
prenaient environ **12–13 ns** dans la baseline de départ, pour des ratios Go/C
entre **9,51× et 11,99×**. La conversion répétée `Value → interface{}` est
désormais évitée pour les littéraux scalaires immuables. Les callbacks des
actions `Effect Int` mises en cache disposent aussi d’une entrée native ;
les autres actions conservent le chemin `Apply`/`Unbox`.

- [x] Mesurer une sonde isolée utilisant le même FFI : conversion de l’argument
  constant répétée ou préparée une fois, callback générique ou natif. Vérifier
  le résultat, les allocations et la conservation de l’appel opaque.
  Sonde avec getter lazy : State **13,002 → 6,507 ns**, RowToList
  **12,605 → 5,251 ns**, allocations **1 → 0** après initialisation.

  arguments constants immuables, sans anticiper l’appel FFI ni son effet.

  refuser les transformations dont la sûreté n’est pas démontrée.
- [x] Étendre ensuite les callbacks natifs aux thunks `Effect Int` lorsque leur
  type et leur contexte permettent d’éviter `Apply`/`Unbox`. Mesurer séparément
  cette étape pour distinguer les gains.
- [x] Valider cette première amélioration : cas limites, ordre et nombre d’effets, valeurs
  capturées, les refus de spécialisation et les deux hôtes JS/natif en

  **47 tests ciblés** et la fixture sur les deux hôtes passent. Sur les
  exécutables générés, les **88 variantes d’entrée** concordent avant/après
  et avec C ; chaque action conserve exactement un appel opaque. Le diagnostic
  d’allocations confirme **une allocation de moins sur chacun des 14 cas**.
- [x] Comparer le Go généré avant/après, vérifier les entrées variables et les
  résultats avec le C inchangé, puis mesurer les 14 et 37 cas en processus

- [x] Archiver données, commandes et preuves ; actualiser la colonne gopurs du
  README en conservant ses statuts par backend et les autres colonnes.

Résultat de la paire fraîche du 26 novembre : les sept actions passent de
**13–14 ns à 6,5–7,8 ns**, soit **43–51 % de temps en moins**. Les quatre
indicateurs Go/C deviennent **1,203742× / 3,938655× / 5,454538× / 2,066376×**
(total / μ / Q₂ / G), contre **1,206713× / 6,805616× / 7,818883× / 2,970261×**
pour l’ancien exécutable remesuré. Le total est plus élevé que dans la baseline
historique, même avant modification ; les gains des petites actions ne doivent
pas être confondus avec les variations de RBTree.

contre-mesures isolées ; les mesures principales restent conservées.

La [campagne suivante sur les callbacks natifs](../altbak.pub/docs/benchmark-results/2026-11-26-go-native-callbacks.md)
est également livrée : **31–43 %** de temps supplémentaire économisé sur les
sept actions, désormais à **3,6–4,7 ns**. Les quatre indicateurs deviennent
**1,096290× / 2,546327× / 3,243306× / 1,477750×**, contre
**1,110360× / 3,579933× / 4,770374× / 1,881685×** avant dans cette paire fraîche.
**51 tests ciblés**, la fixture JS/natif Release/Dev, **528 contrôles d’entrée**,
**306 résultats de campagne** et **56 contrôles d’allocation** passent.
La seule hausse supérieure à 5 % ne se reproduit pas en contre-mesure isolée.
Les corps génériques sont conservés ; le déballage direct des callbacks
unaires évite le surcoût de repli découvert dans la première sonde.

Les petits cas restent à environ **3,2–4,0× C** : leur statut reste WIP et
l’écart résiduel devra être reprofilé. **Priorité identifiée alors : Prime Sieve**,
le ratio individuel Go/C le plus élevé de ces 14 cas core à cette étape.

## 2. Prime Sieve — à traiter

Ratio actuel **4,555092×** : **0,519864 µs Go / 0,114128 µs C**.

- [ ] Évaluer un petit tampon sur pile avec garde de taille et chemin général.
- [ ] Pour le cas prouvé `lower = 2`, commencer le marquage à `p²` et arrêter
  les nouveaux marquages à √n. Préserver l’algorithme général lorsque `lower > 2`.
- [ ] Tester des entrées variables, les bornes du tampon et les deux chemins,
  puis mesurer avec les références inchangées.

## 3. Tail Call Optimization — à traiter

Ratio actuel **1,849805×** : **59,497234 µs Go / 32,164063 µs C**.
La boucle conserve 100 000 itérations pour l’entrée usuelle.

- [ ] Étendre aux récurrences scalaires la réduction de `Σ(k mod d)` déjà
  présente pour les records dans `RecordAffineLoops`.
- [ ] Prouver les bornes et la sémantique Int32 ; garder le chemin général
  pour les entrées négatives, larges ou non reconnues.
- [ ] Vérifier les résultats et mesurer les quatre indicateurs.

## 4. Red-Black Tree — à traiter

Ratio actuel **1,093915×** : **9,525813 ms Go / 8,708000 ms C**.
Ce cas représente **99,20 % du temps Go des 14 cas comparables** ; il est donc
la priorité propre au ratio des totaux.

- [ ] Profiler les allocations individuelles des nœuds et les barrières GC.
- [ ] Étudier une allocation groupée lorsqu’une preuve de durée de vie et de
  non-échappement le permet. Les annotations locales d’usage ne suffisent pas
  à prouver l’absence d’alias ou le droit de mutation.
- [ ] Si nécessaire, préciser l’analyse d’IR ou les garanties TAST manquantes
  avant d’implémenter une gestion par région.
- [ ] Évaluer la suppression du champ de comptage uniquement sur les chemins
  dont la propriété exclusive est prouvée ; préserver les arbres partagés.
- [ ] Valider la correction, mesurer et archiver une campagne distincte.

## Protocole commun

Geler les sources, les binaires avant et les références avant toute modification.
Commencer chaque piste par une expérience courte. Comparer à la baseline officielle
et à une paire avant/après fraîche, avec trois processus par variante en ordre
AB/BA/AB, les mêmes réglages et aucun build concurrent. Garder les diagnostics
séparés des échantillons publiés. Les gains envisagés restent des hypothèses
jusqu’à leur validation sur le code réellement généré.

probe-effects/result.md.text:
# Immediate Effect branch diagnostic

The exact real prepared Effect.Ref write action has no native Effect Int metadata. Its official FFI adapter selects `func() int { return r.Unbox[int](r.Apply(action, r.Value{})) }`. The diagnostic now measures that adapter explicitly, not only the narrower `.IntVal` profiling loop. Preparation and callback adaptation happen outside the measured action, as in the official batch worker.

Three independent short processes confirm one 32-byte allocation per action in the frozen real getter and its otherwise identical copied control. The copied candidate directly executes the selected positive-count hot branch, leaving the original opaque calls, saved/replayed action and cold closure/callback untouched. The candidate allocates zero bytes/objects. Adapter median control13.0ns → candidate6.2ns (approximately52% less); direct Apply.IntVal and actual-getter controls are retained separately in results.json. These are diagnostics, not official Go/C timings.

Each process compares48 varied/replayed calls, including negative signed64 extremes, values belowInt32min, zero, normal positives and Int32max-1. Positive counts >=Int32max are deliberately not executed: the unchanged original write loop does not terminate there. Candidate cold code is copied intact. Full phase/order, unknown-action and saved-callback proofs are required for a generic compiler implementation, beyond this concrete action probe.

No compiler, benchmark, C reference, FFI or frozen generated source has been modified. prepare.py reconstructs the copied action from the hashed Tree+Sum after-all package. Commands: `GOWORK=off go build -o probe .`; three alternating-case processes `./probe -test.benchtime=200ms`. The earlier three-second pprof includes GC pressure; its shares are a bottleneck clue, not a replacement for paired action timing.

module Main where

-- @dependencies: prelude effect console refs exceptions either foldable-traversable
-- @inline Main.choose never
-- @inline Main.nested never
-- @inline Main.factory never
-- @inline Main.condition never
-- @inline Main.makeSaved never
-- @inline Main.returned never

import Prelude
import Data.Either (isLeft)
import Data.Foldable (for_)
import Effect (Effect)
import Effect.Console (log, logShow)
import Effect.Exception (throw, try)
import Effect.Ref as Ref
import Effect.Unsafe (unsafePerformEffect)

tick :: forall a. Ref.Ref String -> String -> a -> Effect a
tick trace label value = do
  Ref.modify_ (_ <> label) trace
  pure value

condition :: Ref.Ref String -> String -> Boolean -> Boolean
condition trace label value = unsafePerformEffect (tick trace label value)

factory :: Ref.Ref String -> String -> Int -> Effect Int
factory trace label value = unsafePerformEffect do
  _ <- tick trace ("F" <> label) unit
  pure (tick trace ("E" <> label) value)

choose :: Ref.Ref String -> Ref.Ref Boolean -> Effect Int
choose trace flag = do
  selected <- Ref.read flag
  if condition trace "C" selected then pure 7 else factory trace "U" 19

nested :: Ref.Ref String -> Ref.Ref Boolean -> Effect Int
nested trace flag = do
  selected <- Ref.read flag
  if condition trace "A" selected then pure 11
  else if condition trace "B" (not selected) then tick trace "K" 22
  else factory trace "N" 33

makeSaved :: Ref.Ref String -> Ref.Ref Boolean -> Effect (Effect Int)
makeSaved trace flag = do
  selected <- Ref.read flag
  let pending = if condition trace "S" selected then factory trace "P" 41 else factory trace "Q" 43
  _ <- tick trace "D" unit
  pure pending

returned :: Ref.Ref String -> Ref.Ref Boolean -> Effect (Effect Int)
returned trace flag = do
  selected <- Ref.read flag
  if condition trace "R" selected then pure (tick trace "I" 51) else pure (factory trace "J" 53)

failing :: Ref.Ref String -> Ref.Ref Boolean -> Effect Int
failing trace flag = do
  selected <- Ref.read flag
  if unsafePerformEffect (do
    _ <- tick trace "X" unit
    if selected then throw "condition marker" else pure false)
    then pure 1
    else factory trace "Z" 2

main :: Effect Unit
main = do

probe-codepoint-take/design.md.text:
# CP.take immédiatement consommé par un fold de code points

État : conception après validation native de traverse. Aucune modification de cette piste dans le compilateur principal. La sonde du dossier compare l'action réellement préparée, avec appels opaques conservés :8568 comparaisons passent contre le `CP.take` et le checksum actuels ; médiane7264→2956ns et2allocations→0 sur trois répétitions d'un même processus. Les mesures officielles et l'oracle source JavaScript restent à faire.

## Descripteur distinct

Ajouter `CodePointFoldDescriptor = { callback :: NeutralExpr, seed :: Int }` et `FunctionInfo.codePointFold :: Maybe CodePointFoldDescriptor`. Cette preuve décrit une fonction String→Int, sans réutiliser le champ `arrayFold`.

`CodePointFold.describe` reconnaît la forme explicitée par son prépass actuel : une lambda String dont le corps appelle le `foldlArray` canonique avec callback entier fermé, seed littérale et `toCodePointArray` canonique appliqué directement au paramètre. Le callback doit être fermé sur ses deux paramètres ; aucune capture ou référence globale inconnue. Les suffixes de lambda et chaque annotation scalaire imbriquée doivent être cohérents, en conservant le traitement existant des variantes TAST Prim.Function/Prim.Array. Une preuve relue depuis le cache est revalidée, avec ABI exacte `[TypeString] -> TypeInt64` et arité1.

## Fusion bornée

Un nouveau reconnaisseur `CodePointTakeFold` traite uniquement un appel saturé et curried à `Data.String.CodePoints.take count input` immédiatement fourni à un consommateur décrit. Aucun nom de benchmark, aucune traversée de local stocké/réutilisé, aucune application uncurried ou étape cachée. Le type String du producteur et les types Int/String de ses arguments sont vérifiés à travers les wrappers TAST.

L'émetteur de boucle de `CodePointFold` reçoit une limite optionnelle. Le chemin sans limite conserve sa sémantique actuelle ; le chemin borné capture count puis input avant de commencer le parcours, y compris lorsque count≤0. Le callback importé est renommé au-delà des niveaux du producteur et du descripteur. Seed littérale et callback fermé ne déplacent aucune factory ni capture observable.

La boucle garde le chemin ASCII existant et `runtime.DecodeStringCodePoint` pour chaque autre octet. Elle s'arrête après count code points ou à la fin des octets. Aucune sous-chaîne/tableau n'est construit, aucune mutation n'est introduite. Le seed est renvoyé intact pour l'entrée vide ou la limite≤0. Le callback s'exécute dans l'ordre sur les mêmes code points et conserve les opérations Int existantes. Pas de changement du runtime ni du FFI.

## Cache et fichiers

Fichiers attendus : CodegenState, CodePointFold (description et boucle commune), nouveau CodePointTakeFold, CodeGen et CallExprs ; tous les constructeurs de FunctionInfo obtiennent Nothing par défaut. Le protocole workers passe àv4 pour sérialiser contenu et absence du nouveau champ ; validateWorkers vérifie cette preuve. Les anciens manifests restent utilisables pour la gestion des sorties, sans réutiliser leurs workers.

Le helper JS des métadonnées et les fixtures du codec passent au même schéma. L'E2E modifie seulement callback puis seed tout en gardant la signature String→Int, puis passe à un callback inconnu traçant les appels. Le caller doit être régénéré, et warm=clean pour sorties et workers en Release/Dev, sur les hôtes JS puis natif.

## Premier pas et preuves

Avant toute matrice longue : dump de la forme réelle checksum/take et de son callback, puis smoke d'activation sur `StringTakeCodePointsUnicode1500` copié intact. Réutiliser la sonde actuelle comme oracle natif avant/après ; ne pas transformer son gain diagnostique en ratio officiel.

Corpora séparés : Unicode valide avec oracle source JavaScript réel ; lone surrogates/WTF8 avec correspondance UTF16 explicite ; octets UTF8 arbitraires invalides uniquement comparés au comportement natif historique. Inclure compte0/négatif, min/maxInt64, limites au milieu et au-delà de l'entrée, paires de surrogates et supplementary. Tester aussi seed non nulle, callback non commutatif, factory count puis string, sources qui lèvent, callback capturé/inconnu, constructeur/fonction homonyme d'un autre module, annotations contradictoires et résultat de take partagé. Les appels opaques réels restent comptés et rejoués avec entrées changeantes.

Travail prévu dans un nouveau worktree dédié et complet, distinct de celui de traverse. Le transfert vers main attendra la publication et le gel de la vague précédente ainsi que la réussite des preuves isolées.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Measure frozen AppAll builds against the exact published JavaScript references.

Without --after, record a three-process baseline. With --after, compare the
two complete suites in AB/BA/AB order. Benchmark sources and harnesses are not
rewritten; this runner only validates and executes the frozen artifacts.
"""
import argparse
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
from library_suite import library_cases
from measure import check
from publish import ROWS
from validate import CASES, validate_output


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
CATALOGUE = ROOT / 'bin/benchmark/ratio-measurements.json'
LISTED = (
    'RowToList', 'string/indexOf-hit-10000', 'State Monad',
    'record/set-large-1000', 'record/set-medium-1000', 'effect/ref-write-10000',
    'string/concat-1000', 'AST Evaluation', 'array/map-10000',
)


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def inspect(directory):
    path = directory / 'manifest.json'
    manifest = json.loads(path.read_text())
    expected = {'language': 'go', 'mode': 'pure', 'test': None,
                'entry': 'AppAll', 'include_library': True}
    if any(manifest.get(key) != value for key, value in expected.items()):
        raise ValueError(f'Expected a frozen Go AppAll build: {directory}')
    profile = manifest['profile']
    if profile['backend_profile'] != 'release' or profile['pgo']:
        raise ValueError('Only Release builds without PGO can be compared')
    if sha(directory / 'benchmark') != manifest['binary_sha256']:
        raise ValueError(f'Executable differs from its manifest: {directory}')
    # The native driver records extra diagnostic sources not copied into an
    # AppAll workspace. Verify every recorded live source, every copy present,
    # and explicitly require the complete 37-case suite and its harness.
    for name, digest in manifest['inputs'].items():
        if not name.startswith(('src/', 'srx/')):
            continue
        if sha(ROOT / name) != digest:
            raise ValueError(f'Benchmark source changed since build: {name}')
        copied = directory / name
        if copied.is_file() and sha(copied) != digest:
            raise ValueError(f'Workspace source differs from manifest: {copied}')
    required = ['src/App.purs', 'src/AppAll.purs', 'src/AppLibrary.purs',
                'src/Bench.purs', 'src/Bench.go']
    names = list(CASES) + [case['module'].removeprefix('Test.') for case in library_cases()]
    required += [f'src/Test/{name}/{name}.purs' for name in names]
    for name in required:
        if not (directory / name).is_file():
            raise ValueError(f'Missing suite input: {directory / name}')
        if sha(directory / name) != manifest['inputs'][name]:
            raise ValueError(f'Suite input differs from manifest: {name}')
    oracle = 'bin/benchmark/library-cases.json'
    if sha(ROOT / oracle) != manifest['inputs'][oracle]:
        raise ValueError('Library oracles changed since build')
    return manifest


def definitions():
    if len(CASES) != len(ROWS):
        raise ValueError('Core row names and oracle contract disagree')
    core = [{'name': label, 'module': 'Test.' + module, 'category': 'Stable',
             'expected': int(value)}
            for label, (module, value) in zip(ROWS, CASES.items())]
    library = [{'name': case['label'], 'module': case['module'],
                'category': 'Incl WIP', 'expected': int(case['value'])}
               for case in library_cases()]
    return core + library


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--before', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--after', type=Path, help='omit for a baseline-only campaign')
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--timeout', type=float, default=600)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    directories = {'before': args.before.resolve()}
    if args.after:
        directories['after'] = args.after.resolve()
        if directories['before'] == directories['after']:
            raise ValueError('Before and after must be distinct frozen builds')
    manifests = {name: inspect(directory) for name, directory in directories.items()}
    manifest_hashes = {name: sha(directory / 'manifest.json') for name, directory in directories.items()}
    if args.after:
        for key in ('profile', 'toolchain'):
            if manifests['before'][key] != manifests['after'][key]:
                raise ValueError(f'Build configurations differ: {key}')
        sources = {name: {key: value for key, value in manifest['inputs'].items()
                          if key.startswith(('src/', 'srx/'))}
                   for name, manifest in manifests.items()}
        if sources['before'] != sources['after']:
            raise ValueError('The benchmark sources differ between builds')
    catalogue_hash = sha(CATALOGUE)
    references = json.loads(CATALOGUE.read_text())['columns']['js-pure']
    cases = definitions()
    if len(cases) != 37 or not set(LISTED).issubset(case['name'] for case in cases):
        raise ValueError('The expected 14 core + 23 library suite changed')
    for case in cases:
        if references[case['name']]['time_us'] <= 0:
            raise ValueError('A positive exact JavaScript reference is required')
    args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    env = dict(os.environ, GOGC=manifests['before']['profile']['GOGC'])
    env.pop('PPROF', None)
    order = ['before', 'after', 'after', 'before', 'before', 'after'] if args.after else ['before'] * 3
    samples = {name: [] for name in directories}
    raw_output, raw_errors, checked_runs = {}, {}, []
    for index, variant in enumerate(order, 1):
        directory = directories[variant]
        if sha(directory / 'manifest.json') != manifest_hashes[variant]:
            raise ValueError('Build manifest changed during measurement')
        if sha(directory / 'benchmark') != manifests[variant]['binary_sha256']:
            raise ValueError('Executable changed during measurement')
        process = subprocess.run([str(directory / 'benchmark')], cwd=directory,
                                 env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=args.timeout)
        stem = f'{index}-{variant}'
        (args.output / f'{stem}.log').write_text(process.stdout)
        (args.output / f'{stem}.stderr').write_text(process.stderr)
        process.check_returncode()
        # Require the appended library section, then also validate calibrated
        # power-of-two batch counts through the established campaign checker.
        validate_output(process.stdout, 'pure', include_library=True)
        checked = check(process.stdout, 'pure')
        times = checked['times_us'] + checked['library']['times_us']
        samples[variant].append(times)
        checked_runs.append({'variant': variant, 'result': checked})
        raw_output[stem] = process.stdout
        raw_errors[stem] = process.stderr
        row = dict(zip((case['name'] for case in cases), times))
        print(f'{stem}: 37 oracles verified; RowToList={row["RowToList"]:.6f} us; '
              f'indexOf-hit={row["string/indexOf-hit-10000"]:.6f} us', flush=True)
    all_tests = {}
    for index, case in enumerate(cases):
        name = case['name']
        reference = references[name]
        values = {variant: [run[index] for run in runs] for variant, runs in samples.items()}
        medians = {variant: statistics.median(runs) for variant, runs in values.items()}
        ratios = {variant: elapsed / reference['time_us'] for variant, elapsed in medians.items()}
        item = {**case, 'listed_js_target': name in LISTED,
                'js_reference': reference, 'target_us_strictly_below': 2 * reference['time_us'],
                'samples_us': values, 'medians_us': medians, 'ratios_js': ratios,
                'all_samples_below_2': {variant: max(runs) < 2 * reference['time_us']
                                        for variant, runs in values.items()}}
        if args.after:
            item['speedup'] = medians['before'] / medians['after']
            item['change_percent'] = 100 * (medians['after'] / medians['before'] - 1)
        all_tests[name] = item
    final = 'after' if args.after else 'before'
    listed = sorted(LISTED, key=lambda name: all_tests[name]['ratios_js'][final], reverse=True)
    remaining = [name for name in listed if all_tests[name]['ratios_js'][final] >= 2]
    report = {
        'measured_at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        'host': platform.platform(), 'machine': platform.machine(),
        'mode': 'comparison' if args.after else 'baseline',
        'scope': {'core': 14, 'library': 23, 'listed_js_targets': 9},
        'protocol': 'Three independent processes per variant; AB/BA/AB when comparing; '
                    'three global warmups per suite, three local warmups, calibration, '
                    'minimum of ten batches; median per row of process minima.',
        'order': order, 'GOGC': env['GOGC'], 'GOMAXPROCS': env.get('GOMAXPROCS', 'default'),
        'js_reference_remeasured': False,
        'catalogue': {'path': str(CATALOGUE), 'sha256': catalogue_hash},
        'runner_sha256': sha(Path(__file__)),
        'workspaces': {name: str(path) for name, path in directories.items()},
        'manifest_sha256': manifest_hashes, 'builds': manifests,
        'executable_sha256': {name: manifest['binary_sha256'] for name, manifest in manifests.items()},
        'all_tests': all_tests, 'listed_tests_descending': listed,
        'remaining_listed_at_or_above_2': remaining,
        'remaining_all_at_or_above_2': sorted(
            (name for name, item in all_tests.items() if item['ratios_js'][final] >= 2),
            key=lambda name: all_tests[name]['ratios_js'][final], reverse=True),
        'goal_listed_under_2': not remaining,
        'checked_runs': checked_runs, 'raw_process_output': raw_output,
        'raw_process_stderr': raw_errors,
    }
    for variant, directory in directories.items():
        inspect(directory)
        if sha(directory / 'manifest.json') != manifest_hashes[variant]:
            raise ValueError('Build manifest changed during measurement')
    if sha(CATALOGUE) != catalogue_hash:
        raise ValueError('JavaScript references changed during measurement')
    (args.output / 'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps({name: {'us': all_tests[name]['medians_us'][final],
                            'ratio_js': all_tests[name]['ratios_js'][final]}
                      for name in listed}, indent=2))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    try:
        main()
    except (ValueError, OSError, KeyError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
        print(f'ERROR: {error}', file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
